tei:div.tei:p: ༄0//྾spyo nang skun sdape thropa rdzib//rwarnguྈ/ 5 khuXs 1rngo5 rdoX khurwa rngu py-i2 tshitharngurdo~Xsdusdu~Xsdushādzirnyi 5841 dzi bodi kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha gdams bsgrigs/spyi'i 'ar+pā thengs lngawawawa wawawawawawa0khro'i0ba wawa da wawawaX waXwawawawawawawawawawa

wa— rgyu ༵ 4ngh+ru ——rwazlozlo —rngo5ṣ+ṭha dro0 snewasdeste ————tswa —ci 7 tsā lhotsho (sdu

cha'alarnatretshospre (sprordzodzi( r+yālha4wane bhe spyo//pho 43 55skuta /lta/ ga— ri me( tsho/oṃ5( 5nadzipa cu— d+nghalominang4 (spyi'i 'don thengs 13pa) bod rang skyong ljongs srid gros lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i snye— rgyu cha u yon lhan khang gis rtsom sgeg byas pa/mi rigs dpe sgrun khang /

rtsom sgrig pa'i gtam/rgya che'i klog pa po dang lo rgyus zhib 'jug pa rnam pas de snga'i bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi zhing bran lam lugs sngar bas mkhyen rtogs dang de'i srid 'dzin sgrig gzhir zhib 'jug gnang rgyu'i dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha mkho 'don zhu phyir/ lhag par lo rgyus rang bzhin ldan pa'i mes bod dbar gyi 'brel ba spyi dang bye brag ching rgyal rabs kyi dus skabs nas bzung / mes bod 'brel ba'i gnad don gyi ngo bo ni yang snying‘‘chos srid’ gang gi 'brel ba'i gnad don yin min gyi gnas tshul dngos 'ga' zhig skor ji bzhin mkhyen rtogs sngar bas yong phyir dmigs te〈bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs〉'don thengs bcu gsum pa 'dir/ de snga'i bod kyi‘‘gzhung bla sa gsum’ so so'i〈srid 'dzin sgrig gzhi〉phyogs sgrig bgyis te bkod cing / 'di dag ni de snga'i bod kyi‘‘gzhung bla sa gsum migyi khungs so so'i las khungs 'ga' shas nang las don dngos gnang myong ba'i rgyal gces mi sna bgres song 'ga' zhig la snyan bskul zhus don bzhin khong rnam pas rang nyid so sos dngos gziṭa dngos gsan dang lhag par las don dngos gnang myong ba'i mkhyen tshor dngos dgongs dbyings su chub pa rnams legs sgrig thog khungs so so'i 'brel yod yig lam 'ga' zhig la'ang zhib bsdur gyis 'bri rtsom mdzad (pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ rtsom sgrig gi bya rim nang du yang dogs gcod zhu 'os skabs bstun zhus shing / de bzhin sa skya'i sgrig gzhi'i skor la rdogs gcod zhu 'os mchis rigs — 1

lhicasor zhu yusda mid stabs sa gnal su mi sna ched bskyod kyis de snga'i 'bril yod mi sna 'arga/'a zhig la slar yang dogs gcod dam/ kha gsab bka' 'dri zhus pa dang 'brel lo rgyus yig lam 'ga' zhig la'ang rgyab rten gzhi bcol gyis phyogs sgrig byas pa zhig yin/lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha'i‘‘dngos gsum’mi(dngos brgyud dngos gzigs dngos gsan)gyi rtsa don gzhir bzung de snga'i bod kyi‘‘gzhung bla sa gsum gyi srid 'dzin sgrig gzhi 'di dag khungs so so'i 'brel yod mi sna so sol 'bri rtsom mdzad pa zhig yin gshis/ lo rgyus 'byung stangs 'dren tshul skor sogs nang don gcig mtshungs nyis zlos dang srid 'dzin sgrig gzhi dang 'brel ba med pa'am de tsam rang 'brel ba rmad pa'i lo rgyus gnas tshul yang yod rung /lo rgyus zhib 'jug gi dpyad gzhir song ba tshang ma ji ma ji bzhin du bkod yod/ 'on kyang 'di ga'i rtsom sgrig pa'i lo rgyus dang rig gnas kyi shes tshad dman khar/ sngar gyi yig lam khag la lo tshigs 'ga' shas thad gcig mthun min pa'ang yod pa sogs kyi rkyen pas 'dir 'gal nor ci rigs 'byung srid cing / des na rgya che'i klog pa po rnam pas gang ci'i dgongs 'char dang slob ston lhug stsol gnang rgyu'i re 'dun zhu rgyu dang / phyogs mtshungs ljongs yig tshags khang nas nga tshor 'brel yod yig cha mkho 'don rgyab skyor gnang bar thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/

dkar chag rtsom sgrig pa'i gtam/ ( 1 )de snga'i dzod sa gnas grid gzhung gi srid 'dzin sgrig gzhi/bshad sgra dga' ldan dpal 'byor dang / chab tshom 'chi med rgyal po/ sreg shing blo bzang don grub/ ( 1 )bod sa gnas srid gzhung rim byon gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ ( 1 )bka' shag sogs phyi nang las khungs khag gi sgrig gzhi'i gnas tshul mdo tsam bshad pa/ ( 16)spyi khyab bka' shag las khungs/ ( 16 )sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po/ ( 19)mdzod chung dang mdzod sbug ( 92 )gsol gzim mchod gsum/ ( 24)rtse yig tshang las khungs/ ( 25)rtse gzim chung 'gag ( 27 )'od 'gag ( 28 )'phral bde'am rtse phyag las khungs/ ( 29)gnyer tshang las khungs/ ( 32 )rtse rnam gan dngul skyed do dam/ ( 33 )rtse rig gnas slob grwa ( 33)bla phyag las khungs/ ( 34)bsher khang las khungs/ ( 42)rtsis khang las khungs/ ( 43)1

zhingasakhang las khungs/ ( 47)de snga'i bod dmag gi gnas tshul/ ( 48)lha sa gnyer tshang las khungs/ ( 55)snang rtse shag ( 66 )so nam las khungs/ ( 57 )ja 1 las khungs/ ( 68)lor khang las khungs/ ( 60 )zhol las khungs/ ( 60 )gor zhib las khungs/ ( 62 )tshe gling do dam las khungs/ ( 63 )lha sa sman rtsis khang / ( 63 )'bab zhib las khungs/ (64 )lam zhib las khungs/ ( 65)zhol 'dod dpal/ ( 65)zhol chibs rwa las khungs/ ( 66 )rtswa gnyer las khungs/ ( 66 )rtsam bzhes las khungs/ ( 67 )shing gnyer las khungs/ ( 69)zhabs 'phar las khungs/ (69)ya mon 'phrul bzo khang / ( 70 )zhol spros bzo khang / ( 70 )gser ṭam las khungs/ ( 71 )grwa bzhi glog 'phrul las khungs/ ( 71 )glog 'don khang / ( 72 )ar po'i las khungs/ ( 73)2

bde zhib las khungs/ ( 73)phyi rgyal las khungs/ ( 74)sbrag tar las khungs/ ( 76)rlung 'phrin las khungs/ ( 76 )'du 'god las khungs/ ( 76 )legs bcos las khungs/ ( 77)gyod zhib las khungs/ ( 78)gzhung 'bru spyi mdzod khang / ( 78)phyi'i spyi khyab khag ( 79)skor gsum spyi khyab/ ( 79)mon khul 'go 'dzin rta dbang bla gnyer/ (81 )nyag rong spyi khyab/ (82 )mdo smad spyi khyab/ ( 85)sde dge spyi khyab/ ( 86 )sog phogs khang / (86)hor spyi/ ( 87)rgyal rtse tshong spyi/ (88)gro spyi/ (89)gzhis rtse spyi rdzong / ( 90 )tārnya kha spyi khyab/ ( 90 )byang spyi/ ( 91 )dwags kong spyi khyab/ ( 91 )la stod spyi khyab/ ( 91 )phyogs mtha'i rdzong gzhis gras/ ( 92 )rdzong 'ge che gras/ ( 94)3

rdzong gzhis 'bring gras/ ( 97)rdzong gzhis chung gras/ ( 99)tshu sho khag (100)de snga'i bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i grid 'dzin sgrig gzhi'i sbyi'i gnas tshul/ sle zur 'jigs med dbang phyug dang bde zur rin chen dbang 'dus/ (102)rtse skor las khungs gras/ (105)yongs 'dzin sgang / (105)sku bcar gsol gzim mchod gsum/ (106)rtse gsol thab/ (106)gsol ba sgang / (107)na bza' sgang / (108)mchod dpon khang / (108)rtse gzim chung 'gag (109)bla sman pa/ (110)rtse mgon khang pa/ (111)rtse mdzod sbug (112)'phrul 'khor do dam las khungs/ (113)tshong don las khungs/ (114)rtse phyag las khungs/ (115)chibs dpon che mo/ (117)phebs byams 'go pa/ (118)gur pa/ (119)gar pa/ (120)bstan don las khungs/ (121)

spyi sa las khungs/ (121)gtong 'dzin las khungs/ (122)thebs sbyar las khungs/ (123)dkon gnyer che mo/ (124)par dpon/ (125)nyer brgyad sku mchod do dam pa/ (125)rtse 'grems pa/ (126)gdan gnyer/ (126)zhod skor las khungs gras/ 5 (127)srid 'dzin nang sgang u yon lhan khang / (127)nang sgang yig tshang / (129)bla brang phyag mdzod/ (130)zhod gsol thab/ (133)bla brang yig tshang / (134)gnyer tshang las khungs/sgyu (135)chibs ra las khungs/ (136)lhan bcar phyag mdzod/ (137)'bab gzhis las khungs/ (138)rkang rtsis sgang ngam 'tsho zhib las khungs/ (139)zhib khang las khungs/ (140)chadacirtsis las khungs/ (140)dmag phogs do dam pa/ (140)klu sding 'go pa/ (141)zhol rgan po/ (142)rtse sprob grwa (143)du

sku spung dmag sgar/ (143)nang sgang kha par spyi 'khor/ (145)shang spyi/ (145)yong sdud pa/ (145)bkar rgya ba/ (146)gser dpon/ (147)sa khul phyi phyogs su yod pa'i las khungs gras/ (148)lha sa nang sgang / (148)lha sa mi khang 'go pa/ (149)pe cin dang / zi ling / shis an bcas kyi so sor bca' sdod don gcod khru'u/ (150)phag ri'i mi ser 'go pa/ (151)yan steng 1 sho/ (151)'brel skyesdod gnas tshul gzhan dag ji (152)1 rtse spyi 'doms las khungs gsar btsugs gnang skor/ (152)kra gzhung bla'i dbar lo rgyus thog lus bsdad pa'i don gnad thag gcod byung skor/ (153)3 rdzong gzhis khag gcig gzhung 'dzin byas skor/ (155)4 nang sgang las byed sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa btsugs skor/ (166)5 bla brang phyag mdzod rim byung gi srid 'dzin lo tshigs/ (157)smo srid 'dzin nang sgang u yon lhan khang gi khongs mi/ (159)7 nang sgang u yon lhan khang gi las tham rtsis 'bul zhus pa'i skor/ (160)de snga'i sa skya'i sgrig gzhi/ lcam grwa nor bzang dang kun dga' chos bzang bcas/ (162)bdag chen nam khri chen/ (166)(blo

treg mdzod las khungs/ (170)gnyer tshang las khungs/ (178)sa skya'i mchod gzhis khag gi skor/ (181)sa dgon yod rigs la mkhan po sogs bla bskos gtong srol skor/ (183)chos de lho byang dang bla brang khang / (186)bdag chen khri 'don skor sogs 'brel yod 'ga' zhig (191)

de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid 'dzin sgrig gzhi/bshad sgra dga' ldan dpal 'byor dang / chab tshom 'chi med rgyal po/sreg shing blo bzang don grub/bod sa gnas srid gzhung rim byon gyi yo rgyus mdor bsdus/de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid 'dzin sgrig gzhi'i thog ma'i khrims rgyun dang / lam srol gyi 'byung khungs cung zad drangs te lo rgyus dpyad gzhi gang nges 'god rgyur/ de yang btsan po'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po nas rtsis pa'i dus rabs bdun pa'i nang rgyal rabs so gsum pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos bod chen po'i khyon yongs la chos srid yun du skyong ba'i cha rkyen med du mi rung ba lha chos dge ba bcu dang / mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug snying por bzhag pa'i sgrig gzhi khod chen po sum cu rtsa drug rgyal blon bka' gros zhib nan gyis gtan la phab pa der bka' gros chen po drug dang / yig tshangs drugabaka'i phyag rgya drug rkyen drug dpa' mtshan drug khrims yig drug bcas 1

yod/dang po bka' gros chen po drug ces pa'i nang gses/ rje'i sku srung zhing sri zhu sgrub pa dang gcig btsan po'i gnya' mnan cing 'bangs la rgyab rten bcol ba dang gnyis/ mo btsun khengs rgod du mi gtong zhing bka' la mi gdag pa dang gsum/ mtha' mtshams srung zhing 'bangs kyi tshal zhing la gnod pa mi byed pa dang bzhi/ dgra 'dul zhing 'bangs skyong ba dang lnga/ dge bcu sgrub cing mi dge bcu spongs ba dang drug yin/gnyis pa yig tshangs drug ni/ gzengs su bstod byed kyi yi ge yin pas rab la gser g.yu gnyis/ 'bring la dngul dang phra men/ mtha' ma zangs yig dang lcags yig bcas drug dang / de 'og shing skya chu ris te spyir btang gi snag yig bcas yin pa de dag gnang yul gung blon che 'bring chung gsum dang /nang blon che 'bring chung gsum/ bka'i yo ga 'chos pa'i bka' blon chen po bcas che dgur grags pa de dag dang / gzhan yang chos grwa'i slob dpon/sku'i sngags mkhan/ stod smad kyi dbang blon/ sku 'tsho ba'i bon po/ gzim mal brtsigs mkhan/ byang thang gi sa mkhan/ mtha'i so srung / sku mkhar gyi rtse srung /yab 'bangs rus drug stong dpon/ ru dpon/ g.yul du dpa' ba/ 'bangs mi phal pa bcas tsho khag nyer bdun so so'i go gnas la gzhigs te gong gsal ga ser dngul sogs kyi bris pa'i gzengs bstod kyi yi ge gnang ba'am/ byas rjes lo rgyus bkod de yig tshangs du 'jog nyar byed pa/gusum pa bka'i phyag rgya drug ni/ dngos pos yul so so'i mtshon byed kyi rtags mtshan zhig ste/ bka' yig gi phyag rgya mtshon byed sgrome bu'am yig snod/khrom rtags te dmag gi phyag rgya ru mtshon/ yul rtags phyag rgya sku mkhar/ chos rtags phyag rgya lha khang / dpa' rtags phyag rgya stag slog mdzangs rtags phyag 2

rgya yig tshangs/bzhi pa rkyen drug ni rang so so'i babs thob yong rkyen gyi rnam pa mngon byed cig yin pas dpa' bor gung dang stag gi gdan/ sdar mar wa zhwa/ ya rab kyi rkyen du lha chos/ g.yung po'i rkyen du thag dang bon/ mdzangs pa'i rkyen du yig changs/ ngan pa'i rkyen du rkun ma/lnga pa dpa' mtshan drug ni/ stag stod stag smad gnyis/ zer chen zer chung gnyis/ gam ras stag slog bcas/drug pa khrims yig drug ni/ dang po khri rtse 'bum bzher gyi khrims ni nang gses/ 1 bod kyi sa cha yongs rdzogs yul sde'i phyogs so so'i sa mtshams bcad de ru chen lnga la dbye ba'i lte ba lha sa ra mo che la byas pas dbu ru dang /yar lung khru 'brug la lte ba byas pa'i g.yo ru bcas dbus kyi sde/ gtsang gi g.yas ruri lte ba shangs kyi gzhong pa tshal dang / ru lag gi lte ba bred kyi ngur pa sna la byas pa g.yas ru dang / ru lag bcas gtsang gi sde/ lte ba rgya shod stag nga snul la byas pa yan lag gsum pa'i ru bcas bod khams kyi mnga' ris dbye mtshams dang rgya khyon gyi tshad gzhi bzos/ 'i yul gyi bdag dbang rnam pa bco brgyad du phye ba ni/ gong gsal sa khul chen po khag lngar dbye ba de'i thog nas rgyal po rang nyid dang / mnga' zhabs kyi blon po/ 'bangs mi/ khongs gtogs rgyal phran dang bcas la dbang ba'i sa cha so sor bcad yod pa red/ri rgyal khab —srung ba'i dmag dpung gi bca' gzhi rgod kyi stong sde drug cu rtsa gcig tu phye/ rgod ces pa ni drag dpon gyi bya ba'i sne mor 'khod pa'i dmag dpon gyi rim par zer zhing / rgod kyi stong sde ni dmag dpon so sos kha lo bsgyur b.ri dmag dpung yin pa de yang ru re la stong sde brgyad dang stong bu chung re/ sku srung gi stong sde re bcas dbu ru'i stong sde bcu dang / g.yo ru'i 3

stong sde bcu/ g.yas ru'i stong sde bcu/ ru lag gi stong sde bcu/ zhang zhung stod kyi stong sde lnga/ zhang zhung lte ba'i stong sde bcu/ sum khu/'i stong sde bcu gcig bcas stong sde drug cu re drug la dmag grangs drug khri drug stong yod/rdzi g.yung gi mi sde 'byed pa ni/ g.yung ngam kheng zhes 'bangs las byed kyi ming dang / yang kheng zhes bran g.yog dang nying g.yog yin zhing / de yang zhi ba'i las tshan gyi rnam grangs shig ste/ snub rje srid pa zhes sogs rje dgu lo ngam rta rdzi sogs rdzi bo bdun/ ga rod sga mkhan sogs mkhan drug rgya ja tshong pa sogs tshong pa lnga/ gdags sbra 'dzin gsum bcas de dag la bran g.yog dang /nying g.yog bcas so sor yod pas rang rang gi bgo skal gyi bya ba byed/ nam pa lde rgyal/ bal po li rgyal/ sum pa lcags rgyal/ mon pa rtse rgyal bcas phyogs kyi rgyal po bzhis bca' 'bul bas mnga' khongs rgyal phran du gtogs/ 5 zhang gsum blon bcas dbus kyi mdun sa 'dzin zhes pa ni/ stod na 'bro/ smad na mchims/ bar na sna nam bcas la zhang gsum du 'bod pa dang / blon chen sbas bcas kyis nang gi bya ba byed cing / blon bcas zhes pa'i gras su yul gyi khrims dpon/ dmag gi spyi khyab/ chibs dpon/ rngan dpon zhes 'bru dang gser dngul gyi gnyer kha byed mi/ phru dpon zhes 'bri mdzo phru ma'i bdag gnyer/ drang dpon te zhal lce gcod pa bcas la dpon bdun zer/ sto dpa' ba'i sde gsum ni/ 'bre/ khyung / mgar/ snub/ gnyan bcas la gug cog sde lngar 'bod pas gru gu btul/ bar gyi dpa' sde ni/ sbas rgya sde bcu gnyis kyi dpon nag shod kyis byas te ljang btul/ smad kyi dpa' sde ni/ mthong khyab srid sde dgu dang / 'a zha stong sde drug gnas pa la stong stong gi bu phyug mtshams kyis dpon byas te rgol bas rgya btul bas de dag la dpa' sde gsum zhes grags pas mtha' yi so kha srung ba'i las 'gan 'khur/ phrostodze

khrims yig drug gi gnyis pa 'bum gsir thog sha ba can gyi khrims ni/bri/ srang / phul/ khyor’ tho/ se sran sogs kyi dbye bas 'degs gshor tshad gzhi gtan la phab/ gsum pa rgyal khams dpe blangs kyi khrims ni/ dgra 'dul ba dang / rgyal khams bde bar mdzad pa/ nang gi chol mdzad 'bangs 'khor skyong ba/ dam chos bya ba/ sgod min la chos mi shod pa/ nor phyir chos mi tshong ba/ ngan par dbang mi sprod pa/ dpa' bor bstod pa/ mdzangs la gzengs bstod/ legs la bya dga'/ sdar mar dmad pa/ ngan par chad gcod/ pha ma mi mnar ba/ bu tsha mi mnar ba/ bza' grogs mi mnar ba bcas khrims srol bco lngar grags pa dang / mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug mi dge bcu sprongs dge bcu'i khrims la gnas/ de yang srog mi gcod pa'i khrims gshin stong dang /gson stong / rkus par 'jal/ log par mi g.yem pa'i khrims smad 'jal dang byi chad/ brdzun spongs ba'i khrims mna' sgog pa/ chang la tshod zin pa/ kheng mi ldog pa/ bang so mi 'dru ba/ bzhi pa mdo lon zhu bcad kyi khrims ni/ kha drag zhan gnyis rtsod na kha drag pa mi skyengs shing / zhan pa yi mi chad pa'i thabs kyi thag gcod pa/ lnga pa/ dbang chen bcad kyi spyi khrims ni/ gnyis kas lan la chad pa gnyis mnyam du bcad de 'dum pa'i thabal rgyal po me long gdong gi zhal lce/ drug pa/ khab so nang pa'i khrims ni/ gnyis ka bden na gnyis bden dang / dga' gsum du thag bcad pa'i dge slong rig gnyis pa'i dpe bcas drug tshan drug yod par khod chen po sum cu so drug tu 'bod pa gsar gtod kyi phyag bzhes su bstar nas rgyal khams bskyangs shing / chab 'bangs 'phral yun bde skyid kyi dpal la bkod pa sogs lo rgyus mdzad rjes kyi ri mo mi nyams gsal bar gnas pa ltar dang / de rjes dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang rgyal rabs so brgyad pa chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi sku dus mes srong bya

btsan dus kyi srid skyong sgrig gzhi rgyun mthud thog mkhan slob chos gsu/ma zhal 'dzoms te bsam kya sa gtsug lag khang so/kas bathe/ngas pa dang / mdo smad ji /na chad du bshad grwa sgam grwa so/gas dge 'dun gyi sde mang po btsugs shing / rgya gar du sgra dang lo tsā slo/ba par btang ba'i lo chen be+e ro tsa na sogs lo tsā ba rnams dang / rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta rnams/ kyis sde snod gsu/ma sogs chos dpe mang po bod skad du bsgyur/ lha khang gi mchod rgyun dang /dge 'dun so sor chos 'bangs khyim dud bstsal thog rgyal mdzod nas lo rer 'bru mar dang / na bza'/ snag shog sogs dgos mkho bstsal zhing / chos bdag mkhan por gser yig chen po'i go gnas dang / blon chen tshang ma'i gral 'gor sdod rgyu/ blon chen gyi gros tshogs chung bar zhugs chog pa bcas kyi thob dbang bstsal te chos lugs mi snas srid gros su zhugs pa'i lam srol thog ma chags/ rgyal po 'di mnga' thang shin tu che bar grags shing dus rabs dgu par rgyal rabs zhe gcig pa chos rgyal khri ral pa can gyi dus su rgya gar gyi pan+ḍi ta du ma dang / lo tsā ba ska cog sogs gdan 'dzoms par byas te/ sngar 3/ba mes kyi ring la myo/do rgyud kyi chos pha'/ cher bod yig tu bsgyur zin na'ang da dung bsgyur ma thub pa 'ga' zhig rang skad du lus pa rnams dang / brda rnying sogs go mi bde ba rnams bod skad la don bsgyur gtso bor byas te skad gsar bcad kyis dag ther mdzad/ yab mes gong ma'i khrims srol rgyun bskyangs thog khri rtse 'bum bzher gyi khrims dang / 'bum gser thog sha ba can gyi khrims/ rgyal khams dpe blangs kyi khrims/ mdo lon zhu bcad kyi khrims/ dkon mchog gi chos khrims/ jo mo mngarme bdag gi khrims dang drug tu phye ste bar skabs nyams lad du gyur rigs dag ther mdzad de dril bsgrags/ gzhan yang sman gyi bcos lugs bzhi/ dpyad mkhan gyi gab rtse lnga/ ya rabs kyi rkyen bdun/ mdzad 6

pa'i mig bcu gnyis/ pho ltang gi nyer brgyad/ mo ltang gi bcu gnyis/ phyag rgya drug rgyal po'i gdan bzhi/ blon po'i gral brgyad/ phyag rka rtsa bu brgyad/mjo' bzhi sogs bod 'bangs kyi gtam dang yig tshang du grags pa'i nang nas phyag len du bzhes 'os pa rnams bzhes te rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/ 'di dus rgya bod gnyis ma mthun pa'i g.yul 'khrug rim par byung ba rnams mthar 'dum ste sa mtshams dang lha sar dbon zhang rdo ring khag gsum btsugs te bod rgya gnyis mthun zhing 'brel ba legs pas gnam la nyi zla zung gcig dang /sa la btsan po dbon zhang zhes kun tu grags/ rgyal po de chos la ha cang dad pas yab mes kyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang nyams gso dang / gsar du 'u shang gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rab byung rer chos 'bangs mi khyim bdun re phul ba sogs bkur bzos bdag rkyen tshad med mdzad pa bcas srong btsan sgam po dang / khri srong lde btsan/ khri ral pa bcas la chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum zhes btsan po'i gdung rabs kyi khrod nas mnga' thang snyan grags dang / chos srid kyi mdzad pa phul phyin du brtsis nas/ de rnams kyi bzhed srol la dge bcu'i bka' khrims zhes bod kyi sa gnas dbang 'dzin rim pas rgyun mthud phyag bzhes bstar rgyu'i gzhi 'dzin sa yin/de rjes dus rabs bcu pa'i nang rgyal rabs zhe gnyis pa glang dar bkrongs rjes 'bangs gyen log rim par byung ba'i rgyu rkyen 'og btsan po'i gdung brgyud kyis dbang bsgyur ba'i mjug bsgril te lo ngo sum brgya dgu bcu lhag tsam gyi ring bod 'di nyid nang khul tshan khag bcu gcig gi dum bur bcad bzung byas te dbang bsgyur ba'i dus skabs der bod kyi chos lugs tshogs pa khag dang / chab srid kyi stobs shugs phyogs khag rnams mi mthun pa'i go skabs dang bskrun nas mong gol jing gir han gyis rab byung gsum pa'i la stag — 7

(1206)lor bod du dmag dpung gtos che btang 'byor phyung ba dang / de rjes sa skya'i cho sa lugs tshogs pa dang jing gir han gyi rgyal brgyud dbar rim bzhin 'brel ba byung ste rab byung bzhi pa'i chu glang(1253)lor se chen han gyis bod du dmag dpung btang nas bod yongs gcig gyur bzos thog hor khrims rtsa 'dzin du bgyis pa'i bod khri skor 1ridu bgos te 'gro mgon chos 'phags la khri skor 1rngi dang chol kha gsum rim bzhin phul/ 'ja' sa tham gcibastsal/ de'i skabs kyi srid 'dzin sgrig gzhi ni spyi khyab dpon chen gcig dang /khri skor so sor khri dpon/ stong dpon/ brgya dpon/ rdzong dpon/ gzhis gnyer bcas dang / nang gi las tshan bcu gsum ste/ gsol gzim mchod gsum/ mjal(mgron gnyer)yig mdzod gsum/ thab 'dren gdan gsum (gsol thab pa/ 'dren chas pa/ gdan gnyer)skya rta mdzo khyi bzhi(chibs rag skabs kyi skya dar ba dang / rta dpon/ phyugs gnyer/ khyi srung sgo ra ba)bcas la chen por 'os pa'i las tshan bcu gsum du grags/ rab byung lnga pa'i chu sprel(1272)lor yon gong mas bod du thu po shon phus si tu hra'o phu'u zhes pa'i srid 'dzin do dam las khungs btsugs/ bod 'di yon gong ma'i mnga' khongs kyi cha shas su gyur/ srid don gal che ba blos ma 'khyud pa rigs sa skya bdag chen nam khri par dgongs skor zhu dgos pa las de min spyi khyab dpon chen gyis thag gcod byed pa dang / dpon chen gyi go gnas bsko 'then sogs don 'gangs che rigs yon gong mar snyan 'bul zhu dgos shing / 'gro mgon chos 'phags nas tā dben blo gros rgyal mtshan bar khri thog dgu dang / dpon chen shākya bzang po nas dbang brtson bar dpon rabs nyi shu skor gyis rab byung bzhi pa'i shing glang (1264)lo nas rab byung drug pa'i shing rta(1354)lo bar bod yongs la dbang bsgyur/ lha

— dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang sa skya'i gdung brgyud nang khu spru 'gal ba je cher song rkyen sa skyari srid dbang phag mo gru par shor te rab byung drug pa'i sa glang(1349)lo nas bzung phag gru byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bod spyi la dbang bsgyur/ yon gong mas ta'i si tu'i go gnas bstsal/ sa skya'i dus su sngar gyi dge bcu'i bka' khrims la hor khrims kyi shan shor ba'i he bag la brten chos rgyal mes dbon dus kyi khrims lugs 'di nyid gtso bor bzung thog tshal pa khri dpon dus kyi khrims srol legs cha dang / 5log dus gnas skabs la gzhigs pa'i sdon 'phri dang bcas khrims yig zhal lce bco lnga gtan la phab pa ni/ dpa' bo stag gi zhal lce/ sdar ma wa'i zhal lce/ sne mo las 'dzin gyi zhal lce/ zhu bzhes bden rdzun gyi zhal lce/ bzung bkyig khrims ra'i zhal lce/ nag can khrug sbyor gyi zhal lce/ dran 'dzin chad las kyi zhal lce/ hor 'dra za rkang gi zhal lce/ bsad pa stong gi zhal lce/ rmas pa khrug gi zhal lce/ bston ham mna' dag gi zhal lce/ rkus pa 'jal gyi zhal lce/ nye 'brel bral 'dum gyi zhal lce/byi byas byi rin gyi zhal lce/ nam phar tshur gyi zhal lce bcas kyi khrims srol la brten nas rgyal khams bde bar bkod/ gong dkar/ brag dkar sne'u/ 'ol kha/ gabyus rtse/ lhun rtse/ rin spungs/ 'phyongs rgyas/ gri gu la sogs rdzong chen bcu gsum brtsigs/ rgya khyab rdzong gzhis so sor gnyer sdod lo gsum res 'khor gyis bsko rdzongs byas/ rtsed thang du bshad grwa btsugs pa sogs chos phyogs spu mdzad rgya che/ rlangs kyi gdung brgyud thog ma phag gru byang chub rgyal mtshan/ gnyis pa shākya rgyal mtshan(yon gong mas go shri'i cho lo dang tham ka bstsal)/gsum pa grags pa byang chub/ bzhi pa bsod nams grags pa/ lnga pa shākya rin chen(ming gong mas tho gan thi mur gyi lung gnang)/ drug pa grags pa rgyal mtshan (ming gong mas gser lham dang / she bam/ wang gi 'ang gnang)/ bdun lha0

grags pa 'byung gnas/ brgyad pa kun dga' legs pa(ming gong mas zheri/nga ḍa// 'ja' sa gnang)/ dgu pa ngag gi dbang po/ bcu pa ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa(ming gong mas wang gi 'ja' la gnang)/ bcu gcig rnga/ ngag dbang grags pa bcas gdung rabs bcu gcig gis lo sum brgya skor bod chol khartegasum la dbang bsgyur ba'i rjes su/ sne'u gdong pa'i blon po rin spungs pa nor bu bzang pos snga rjes sa gnas rim bzung gis sne'u gdong pa'i mnga' thang nyams nas rin spungal pas srid dbang 'dzin skabs rin spungs pa'i nang 'khor zhing shag tshe brtan rdo rjes rje bor gyen log gyis rdzong dang sa khul mang po bcad bzung byas te rten gzhi btsugs thog karma bstan spung dbang po sogs kho pa'i bu gsum gyis rim bzhin dbus gtsang du mnga' khongs rgya bskyed byas pa dang /'di gsum gyi bu karma phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis bod yongs la dbang bsgyur byas/ de'i bu karma bstan skyong dbang pos srid dbang rgyun bskyangs thog phag gru'i khrims yig zhal lce bco lnga'i thog kla klo mtha' 'khob kyi zhal lce bsnan te khrims yig zhal lce bcu drug rtsa 'dzin du byas pa'i gleng gzhir gtsang pa rgyal po mi rabs kyi byas rjes dang che brjod 'go rgyan du bkod yod/ gong gsal sa skya dang / phag gru/ rin spungs/ gtsang pa sogs rgyal rabs 'pho len byed skabs gtso bo drag dpung la brten pa bzhin gtsang pa'i rgyal thog bzhis srid dbang lo bdun cu lhag tsam bzung ring chos lugs grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin gyi dge bstan la dngos shugs su sdang zug yod par brten phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan dang skyid shod sde pa gnyis nas bod kyi gnas babs skor gu shrī han la yi ge btang / de'i phyi lo gu shrī han ngo 'khor nyung bsdus tshong pa'i chas spras te dbus gtsang du rtog zhib byed par 'ongs nas tā la'i bla ma lnga pa dang / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyal mjal kha zhus/ tā la'i bla mas gu shrī kā0

han la bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po zhes mtshan bstod gnang ste phyir log de rjes gu shrī han gyi dmag dpung gis chog thu rgyal po'i dpung dmag rtsa med btang thog be ri rgyal por dmag drangs te sde dge dang d+dha/ra khams sogs mnga' 'ogre tu bsdus thog sog dmag bod du shar bskyod byas te sde pa skyid shod pa'i ngamag dpung dang mnyam sbrel gyi gtsang du dpung bskyod kyis karma ma bstan skyong dbang po'i rjes 'brang dang bcas pa tshar bcad de gyen log zhod 'jags su btang ba dang / rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta(1642)lo gu shrī han gyis bod khri skor bcu— gsum gyi srid dbang dang gtsang pa rgyal po'i rin bral dngos nor bcas tā la'i bla ma lnga pa chen por phul ba de nas bzung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i chos srid zung sbrel gyi srid dbang dbu brnyes/ de yang dga' ldaca pho brang zhes ming gi 'byung stangs ni sngar sde srid phag gru 'bras spungs su phebs skabs kyi bzhugs yul rdo khang sngon po zhes pa de sne gdong gong ma ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis rgyal dbang sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtshor phul zhing / rgyal mchog gang nyid kyis skal ba dang ldan pa rnams dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang du 'dren pa'i rten 'brel gyi slad du dga' ldan pho brang zhes 'dogs pa gnang / de rjes rgyal dbang sku phreng bzhi pa bar gyi bzhugs gnas yin la tā la'i lnga pa chen po yang der bzhugs par brten srid gzhung gi ming yang dga' ldan pho brang zhes btags pa dang / tā la'i lnga pa chen pos phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel la lung bsgyur tham ka bcas sde srid bsko bzhag bstsal/ gtsang pa'i dus kyi khrims yig zhal lce bcu drug nas dpa' bo stag dang / sdar ma wa/ kla klo mtha' 'khob kyi zhal lce dor bas zhal lce bcu gsum gtan la phab cing / khrims yig gi che brjod lo rgyus sogs/ dus bstun bskyur bcos gnang ba dang / sde srid bsod nams chos 'phel nas chu 11

lug(1643)lo khrims yig zhal lce bcu gsum gyi rgyab gnon rtsa 'dzin she bam che mo zhes gtan 'bebs khyab bsgrags kyang gnang yod/ sde srid 'dis srid lo bcu bdun bskyangs te sku gshegs/ de rjes tā la'i bla mas srid dbang lo gnyis bzhes rjes grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang / blo bzang mthu stobs/ blo bzang sbyin pa bcas so sor sde srid bsko bzhag bstsal bas khri lo sum cu so drug song /sa lug(1679)lo tā la'i bla mas grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshor sde srid bsko bzhag bstsal te lo nyer drug ring srid bskyangs/ sde srid 'dir sde srid gong ma gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i gzengs bstod bla lhag tu mdzad skor rtse bde shar gsum skas 'gor rtsa tshig phyag par ma da lta yang mjal rgyu yod/lcags bya(1681)lo tā la'i bla ma lnga pa chen pos dga' ldan tshe dbang dpung bcas mngags te/ la dwags rgyal po seng ge rab brtan stos bcas cham la phab ste stod mnga' ris skor gsum dbang du 'dus/ mnga' ris dang lho mon sogs sa mtshams khag la srid 'dzin sgrig gzhi btsugs/ dar rtse mdo sogs 'bri chu shar brgyud kyi sa gnas khag la sa mi zhib gcod dang sgo khru them gzhung gsar du bkod/ de rjes rdzong gzhis khag gi sa ming dang / thon khungs/khrul 'bab bcas gtan 'bebs kyis 'bab deb spug dam 'byar ma khag lnga bcu nga drug bathos/ gzhan yang ris med dgon khag gi chos khrims bca' yig dang / sa khang mi gsum gyi bdag thob gtan tshig dgon khag gi grwa khrul bsdu lam/ srid gzhung nas 'bru phogs dang / rgyun ja gtong rgyu'i lam srol sogs gtan 'bebs mdzad/sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos sa skya'i dus kyi las tshan bcu gsum nas mchod dpon sogs khag gsum phud thog gsar du las tshan rnam grangs kha snon 12

mjad pa'i dang po srid skyong gi byed sgo dang / de nas bka' blon/ dmag dpon/ cul lce gcod pa/ batho rigs do dam/ gnyer pa'i rigs che phra/sdom gcod pa/ mi dpon/ phyogs mtha'i rdzong gzhis/ grwa tshang khag gi gnyer pa/tshong dpon/ rda ro kha'i 'go pa/ dkon gnyer/ gser yig pa/ bkar rgya yong sdud la sogs pa phyi nang las tshan gyi spangs blangs byed sgo'i rim pa dwangs shel nyer gcig zhes pa dang / 'bras ljongs bstan srung rnam rgyal gyis sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshor khrims lugs skor dogs sel zhus pa'i 'dri ba dri lan/khrims gcod las khungs khag nas khrims yig nang gsal nyes 'bab 'jal sprod bde ched stong srang 'brur bkug zho 'bebs kyis 'jal dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs bcas mdzad yod/chu khyi(1682)lo tā la'i lnga pa chen po dgongs pa rdzogs rjes lo bco lnga gsang rgya mdzad ring gser sdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig rten dang brten pa legs grub thog rtse pho brang dmar po le lag dang bcas pa gsar bskrun/ lnga pa'i dgongs rdzogs tshogs mchod chen mo dang rjes 'brel mchod sprin ser sbreng gi srol btsugs/ —me glang(1697)lo tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho po ta la'i gser khrir mnga' gsol skabs der sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang / gu shrī sras brgyud lha bzang khang 'gal zlar gyur te lha bzang khang nas srid dbang lo 1ri bzung ring tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho tā la'i khri las phab ste gong ma'i mi sna'i gdong pe cin du phebs dgos byung ba'i lam bar sku gsheṭa tshul bstan sta'i lo rgyus kyang yod/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho sku 'phum nas gdan drangs te po ta lar khri gsol zhus/ skabs der bod ljongs tshogs 'dus srid 18

dbang lo gcig bzung rjes da'i ching sba dur gyis gtso bo byas pa'i nga lum sbyar gsum dang / pho lha ba bcas nas bka' blon gyi 'gan 'khur srid dbang bzung rjes/ me lug(1727)lo bka' blon rnams dbus gtsang phyogs 'then nang 'khrug byung rjes pho lha bar gong mas jun wang gi cho lo tham ka bcas bstsal nas srid lo lnga0ring bskyangs te 'das/pho lha ba'i bu 'gyur med rnam rgyal la jun wang gi go thob dang bcas pha shul bu 'dzin gyi srid dbang lo bzhi bzung ring khrims 'gal gyi bya ba byas rkyen am ban gnyis nas 'gyur med rnam rgyal bsad pa dang / 'gyur med rnam rgyal phyogs gtogs nas 'khon lan gyis am ban gnyis bsad pa sogs nang 'khrug rgya che langs stabs/ tā la'i bla mas snying 'jags yong thabs thugs 'khur che bzhes la brten dus bde zhod 'jags byung ba dang / lcags lug(1751)lo tā la'i bla skya/ sku phreng bdun pas lugs gnyis thugs 'gan bzhes/ bka' blon gung rdo ring paṇ+ḍi ta mgon po dngos grub dang / mdo mkhar tshe ring dbang rgyal/ thon pa sri gcod tshe brtan/ ser mo ba rtse mgron nyi ma rgyal mtshan bcas la bsko bzhag thog bka' shag tshugs yul gtan 'khel dang / tā la'i bla mas thugs smon dang bcas lung sgyur rgya tham bde skyid ma/ sel tham/rtags tham bcas bstsal thog phyi nang bstan srid yongs la dbang sgyur chog pa'i lung lag gi gzengs bstod mdzad/ bka' shag gi zhib cha'i 'gan dbang dang las bya drung mgron 'gag pa bcas kyi go rim gsham du gsal/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pas lcags lug nas/ me glang bar lo brgyad lugs gnyis thugs 'gan bzhes te sku gshegs/ 'di nas bzung tā la'i sku phreng lnga pa dang / bdun pa gnyis kyi mdzad lam ltar tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim pa dadza / srid skyong rim pas lugs gnyis chab srid bskyang srol ltar/14

tā la'i bdun pa sku gshegs rjes srid skyong thog ma bstan gling de mo 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtshos lo nyi shu rtsa gcig tshe gling ngag dbang tshul khrims kyis lo sacu/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pas lo brto brgyad/ kun gling stag tshag bstan pa'i mgon pos lo bdun/ de mo 'jigs med rgya mtshos lo dgu/tshe smon gling 'jam dpal tshul khrims kyis lo nyer drug paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi mas zla ba dgu/ rwa sgeng ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims kyis lo bcu gcig tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gcig pas zla shas ring thugs 'gan bzhes te sku gshegs rjes slar yang rwa smreng ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims kyis lo bdun/sde srid bshad sgra dbang phyug rgyal pos lo gsum/ sde drug mkhyen rab dbang phyug gis lo dag tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gnyis pas lo gsum/ stag tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan gyis lo bcu gnyis/ de mo 'phrin las rab rgyas kyis lo dgude nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas lugs gnyis thugs 'gan bzhes te lo bcu song mtshams dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa'i dmag dpung lhags 'byor la brten sku 'khor hrag bsdus rgya sog yul grur chibs bsgyur gnang ring la mo shar blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis lo gsum/ la shar dang / srid blon bshad zhol chang gsum mnyam sbrel gyis lo gsum/ sa bya lo 'jug tu tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa bod du zhabs sor 'khod cing / lcags khyi lo 'gor lu'u cun rgya dmag bod 'byor gyis rkyen pas tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor nyung bsdus rgya gar du nyen g.yol chibs bsgyur gnang ring dga' ldan khri pa tshe smon gling blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nas lo gnyis/ chu byi lo tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa bod du zhabs sor 'khod rjes slar yang lo nyer gnyis/ rwa smreng 'jam dpal ye shes dang / srid blon glang mdun mnyam sbrel gyis lo drug rwa sgreng sku rkyang gis lo gnyis/ stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab kyis lo bcu/ tā 1bya

la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pas lo bcu(blo bzang bkra skes dang bde mkhar ba gnyis kyis lha sa'i srid blon las tshab lo gnyis)bcas de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid dbang dbu brnyes tshul dang / dbang sgyur lced tshul lo rgyus mdor bsdus de ltar dang / gsham du phyi nang las khungs tsā/ ga gi sgrig gzhi'i gnas tshul rim par byas nas mdo tsam 'god rgyu 'di lta ste/bka' shag sogs phyi nang las /ghungs khag gi sgrig gzhi'i gnas tshul mdo tsam bshadacepa/spyi khrab bka' shag las ku/ ngas/spyi khyab bka' shag las khungs ni thog mar bka' blon zhes pa las bka' shag las khungs med cing / ra ba byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags— rta (1750)lor wang 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi don rkyen byung ba'i phyi lo der tā la'i bla ma bskal bzang rgya mtshos lugs zung gi thugs 'gan bzhes te gong ma chan lung la snyan seng dang 'brel spyi khyab las khungs bka' shag dngol su gsar 'dzugs bskyangs shing / skabs der bka' blon rdo ring paṇa ḍi ta mgon po dngos grub rab brtan dang / mdo mkhar zhabs brung tshe ring dbang rgyal/ thon pa sri chod tshe brtan/ rtse mgron dar han nyi ma rgyal po bcas bzhi bsko bzhag dang 'brel bka' shag gsar tshugs nyin tā la'i bla ma mchog kyang ched phebs kyis thugs smon gnang thog bka' shag gi tham ka‘‘srid zhi bde skyid’’ces pa gsar skrun byas yod pa de nyid phab rgyag dbang bsgyur byas chog pa'i gzengs bstod kyang mdzad/ spyi khyab las khungs bka' shag la bod sa gnas srid gzhung 1snye

gi chab sgring dang / dopol 'byor rig gnos/ dmag rdon bcas phyi nodzi garnga ci'i 'ab/na dbang cha tshang yod pa dang / 'on kyang des srid rdon gal che'i riṭa dang / phyi nang las tshan mi sna bsko 'then so gas tā la'i bla mar 'char 'bul phyag rtags zhu dgos pa dang / gsham 'og las khungs che 'bring chung gsum dang / spyi khyab khag rdzong gzhis che chung khag bcas kyi 'char can bsdu gtong dang / spyir btang khrims 'doms byed sgo chung rtsag so so'i dbang tshad la gzhiṭa pas do dam mi sna gros bsdur gyis las tham phab ste thag gcod byed dgos pa phud/ de min phyi nang mi sna bsko 'then dang / rdos rta lam yig mi bsad rku 'phrog gyod gzhi 'khrun gcod ma thub pa'i rigs/ 'bru dngul gtong gron/phyag rdzas 'du 'god/ 'dzugs skrun rnam grangs/ dus bstun gsar gtod kyi rigs sogs mdor na srid gzhung de'i phyi nang zhi drag gi las don gang ci spyi khyab bka' shag la snyan zhus chog mchan dang ma 'brel bar thag gcod mi chog sa mtshams dang / dmag don sogs gnad don gal che'i rigs bka' shag dang / spyi mkhan(spyi khyab mkhan po ste rtse skor gyi 'go 'doms sa dbang dang gdan thob 'dra ba zhig)lhan rgyas bka' bsdur thog drung rtsis brgyad sbrel la gros babyi ra byas bcug ste thag gcod thub na dang / de min bod ljongs tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa ste/ gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po las sne/ dza tha'i(dza sag dang tha'i ji)'thus mi drung rtsis brgyad/ dmag spyi/ rtse mkhan mgron che ba/ sne mgron ma khan chung / sku srung mda' dpon/ rtse shod las tshan dang drung dkyus 'thus mi bcas kyi tshogs 'du dang / yang na bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas pa zhes gzhung zhajisnas ser skya yongs rdzogs dang / lha sdod bkras lhun bla brang gi mi ser 'go nga// dmag sgar khag gi ru brgya sding gsum/ rtse shod phyag nang sogs sto zan yan gyi mi sna/ gdan sa khag gi bla ma las sne che chung / khang tshan dge rgan 17

zhes pa grwa dmangs 'thus mi/ dbus gtsang tsho chen/ mdo smad khul gyi spri 'thus rmar mdzo gsang gsum gyi mi ser 'go pa/ gzhung sog 'thus mi bcas rgyas 'dzoms thog nas gros bsdur 'char 'god kyis tā la'i bla mar chog mchan zhu dgos pa sogs red/bka' blon bzhi'i 'og tu bka' shag steng shod gnyis yod pa'i steng la mgron drung khang zhes pa bka' drung gnyis dang / bka' mgron gsum las grub cing / bka' drung gis gong gsal bka' shag gi 'gan dbang dang 'brel ba'i las don skor gyi yig 'bri dang 'char zin 'bri 'god sogs bka' blon gyi ngag bkod ltar bgyid dgos pa dang / bka' dam phab rgyag baye /ga che/nyer byed dgos/bka' mgron gyis las tshan pa yan gyi dpon rigs phyogs 'gro'i skabs thon phyag dang phyir log skabs 'byor phyag gi snyan seng dang 'brel mgron deb thog gnangs brda gtong rgyu'i tho 'god byed dgos pa dang / rdzong dang gzhis sdod kyi mi 'gro shod drung dkyus ma 'byor thon skabs bka' blon gyi bka' mngags bzhin bka' shag 'gag tu byed sgo'i bka' sgyur gtong dgos pa/bka' shag tu yig ngag gang rung nas snyan 'bul byung rigs 'gag nas blangs nyan gyis bka' blon rnam par snyan seng zhu dgos/ gzhan yang bka' blon rnams kyis nyin re las don ji mjad mgron deb tu 'god dgos pa/ tā la'i bla ma mchog la bka' shag nas yig thog snyan zhur 'bul dgos rigs dkar chag bkod de rtse 'gag tu mgron cher 'bul dgos pa sogs byed dgos/de min bka' blon so sor 'gag pa re 'khrid rgyu yod pa de dag gis bka' blon rnamyoges phebs bsu skyel nyen srung dang / bka' 'gag tu sgrig lam gnon 'doms/ bka' shag ma chen gyis gsol ja 'degs skabs 'gag pas 18

bka' blon gyi mchod zhal bzed de 'bul ba sogs zhabs zhu'i byed sgo rnams sgrub dgos/ snye ngaka' shag shod ces par shod skor rim pa bdun pa'i las tshan pa drung yig chung ba gsum yod/ de dag gi las 'gan ni rta khal lam yig thong 'dzin sgyur rgyu dang / rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khongs kyi gzhung dgon khag la nyi sdog zhabs rim sgrub rgyu'i dpyad phra gtong rgyu/ dgyes ston khag gi sder gzhung sder yigachibs rags gral tho/ mchod 'bul lag deb sgyur rgyu/ rdzong gzhis 'pho len gyi sprod rgya lam yig khag bka' shag brgyud rtse shod du snyan zhur gtong rgyu/ bka' shag gi sku tshab rtsag rtsig dper na dbu gur 'don 'jug 'u shang lha khang gi mchod 'bul dang sad srung char 'beb(lha khul nye 'khor du) khag la bskor g.yeng sogs gzhan yang 〈ga'u li〉nang gsal byed sgo khag byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ de min bka' shag gi las don mi sna'i khongs bod rgya'i yig sgyur ba gcig dang / 'bras spungs spyi sos 'dzugs gtong byed dgos pa'i bka' shag khang gnyer thes pa zhig kyang yod pa bcas/sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po/sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po zhes pa ni tā la'i bla ma'i sku'i gam bcar rtse skor rim pa gsum pa'i sku ngo'i gdan thob yod pa zhig yin zhing / de ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku dus su gsar du bsko bsgag gnang ba nas bzung byung ba zhig red/ de'i gtso bo'i las 'gan ni tā la'i bla ma'i gam bcar sku'i rim gro ba yongs kyi spyi khyab 'go 'dzin thog rnam kun mnyes pa gsum gyi sri zhu sti stangs zhu dgos la chab srid 'phrin las 19

kyi zhabs zhu'i thad la'ang phyi nang mchog dman bar gsum nas tā la'i bla ma mchog gi mtshan 'khod snyan zhu 'bul 'byor rigs spyi mkhan brgyud 'bul dgos pa dang / ‘‘gong (gong sa tā la'i bla ma)srid bka' shag’’bcas pa'i mtshan 'khod snyan zhu srid bka' brgyud rtse 'gag tu 'bul 'byor rigs spyi mkhan nas tā la'i bla ma'i mdzad seng go rim dang bstun zhabs bskul zhu dgos/ skabs 'gar gzhung don gal che'i skor srid bka' dang bcas spug tu snyan zhur ngo bcar dgos pa'ang yod/ rnam kun chab srid kyi las don gang ci'i thad la bka' blon dang dbang cha 'dra mnyam yin pas zhi drag las don gal che'i skabs su bka' shag dang go bsdur gnang dgos pa dang / rtse skor ser mo ba dang / bod ljongs ris med gzhung dgon yongs kyi spyi khyab rtse yig tshang las khungs nang spyi mkhan gyi las gdan yod mus thog rnam kun dgon sde khag gi las don che khag dang / mkhan po/ zhal gzim(zhal ngo dang se ra gzim khang sde pa)sogs las sne che gras/ rtse skor khongs gtogs dang bcas pa'i las tshan bsko 'then sogs gong ci'i 'gan dbang yod pa red/ gzhan yang rtse rnam sras gan mdzod ces de snga tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim pa'i skabs lo ltar gser dngul gos dar ja bcas bkar 'jug zhu dgos pa'i mdzod khang de'i 'don 'jug gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur spyi mkhan dang / bka' shag thun mong nas byas te lo ltar zla 1shrīpa'i nang sngar lam bkar 'jug zhu dgos gras/ zhol gnyer/bsher dpang / snang shag gnyer tshang las khungs kyis mtshon las khungs khag dang / dkon gnyer dpon bcas nas lo ltar sgrig 'bul zhu dgos khongs snang che'i gser dngul gos dar/ mtha' dbus dad 'dus kha ga nas skyabs mgon rtse shod gnyis la dad mjal 'bul rten khongs nas rtse shod phyag mdzod gnyis la sngar lam gyi 'bab sgo khag phud/ de 'phros gser dngul gos dar gang yod 20

dang / gzhung gnas nas lo gnangs chags su rtse shod phya ga mdzod gnyis kyi 'bab khongs nas snam rigs/ sman rigs/ spos sogs smad mkho'i dngos riṭa bskur nas gzhung drel lag do dang dos rta lam yig bcas ja dar sogs mkho sgrub byed po‘‘mdo sgar dpon’’zhes rtse phyag nang zhig ched bskos kyis gtong lam bzhin rtse ja dang / dar gos rgya dngul sogs mdo zog 'byor rigs nas thuṭa mkho phud/ de byings ja dar/ rgya dngul/ gzhan yang mkhan khongs gzhung khang khag gi khang gla dngul ṭam dkar dang / rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing stag (1914)lo ya mon 'phrul batho khang / gro stod nor bu mtsho skyid nas zangs ṭam/ rjes su lor khang bcas nas ṭam dkar dang / pad shag shog lor bcas par 'grems gnang ba'i ma 'jog gam/ bar khe lta bur lo ltar gser dngul/ ṭam dkar phon che/ sa rta(1918)lor nor thod gser ṭam las khungs btsugs pa nas gser ṭam par rgyag gi gser ṭam rer pad lor srang nyi shu re rtsis khrom ra gang sar sprod len byed pa'i dza thang bar khyad gzhung khe lta bur lo ltar rgya dngul sa phag dang / rta rmig ma/ gser ṭam do po/ so las khongs kyi gzhung khang / mi rtsa pho mo'i mi bogs/ ja tshwa las khungs nas do dam byed pa rgya khyab tshwa bal/ rnga ma/ pags rigs sogs kyi sho khrul sngar lam ṭam dkar zhe gcig bsdu len byas 'bab/ nag chu/ lha ri 'go gro phag bcas sa 'gag spag nas ja khrul sgam ja dang / 'khor drug ja ril bcas do grangs chig stong brgal ba sogs lo ltar rtse rnam gan mdzod khang steng shod du bka' shag dang / spyi mkhan/ drung rtsis/ rtse shod sku tshab bcas thun mong nas bcug phra dang sbrags bsdu 'jug zhu dgos/ de mtshungs spyi mkhan dang / rtse yig tshang las khungs nas do dmatshobyed pa sngar bod chos rgyal gong rim gyi chas gos rin chen rgyan cha zhes gser ga(gser gyi ga'u) bod g.yu zhe gcig gi phra tshoms lha1

can che chungatshobre tshad tsam sgor gre/zuk+to/ riki ma —kaci ༄ka dang / sog sgo ra zhe8 ge de las cung chung ba nor rga/zugs ma/ sog rna bcas g.yu khru gong mtshungs/ rna brgyangs zhes bod g.yu the bong tsam nyi shu skor dngusda gyi mtha' skyor thog gral bstar sgrig pa ring thung bkuchani /sgu gre/nga tsam/ shal dmar zhes byu ru dkrugs ma che chung kham tshig che ba tsam rdog grangan/ brgya dang su myo cu skor yod pa'i do shal gcig shal seri zhes spor+sā shel rnying ma zhe gcig ngang sgong che tshad tsam rdog grangs nyi shu skor yod pa'i do shal gci ga(do shal dmar ser zer)/ ko lham 'go snam mtshal lngang gi yu sbyar/ gos thon mthi sngo khru'am/ dpyad ldan gang rung gi rtsi gos dang / rtsi ber sram rgyan ma/ gtsug zhwa sgro gzugs bcas re re bzhin deb bkod byas pa'i gtan deb dang / cha tshang rer 'jug sdod stag sgacha/ re bcas khyon bsdoms cha tshang sum cu so bzhir sgam grangs sum cu so bzhi yod pa de dag dgung gab ra dang chibs bsgyur sogs mdzad sgo khag la 'don pa ma gtogs rnam kun rtse dus 'khor lha khang 'og dzam lha khang du bsdu 'jug zhu dgos/mdzod chung dang mdzod sbugatā la'i bla ma sku sger gyi mdzod sbug dang / mdzod chung gnyis kyi gtso bo'i do dam spyi ma khan dang / las bya rtse mkhan che gcig dang mi /khan chung gcig las tshan pa gnyis/ bar skabs srid skyong ra sgreng dus 'phar sgon shod skor tha'i ji gcig bcas yod pa'i gtso bori las 'gan mdzod sbug dang mdzod chung gnyis kyi khongs su gser dngul gyi sa phag dang / rta rmig ma/ ṭam kagazi/ byu ru/ mu tig g.yu/ pha lam sogs rin po che'i rigs dang / gos 22

dir sogs rin thang bral ba'i phyag rdzas sne mang 'bor chen zhig bkar khongs su 'don lajug do dmyo/ byed dgos pa'i thog nga/burngasu yo/tsang kham sa sog/ dad gyi na khag gicha/ phul kyidangos khongs nas sngar lam rtse shod phyag mdzod gnyis su 'bab rigs phud/ de byings mdzod sbug tu do dam dang / sku sger mdzod sbu ga tu sbyor 'bul zhus pa'i gzhis khag 'brob/ thang / mi rtsa pho mo bcas la do dam gnyer skyong / gzhan yang dbus gtsang rgya khyab gzhung gling khag la lo ltar lcang ma 'debs 'dzugs sam/ gcod breg lha sa smon tshogs gnyis dang rgyun shing gtong byed shing gnyer la nye 'khor gzhung gling khag nas tshogs shing 'os 'tshams gtong rgya/ nor gling chibs rwa mdo sbug gi do dam dpon po chibs dpon zhes gnas lnga pa'i las tshan pa'i gdan thob yod pa gcig dang / chibs g.yog mi grangs nye shu skor/ zhol chibs rwa mdo sbug dang / chab drel/ gzim drel/rgyug ma bcas kyi do dam pa chibs dpon chen mo zhes shod skor gnas drug pa'i las tshan pa gnyis dang / chibs sbug zhal ngo dang / bar gzhi zhal ngo (bar gzhi ba zhes pa'i nye 'gram du sngar chibs rwa zhig yod pa phyis zhol chibs rwar zla bsgril btang yang chibs rwa zhal ngo'i sngar ming rang 'jags thogs pa)gnyis/ chibs bcos zhal ngo / lag do mi bzhi/ 'go yan mi bcu(a drung)gzim drel zhal ngo /rgyug ma zhal ngo zhes drung gtogs mi gnyis/ de 'og gzim drel lag do mi grangs bco lnga skor bcas kyi rgyun gtan byed sgo gang ci spyi mkhan nas 'go 'doms byed dgos/ mdzod sbug mdzod chung nas skyed yang ma 'grem gnang ba'i mdzod sbug dngul skyed do dam gong gsal mkhan che can dang / mdzod chung dngul skyed do dam rtse gzim 'gag khri pas gtsos gzim 'gag bzhi nas byed dgos/ mdzod sbug mdzod chung gnyis ka'i las don gal che'i rigs spyi mkhan la dgongs skor zhu dgos la/ latra/ don rtsag rtsig mkhan po tshang gi phyag 23

khang zhes mkhan phyag mi gcig(gzhung gi go gnas med) dang / drung tog yod pa'i drung yig gcig gis rgyun tshugs las don sgrub dgos pa bcas red/gsol gzim mchod gsum/tā la'i bla ma'i sku'i gam bcar zhabs zhu'i gras su gsol —gzim mchod gsum ste/ gsum gar sku bcar nang ma mkhan sde che kha'i mtshan gnas gdan thob yod pa red/ sku bcar gsol dpon mkhano pos rgyu na du rtse gsol thab khang gi gsol dpon mkhan chung dang / gnyer pa/ ma che/ zhib pa/ gsol mdzo ra bcas gsol thab mi grangs nyi shu skor las grub par+ṣa rtse gsol thab khang gi gtso 'gan bzhes dgos pa de yang / gtso bor tā la'i bla ma'i ljags smin gsol tshigs khag la gtsang sbra dang bstod dang ldan pa'i gnyer skyong thog 'char 'phar mdzad sgo khag dang / rgyun gtan drung jar dkar spro dang / gsol gro (gro ma) bzhes 'bras sogs phebs sgo khag sgrig gshom/ gzhan yang rtse skor gsol thab pa bsko 'then 'os 'char gtong rgyu sogs kyi 'gan dbang yod/sku bcar gzim dpon mkhan po'i 'gan dbang gartsa bo tā la'i bla ma'i gzim chung khag dang / thugs dam khang / mtshan gzim khang bcas kyi sku'i nyer spyad dang / sku'i na bza' skor la gtsang sbra phu dud dang do dam/ tā la'i bla ma mchog pho brang yas mas sogs nye khul chibs sgyur skabs byams 'degs pa mi bcu drug byams 'then mi brgyad bcas la rnam kun ched gnyer 'go 'tsho byed po phebs byams 'go pa zhes shod skor rim bzhi gcig dang / las tshan pa gcig yod kyang rtsa ba'i do dam gzim dpon mkhan po nas mdzad dgos/sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan pos tā la'i bla ma'i thugs dam zhal sku

'don khang sogs gzim chung khag la 'char 'phar mchod spyin sgrig gshom zhu sgo spyi dang / lhag par rgyun gtan gzigs dpe khag la thugs tshags gnang rgyu dang tshogs mang gsung chos skabs sogs nam dgos su gzigs 'bul bstar chog ang gsar/ dbu skor grwa tshang ste/ rnam grwa phan bde legs bshad gling grwa tshang gi sgrig khrims gnon 'doms dang / 'don kha khrul/ gar thig dbyangs gsum sogs chos spyod bya gzhag la do dam 'go 'tsho mdzad dgos la rnam grwa'i chos srid kyi don gnad snyan zhu dgos rigs kyang chos dpon mkhan pos thad kar snyan seng zhus chog pa bcas yin/rtse yig tshang las khungs/yig tshang las khungs ni rab byung bcu gsum pa chu sprel(1752) lo tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa'i skabs thog mar rgyal dbang gang nyid kyi sku sger yig tshang lta bur 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa zhig yin zhing / de'i mi sna gser yig zhwa ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs can rtse drung rim bzhi'i gdan thob yod pa gcig dang / las tshan pa gnyis/ las bya rtse drung kha shas bcas yod 'dug kyang / de'i rjes su rtse rig gnas slob grwa nas thon pa sogs gzhung zhabs ser mo ba rim bzhin 'phar ba dang / las khungs khag la ser skya nyis sbre la bsko 'dzugs gnang dgos pa bcas kyi sku sger yig tshang de ser mo ba yongs kyi spyi khyab rtse yig tshang las khungs su ming sgrur gyis do dam pa rim bzhi'i gdan thob yod pa'i rtse drung gsum dang / de rjes srid skyong rwa sgeng dus mkhan drung las 'phar gcig bskos pas mkhan drung bzhi/ yig tshags pa las tshan pa'i gdan thob yod pa'i rtse drung gcig(yig tshang gnyer pa zhesdo/ 'bod srol) las bya rtse 25

bying bco lnga tsam/ dbu mdzad ri mo ba gcigre/ 'i/0/ tusku nga rlo/ ba phrug bzhi/ bcas las krub pa zhig yin/las khungs de'i 'gan dbang ni rgya khyab gzhung dgon khag dang / rtse skor ser mo ba yongs kyi spyi khya/ ba 'go 'doms thog dgon sde khag gi mkhan po/zhal ngo / gzims khang sde pa sogs las sne che khag rtse skor las tshan che 'bring chung gre/sum khongs gtogs dang bcas bsko 'then skor tā la'i bla mar 'char k+ṣ-isebul chog ca/chan zhu dgos pa dang / tā la'i bla ma nas ro ltar rgya khyab rdzong gzhi8 lha sde mi sde yongs la blangs dor gyi byed sgo spyir btang dang /dmigs bsal gyi rtsa tshig dgon sde khag gi bca' yig gdan sa gsum dang /rgyud grwa stod smad/ gnas chung grwa tshang / rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang bcas che btsan bdun gyis mtshon sger chos khag la sa khang mi gsum bdag thob skor gyi〈she/ bam che mo〉gzhan yang phyi'i rgyal khab khag la stsal rgyu'i sbug dam bka' yig bcas tā la'i bla ma'i bka' mngags dgongs don ltar rtse sde drung lhan rgyas nas 'char zin bkod de chog mchan thob mtshamyo/sa gtsang bris kyis tā la'i bla cha/ 'i sku mdun du sbug dam dam zhu zhu dgos pa dang / phyogs mtshungs srid skyong dang srid blon gyis stsa(mā rgyu'i rtsa tshig dang / lag khyer/ bkod rgya sogs kyi ma zin bzo bkod dang thaca/ ka phab rgyag sbug dam dang srid dam gyi phyi sgod lde mig bdag gnyer bgyis te dam sgam khar tā la'i bla ma'i mgul tham dang srid skyong sri da blon gyi mgul tham so sor zhu dgos/ rnam kun rtse skor gyi las don che phrari rigs dang / rgya khyab ris med gzhung dgon khag la stangs 'dzin byed dgos pa/ skabs 'gar chab srid kyi las don gal che'i rigs mkhan drung bzhi dang / rtsis dpon bzhi bcas drung rtsis brgyad sbre'/ la bka' nogag nas tshogs 'du'i dgongs don bka' mngags kyis zur tshogs byed dgos/ pa dang / bod 26

ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms skabs su'ang drung rtsis brgyad sbrel nas tshogs 'du'i ngago 'doms byas te gros bsdur thog tshig tho spyi tham bzhi(rtse shod drung spyi dang / gdan sa gsum gyi spum ka)'byar bka' shag brgyud tā la'i bla mar phul te chog mchan zhu dgos/ gzhan yang rtse rig gnas slob grwa'i 'go 'tsho stangs 'dzin dang / snye mo yon bdag dang e pa yon bdag sogs la bkod 'doms kyang byed/yig tshang gnyer pas mkhan drung rnams kyi bkod mngags ltar yig 'bri dang / las bya dkyus ma rnams la las don bkod 'doms/ rtse drung dkyus mas gzhung sger las don skor yig tshang du zhu dgos rigs yig tshang gnyer pa brgyud rgya dgos pas gnyer pas mkhan drung rnam par zhu ba sogs byed dgos/rtse gzim chung 'gagartse gzim chung 'gag gi gtso bo'i 'khur 'dzin mdzad po rtse mkhan mgron che ba zhes rtse skor rim bzhi'i gdan thob yod pa'i mkhan chung gcig dang / de 'og gnas lnga pa'i rtse mgron mi grangs bcu drug gzim 'gag khri pa mkhan che dar rgan gyi gdan thob yod pa gcig dang / gnas drug pa las tshan pa'i rgadan thob yod pa gsum bcas las grub pa'i rtse gzim chung 'gag gi 'char 'phar mdzad sgo khag dang / lhag par dgon sde che khag gi bla ma las sne dang / gzhung zhabs ser skya che 'bring chung gsum gyi las tshan bsko 'then soṭa lugs zung chab srid lung bsgyur gyi rigs su gtogs pa tā la'i bla ma'i bka' gang yod ji ma ji bzhin bsgyur dgos pa ni rtse mkhan mgron gyi phrag thog tu babasme pa'i las 'gan gtso bo zhig yin/ srid skyong gis mtshon gdan sa'i rgyal 27

sprul che khag dang / bka' gung / gzhung zhabs ser skya/ sto zan yan/ gdan sa'i bla ma las sne sogs gsar mjal dang / 'byor thon gyi rigs thog mar rtse 'gag brgyud gzhes brda snyan seng zhu dgos pa dang / dngos gzhi'i che 'don mjal bcar skabs rang rang go babs la gzhigs pa'i thob bzos go rim bzhin stsol dgos/ gzhan yang phyi'i rgyal khab khag gi mi sna dad mjal zhu mi sogs 'char 'phar mdzad sgo che phra gang ci nyin ltar 'gag deb tu bkod de slar tā la'i bla ma sku thog gcig gi mdzad rnam 'god rgyu'i ma zin 'god dgos pa sogs kyi 'gan dbang yod cing / srid skyong dang / bka' shag yig tshang bcas brgyud zhi drag bsdu gtong las khungs khag dang / phyogs mtha'i spyi khyab/rdzong gzhis khag bcas nas las don gang ci'i byed phyogs kyi 'char gzhi snyan zhu dang / sa mtshams kyi gnad don/ gzhung 'bangs ser skya spyi sger so so'i bde sdug snyan zhu sogs gong srid bka' shag dang bcas pa'i mtshan 'khod yin phyin thog mar bka' shag dang / srid skyong / de nas rtse mkhan mgron che ba brgyud tā la'i bla mar 'bul dgos pa dang / skabs 'gar bka' shag gis gtsos las khungs che 'bring khag la do dam ngo las rgyun tshogs yod med dang / tshuṭa grol snga phyi/ las don skor sogs la rtse mkhan mgron che ba ngo phebs kyis rtog zhib skor g.yeng byas te gnas tshul ji yod skabs 'phral tā la'i bla mar snyan seng zhu dgos pa/ gzhung don gal che'i rigs srid skyong dang / bka' shag bka' bsdur gyis tā la'i bla ma'i sku mdun du snyan zhur ngo bcar zhu dgos pa bcas red/zhod 'gagame glang (1757) lo tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa dgongs pa zhi 28

dbyings su mnal rjes de mo bde legs rgya mtshos srid skyong las 'gan bzhes skabs shod 'gag ces gsar gtod gnang ba de'i 'gan 'khur gtso bo sne mgron zhes rtse skor mkhan chung gcig dang / gnas lnga pa shod mgron mi grangs brgyad/ gzim 'gag gnyis/ sne shan rtse drung gcig bcas yod/ sne mgron gyi 'gan ngabang gtso bo ni gsham 'og las khungs khag nas sne mgron brgyud snyan zhu dang / 'char gzhi 'byor rigs nas rtse 'gag tu dmigs bsal snyan zhur 'bul dgos pa phud/ de byings srid skyong nas chog mchan phab ste sne mgron brgyud bka' shag tu stsal ba dang / nyes can drag khrims gcod dgos pa'i rigs dang / gzhan yang bsdu gtong las don/ rtse shod nang zan bsko 'then sogs chung rtsag gi rigs srid skyong nas chog mchan bstsal te sne mgron brgyud bka' bsgyur rgyu dang / gzhung zhabs ser skya/ gdan sa'i mkhan po las sne bcas gsar mjal dang / 'byor thon gyi rigs rtse 'gag dang 'dra bar 'gag mjal zhus te nyin re'i shod 'gag deb tu 'god dgos/ 'phral bde'am rtse phyag las khungs/rtse phyag mdzod 'phral bde las khungs ni dpal 'byor bsdu gtong gi las khungs che gras shig yin zhing / gtso bo'i do dam rtse phyag ces rtse skor mkhan chung (rim bzhi)gnyis dang / shod drung rim bzhi gcig drung dkyus kyi gdan thob yod pa'i rtse phyag drung gcig rtse phyag nang ngo ma dang / zha'u li (phyag nang 'os sgug par zer)bcas mi grangs nyi shu skor yod pa dang / de'i gtso bo'i 'gan dbang ni tā la'i bla ma'i thugs mkho gser dngul zangs lcags/gos dar/ gzhan yang rin po che'i rigs glang chen gyi mche ba/ ru rta/ snyi wang ཿgyi

sogs rtsa che'i sman ribanas/ bod ཿsnyen/ rma do ja/ ljags smin sman 'bras dang /kan tshal/ shing 'bras sna tsho /mi // ska/ ra tingatshogihwa/zurten+tus myo// bu ram sodzo/ru/ r+ṣa /tho/ rgu'i 'dod yon 'du 'god byed da bo /sa/ 3/ kha/gre/ gi 'bab khungs stod /ku'/ gse ra dpon zhes phyag nang mi gcig byang 'a d+dha/ brgyud rtsa hreng / mda' pa kha/ spu hreng /ru thog sogs gser kha khag nas lo ltar gser srang stong phrag brgal ba'i gser khrul bsdu /laca/ yod pa da nga / ba/zhung tshong rtse/sa phyag nang mi gcig gzhung lam brgyud lag do rta drekhashaṃ dos rta lam yig dang bcas sko ra gsum khul du ja dar sogs sngon bsgrubs zin pa'i sman zog sna tshogs bskur te mngar kham dang kha sur sogs shing 'bras kyi rigs dang / ka ra ting gzugs dang bu ram rtsa sgor/ bye ril lhu dkar/ bye zhib sogs mngar cha'i rigs mkho sgrub byed dgos pa dang / mdo smad kyi rgyal ston khul so gas nas 'bri chu gser sdud pa dang / phag ri 'bras sgrub/ rgyal thang zangs sgrub pa bcas nas khul so so'i thon zog bsgrubs te sgrigs 'bul zhu dgos/ sngar lam lo gnangs 'char la bal yul rten bzhengs pa spres bal yul mchod rten rnam gsum la na bza' skron 'bul dang 'brel mchod sprin sna lnga stong tshar re 'bul gshom zhu dgos pa dang chabs cig gor gzhung la 'tshams rtags dang / bal snam tshwa bcas dang thon zog brje res byed lam bzhin sman rdzas dang / de min gyi mkho zog sna tsho gas sgrub 'bul zhu dgob// de bzhin 'bab deb nang gsal dwags po lha gsol gzhis/ dpal di gzhis/ rgya shar gter sna gzhis so gas gzhis khag rnams kyi thon 'bab dang / mal gro gzi sbug sogs lho byang she khag gi she 'bab 'phral bde phyag mdzod nas bsdu len byed pa nga/nga / lhag par tā la'i bla ma mchog spyi sger dad sbyin khag nas lha ldan smon 'a/ma tshogs mgon du gdan zhu dang / rnam kun 'das gson khag gi skyabs zhu'i 'bul dngos khongs na sa gzim chu nga gi 30

thugs ma /bo dang / rtse rnam gan du bsdu 'jug gnang 'oṭa/ phud/ bu/ byings 'bul dngos ji yod rtse shod phyag mdzod las khungs su 'bab pa dang / gzhung gi 'char 'phar gtong sgo bka' 'dzin dang 'brel rigs rtse shod phyag mdzod gsum cha gsum gnyis gtong lam bzhin rtse phyag nas gsum gcig(bla phyag nas gsum gnyis)gtong dgos/ rtse pho brang gi mchod khang dang / gser gdung khag bcas 'a dkon gnyer mchod 'bul ba yod mus thog rgyal po lcog shar chen lcogagayul rgyal lcog bcas pho brang gi khor yug steng shod le lag dang bcas par sgo rwa ba dang / khang gnyer/ gad pa bcas sa khungs so sor 'gan dakhri yod khar rnam kun rtse phyag las khungs nas do dam bkod 'domyoshaṃs dang 'brel dgong mo'i chu tshod dgu pa tsam la rtse phyag mkhan chung ngo ma gcig dang / phyag nang gnyis lgang zhu 'khyer te pho brang steng shod tshang mar me rkun gnyis la dogs zon gzab grung dgos pa'i 'char can bskor g.yeng byed skabs su sa khungs so so'i dkon gnyer dang / khang gad mi sna ma bsdad pa sogs kyi gnas tshul byung tshe nyes chad nan po gcod kyi yod pa red/ de mtshungs gzhung sgo phun tshogs 'du lam dang / ltag sgo rgyab/ byang chen thar lam bcas kyi sgo srung pa nas rnam kun rtse shod mi sna dang / las don dang mchod mjal zhu mi sogs la zhib 'jug dang 'brel chas gos ya ma gzugs dang / sked gri gzer ba/ stod hreng phud pa/ chang rag sogs myos rdzas kyi rigs dang / gang zag tha mag sogs 'thung 'then mi chog la lhag par pho brang khor yug le lag dang bcas par bud med zhag sdod mi chog pa sogs sbug dam rtsa tshig dgongs don ltar do dam rgyun bsring byed dgos pa red/ 31

gnyer tshang las khungs/rtse gnyer tshang las khungs ni de snga sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skabs nas bzung 'bru rtsam/ sha mar/ ja 'bras/ tshwa bul/ snum sogs kyi skabs de'i gtong sgo'i las khungs che ba zhig yin zhing / rtse pho brang dmar po gsar bzhengs skabs ar ston sogs gtong 'gros che skabs su sde srid sku ngo ma las khungs der dbu 'dzin du phebs pa'i bzhugs khri'ang da lta'i bar yod pa red/ phyis rtse shod gang sar bsdu gtong las khungs rim 'phar gyis bar skabs su rtse gnyer tshang las khungs kyi do dam rtse drung gnas lnga pa'i las tshan pa gnyis dang / drung tog yod pa'i drung yig gcig gnyer nang zhes nang zan mi nyi shu bcas yod pa de dag gi las 'gan ni de snga rgya khyab gzhung sger chos gsum la lag 'don gyi khrul 'bab che shos‘‘rgya shing rngod gsum’’gyi nang nas smon rngod lte ba'i 'bab deb rtsam khang du yod pa'i khongs nas rtse gnyer la 'bab rigs zur 'don mchan 'khod ltar khri khungs so sos rtsam khrul 'jal dgos pa de yang khad 'gyangs mi ser nas rtsam dod dngul sgril gyis sprod dgos pa dang /nye 'khor rdzong gzhis khag nas rtsam pa ngo 'bul dgos pa rnams rtse gnyer tshang las khungs nas bsdu len gyis rtse pho brang gi lha khang khag dang / mchod pa khang / 'char 'phar stong mchod dang mchod 'bul brgya bkag(se 'bras dga' gsum nas po ta la dang gtsug lag khang sogs la mchod 'bul pa phebs dgos par dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya nas chag mi chog pa'i tshad bkag yod par zer) khag bcas la mchod rtsam mchod 'bru dang / drung ja mdo sbug gi mdzad sgo khag la gsol zhib dgos rigs rtse gnyer gyis skabs 'phral zhol las khungs nas blangs te ci 8ཿ

zhib phor 'geng 'bul zhu dgos pa dang / rtse khang gnyer dang gad pa khag gi 'bru phogs kyang rgyagatshudagos pa red/ rtse rnam gan dngul skyed do dam/sa lug(1919) lo sman rtsis khang sogs kyi gron dngul gtong dmigs su rtse rnam gan bkar khongs nas ṭam dkar 'bor chen zhig sger chos tshong riṭa khag la ma 'dzugs gnang ba'i rtse rnam gan dngul skyed do dam zhes rtse skor mkhan che gcig dang / drung rtsis gnyis/ rtse shod gzim 'gag gnyis/ rtse drung las tshan pa gnyis/ shod drung rtsis pa gcig las bya rtse drung bcu skor bcas bsko gzhag gi skyed dus dang po zla gsum pa/ gnyis pa zla drug pa/ gsum pa zla brgyad pa/ bzhi pa zla bcu pa/ lnga pa zla bcu gnyis pa bcas dus bkag so sor skyed 'bab chad med bsdu len gyis lo ltar bka' shag tu byung song rtsis khru phul te dag mchan zhus thog lo 'khor rer do dam ngo las brje len byed dgos/ rtse rig gnas blob grwashing khyi (1764) lo tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtshos gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa'i rtse rig gnas slob grwa 'dir yig gzugs kyi dge rgan rtse drung gcig dang / rig gnas lachi/ wa rtu/ chag lo yig gsar/ t+pagos lo yig gsar sogs yig sna'i rigs dang / sgra snyan dngags/sdeb sbyor/ sum rtags/ rtsis dkar nag sogs la byang chub pa'i dge rgan zhig 33

smin grol gling kro khongs natra/ 'che/myoshaṃs bak+ko ga/na nga gro 'a/ mo/da neng / rla/ba phruka ni gdan sa 'bras se dgasku gsuca/ dang / rme ru/ bzhi sde/ gzhis dgon/ kha/ ga bcas nas grwa chag brgyab ste bsdus par gzhung pa ze ra ba dang / rtse drung shag tshang gi khungs 'dzin la sger pa zhes shes rig 'dzoms la kun spyod gtsang ba zhe gcig mi grangs lnga bcu skor 'dems basprugs kyis dge rgan gnyis nas 'os 'char phul thog rtse yig tshang las khungs nas zhib 'jug chog mchan phebs bstun 'dzugs ja dang bcas/ slob grwa'i sgrigs lam bca' yig gzhir bzung slob grwar zhugs chog de'i khongs nas gtso bo slob phrug so so'i sheṅge yon sbyang rtsal che chung dang / bslab gral rgan gzhon sogs la gzhigs te rim bzhin rtse yig tshang las khungs nas rtse skor zhabs zhu'i 'os khongs su gtong gi yod/bla phyag las khungs/ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi phyogs bzhir zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las khungs bzhi yod pa ste/ shar du zhi ba'i las khungs rtsis khang phun tshogs bkod pa dang / stor rgyas pa'i las khungs bka' shag nub tu dbang gi las khungs bla phyag byang du drag po'i las khungs bsher khang bdud sde tshar gcod bcas bzhi yod pa las lhor rgyas pa'i las khungs bka' shag steng shod kyi 'gan dbang mdor bsdus gong du bkod zin pa ltar dang / nub tu dbang gi las khungs bla brang phyag mdzod ni rab byung drug pa'i sa glang(1409) lo rje tsong kha pa chen po'i mdzad che na bzhi'i ya gyal lha ldan cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo zhes gdan sa 'bras se dga' gsum gyi dge 'dun tshang ma mchu zla'i yar tshes rngi nas nyin nyer gcig dang / phyis 'phar tā la'i bla ma lnga pa'i dgongs 34

rdzogs mchod sprin tshogs mchod nyin bcu gnyis ring so sor ra sa 'phrul snang gtsub/ ngashaṃ ga khang du 3/so/si tshogs la phebs par bsnyen bkur zhu dgos rnga/ dang /sngar durnga/ smo na nā ca tshuzla/sa ring gi dge ‘nadun 'dus pa rgya myo/tshor bsnyen bkur stuni nga thuspu// tsha gra so/r+shakas rje tsong ba/ pa chen po'i sku sger bla brang nas nar gtong byed stu/ dang / gra sgrig bya yul lha sa bar skor nang bla brang rnying pa(de snga'i sde dpoca/ trī na pa ba'i sle/ra 9/gle/ byed pa de red)zhes pa de yin cing rjes su lo re bzhin ca/tsho sngo na sogs smad phyospu/sa nas dad 'dus sbyin bdag je mang du song rkyen rka/ shwe nga paṃ/ zhi/ rma dzo da khang de lha sa gtsug lag khang steng du spos par bla brang phyag mdzod ces zer/ 'on kyang skabs der sbyin bdag 'das gson khag gi dad rdzas tsam las gzhan gyi 'bab dmigs med la gtong yul yang smon lam zla gcig ring tsam ma gtogs med rung / rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta (1642) lor tā la'i bla ma lnga pa chen pos srid dbang bzhes rjes gzhi nas lha sa smon laca/ gyi gtong gzhi mdzod khang de srid gzhung gis gnyer skyong byed pa'i baji gtong las khungs shig tu gyur pa der thog mar gzhung bskos mi sna kha nizhas las med kyang / rim bzhi na las khungs de'i bsdu gtong rgya khyon je cher song stangarnga / phyirnga/ do dam mi sna rtse slo/ra mkhan chung gnyirnga dang / shod skor rim baju/ gcig de rjechi / rwa sgreng rgyal thogre/ skabs rim bzhi las 'phar gcig dang / drung gre/togs phyag drung gcig phyagre/ nang ngo cha/ dang zha'u li bcas yod pas khyo'e mi grangs sum cu skor las tsho/ba ci nga / las khungs de'i gtso bo'i 'gan dbangatshoni kadan sa 'bras se dga' ba/sum la rgyun ja rgyun mar gtong dgos pa dang / gtsug lag khang spa/ rga/ dang / rtse pho brang / nor gling pho brang yas ma ru// gsang chen rgyud grwa rnam gnyis/ rtse rnacari rgyal grwa tshang / dga' gdong / rme ru/ bzhi sde/ gling phan chun/ lha sa/'i phyodzi/sa stu/zhe'i rigs gsum 3bya

lha khang bcas la mchod bsnyen gtong sgo nar gtong byed dgos pa/ rnam kun zla ba 'byung ngo cog gi nya stong brgyad gsum so sor gtsug lag khang dang / khyad par jo shā / rnam gnyis kyi spyan sngar 'char can stong mchod 'bul dgos la lhag par du smon lam dang tshogs mchod gnyis kyi ring gdan sa 'bras se dga' gsum gyi dge 'dun nyis khri brgal bar bsnyen bkur gsol ja gsol mar dang bzhes thug gi rgyu 'gro bzhes 'bras/ nas chag sdor mar/ phyur ba/ bzhes sdor/ 'khur dod dngul/ sger khag lag 'don 'gyed dngul phud/ dod 'bul dang thebs sbyar khag bcas kyang rgyun gtan las khungs rang nas 'gyed dngul 'bul dgos/ de mtshungs spyi khyab bka' shag gsol thab kyis gtsos las khungs khag gi rgyun gtan ja mar dang / sha rtsam/ tshwa bul sogs nar gtong dgos pa ma zad/ lhag par skyabs mgon rtse shod gnyis nas phyi rgyal mi sna dang / gzhan yang dad mjal zhu mi khag la 'tshams rtags gnang sbyin gser dngul/ snam rigs/ pags rigs/ sman rdzas sogs bod zog rtsa che'i rigs dang / dar gos/ ja sogs nam dgos rtse 'phral bde dang bla phyag las khungs gnyis nas 'bul dgos pa dang / gzhung khang khag gi ar las skabs rdo shing /dmangs 'ul dang bzo rigs tshan pa khag gi phogs thob ja mar/ phyur ba/ rgyar (sha)sogs dang / sman rtsis khang dang lcags po ri sman khang / dmag sgar khag gi sman khang bcas par sman rigs dgos mkho gang yod nar gtong byed dgos pa bcas/ gtong gzhi de dag gi gtso bo'i 'bab khungs ni rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khag nas yong sdud ces lo 'khor gcig gi khrul mo che de'i khrul rigs kyi rnam grangs brgya phrag kha shas yod pa'i 'bab deb spyi dang / lhag par sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khag nas zhing 'brog thon skyed kyis mtshon rtswa sman rdo sman/ tha na rdza chas yan gyi thon khungs ji yod zhib tshags kyi 36

rdzogatan ribebs mdzad pa'i〈'bab deb dbyigs mdzod chen mo〉zhes pa'i nang stod dang / mdo smad phud/ dbus gtsang sto kha kho nar gser kha khag nyi shu skoḥci nas gser dngul zangs lcags sogs mdog ldan lcags rigs gtso bor gyur pa'i dngos dang / yong khrul khongs sha mar/ nya sha skam po tshad long /(de snga gtsang dus skabs rgyal rtse/ sna rtse/ gling / gong dkar bcas rdzong khongs nya sde khag nas yong khrul chung sha khog ces nya skam tshad long bsdu lam yod pa rnams phyis chag yangs kyis nya sde la sa zhing dang / 'brog thang gi rten gnas/ lo ltar nya 'bru bcas kyi 'tsho thebs bstsal ba red) bal rnga/ pags rigs/ 'bru rigs dkar nag thig ris sogs tshos gzhi mi 'dra ba'i snam rigs sna tshogs/ rtsid bshang gi sbra snam srab pa/ rtsid pa dang / khu lu 'dres ma'i spra snam/ gser dngul zangs lcags/zha nye/ lcags dkrol gyi sgo shan/ sgo 'bor/ mtshon rtse gcig pa'i 'phrul mdung / dpa' dam/ bod mdel tshad mtshungs kyi mdel/ khrub rmog mkhreg shing gi rta sga/ skyem shog rgya shog snag tshwa/ rtswa sman/ rdo sman sogs sman rigs sna tshogs/ gla rtsi/ dom mkhris/ khrug rwa/ ghi wang/ dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu/ bod tshon gyi rigs/ btsos dang / star lngags/ rgya tshos la sogs pa'i shing tshos sna tshogs/ bse ru'i rwa/ shā ba'i dung rwa/ gtsod rwa/ 'brong rwa/rma bya dang bya ngang sogs kyi sgro spu/ stag gzig dom/ dred/ wa/ g.yi la sogs sder chags gcan gzan gyi rigs su gtogs pa'i pags pa/ rtsam phor/phor pa/ shing sder che chung / dzab shing gi phor pa/ zho mdong / zar bu sogs spyod mkho'i shing chas rigs 'dra min sna tshogs/ su pan/ mog ro/ kham star/rgun 'brum/ shing 'bras sna tshogs/ lho lcam dang / pang leb sna tshogs sogs mdor na sa khul so so'i yul zog thon dngos 'dra min gyi khrul sne brgya phrag kha shasagyukyi 'bab khungs che shos bla phyag las khungs yin cing / de 'og rtse 'phral 37

bde las khungs dang / rtse kanyer tshang las /kungs/ rtso/la la sa / brungs/ shod gnyer 6 5spro 9ge sa /ci nga ri // khu ma len las rngo/hūṃngarnga phocas su 'bab pa dang / lhag par bla phyag larngage khungs su shan rtsa rdzong khongs nag tshang tsho drug nas mar khrul dang / rtsirba 'khri da///ra she'i mar 'bab bsdomyo/sa lo re lha srang khal bcu yam̐kanyis (ṭā/da tshad /༄'a/ spyob kyi do ya re)re yod pa'i mar ltang ngo grangs brgyad brgya skor dang / nag tshang byang phyogs kyi phyugs rigs la 'brong rtsa yod par brten dmigs bsal byang phyogs sa khul 'ga' shas nas sngar srol bsdu lam ltar 'brong khe/ dang / da dung /kul der dad sbyar(dad sbyin khag gis sbyar ba'i)khag bcas kyi mar 'bab bsdu khungs che zhing / gzhan yang dbus khul nye 'khor rtswa yul bzang sa khag la las khungs rang gi she 'bri ched 'dzugs kyis gzhung she khag mang yod par bsdu len byed po she dpon phyag nang rgan pa gnyis dang /dwagyi/rngage po sku rnam she dpon/ 'on gtam chu she dpon/ lho kha gri gu she dpon/stod khul gro shod she dpon/ yangs can she dpon bcas phyag nang re gtong lam yod ci nga / stod sa dga' khul gyi khrul mar rnams 'bras spungs dgon pa dang / rgyal ston /khul gyi mar 'bab rnams dga' ldan dgon/ nag chu khul gyi mar 'bab rnams se ra dgon pa'i rgyun mar bcas la kha 'thab tu rdzong 'go so so sa 0/sdu 'bul zhu dgos pa dang / gdan sa gsum gyis gtsos gzhung khongs dgon sde che 'bring khag dang / yab gzhis/ sde da pon mi / drag byings sger drag 'bri nga dkyus gsu/ma so so'i 'arin dbang rgya khyo/ na la ka shigs pas she 'bri nyis brgya lnga bcu nas sum cu 'a na skye yed 'chi med du rtsirnga/ 'phri/ ra bstsal ba'i she 'bab dang / mtsho sna /3brangage spruspra pas sbas tshang / yangardori can/ 'dam/ mar rkyang bcas rdzong / bag bzhi'i 'bro ga pa narngashaṃ lo re dzo dze+e khal chig khri brgyad stong skor la yul gro la rin /ribru sgad de mtsho sna bar skye rtedzo dre na byed dgos pa di nga / de 3༷

byings tshong tshwa ji yod gong gsal rdzong khag bzhi'i 'brog pa so so/sa 'dod nyo 'dod tshong byas chog pa bcas mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pas tshwa 'bras brje len gyis lo ltar bla phyag las khungs su 'bras khal nyis khri skor dang / gzhan yang sto zog gi thon khungs sgrigs 'bul zhu dgos/ de bzhin gting skyes 'bras sgrub pas shangs rnam gling rdzong / lha phu gzhis sdod/ rgya mtsho gzhis sdod/ 'od yug gling dkar gzhis sdod bcas rdzong gzhis khag bzhi'i tshwa 'bab khongs nas gsum gnyis rtse phyag las khungs khongs phag ri 'bras sgrub pa nas bsdu len byed pa phu da/ gsum gcig tshwa khal chig khri nyi stong skor dang / bzhad/ rta nag khul gyi tshwa 'bab bcas gting skyes brgyud zar tshong dus su tshwa 'bras brje len byas te lo re 'bras khal chig khri bzhi stong skor bla phyag las khungs su sgrigs 'bul zhu dgos pa/ de min dkon gnyer dpon gyi lha sa gtsug lag khang gi yong 'bab dang / zhol las khungs/ snang shag las khungs/ bsher dpang las khungs/ gnyer tshang las khungs bcas kyi yong 'bab dngul dngos rnams lo ltar bla brang phyag mdzod la sgrigs 'bul zhu dgos/ las khungs de rnams kyis sgrigs 'bul zhus pa'i dngos por bla phyag las khungs nas rin 'bebs kyis lo ltar bod zla 1tshes 'i4nyin bla steng gzim chung kun gsal du tā ma'i bla ma'i spyan sngar lha ram dge bshes ang rim dang / bco lnga mchod pa'i ang rim gzengs bstod bya dga' gnang grub rjes sgrigs 'bul ang rngom la gzhigs pas sngar lam bya dga' gsol ras stsal lam dang / las khungs khag gis gyod zhib dpyad pa'i las shog bla phyag nas zhu len byas yod na khrims 'degs kyi yong 'bab bla phyag la 'bab pa bcas gong gsal rtsa ba'i yong 'astab kyi thog nas lo ltar bla phyag bang mdzod g.yang khang mdo sbug tu bkar 'jug zhu skabs rtse zhod bka' shag bcas kyi sku tshab zhus te sbyag dam 39

dang bka' tham 'byar mar bsdu 'jug dang 'brel〈ma deb〉dang 〈budeb 〉so sor brjod 'god zhu dgos/ de snga bla phyag las khungs nas 'bru rtsam gnyis kyi bsdu gtong byed kyi yod 'dug kyang / phyis dmag phogs las khungs dang /rtsam bzhes las khungs zur 'dzugs byas stabs smon tshogs skabs zhib chag (nas chag) gi rgyu 'bru tsam las bsdu gtong mi dgos/ lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i gtong gzhi gzhung thog nas 'gan bzhes gnang ba nas bzung 'char can gtong sgo'i thog dad 'dus sbyin bdag khag gi zhal 'debs ja mar/ sha rtsam gang yod/ lag gtong sku 'gyed bcas skabs 'phral 'dus tshogs su smin 'bul zhu dgos pa dang / gzhung thog nas rnam kun krig car ma dngul zur 'jog gis sku 'gyed 'bul dgos khag dang / mdzod sbug nas spyan bsal sku 'gyed 'char 'phar khag de snga bal bod hor gsum dad sbyin khag nas smon tshogs dge 'dun re'i phyag tu sku 'gyed dngul ṭam re 'bul rgyu'i ma dngul sngar lam ṭam rdo drug brgya drug cu re drug re 'bul dgos pa ltar ma dngul bcas bla phyag las khungs su deb bkod byas thog lo ltar 'gyed gtong byed dgos kyang / phyis 'gyed dngul ma rtsa sbyor 'bul zhu mi mang stabs bla phyag las khungs nas bsdu gtong rgya 'ubs ma 'dus pas rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu rta(1942) lo thebs sbyar las khungs zhes do dam res 'khor dza sag ser skya gnyis dang / drung rtsis gnyis/ mkhan rim gnyis/ las bya ser skya nyi shu skor bcas gsar 'dzugs kyis lcags lug(1931) lo phan gyi ma dngul rnams bla phyag las khungs nas do dam byed rgyu dang / lcags lug tshun gyi byung dang 'byung rgyu'i ma dngul rnams thebs sbyar las khungs nas do dam byas te lo lo'i skyed 'bab bla phyag las khungs su rtsis sprod dgos pa'i 'gan dakhri byas yod pa red/ da dung bla phyag las khungs nas rwa sa gtsug lag khang dang / rwa che soṭa 40

lha /bang khag gi rgyun mchod dang / 'char 'phar stong mchod khag smon lam 'phar tshugs/ gzhan yang bstan srid kyi zhabs rim khag dpal lha/ rme rnying sogs lcog khag gi rgyun gtan lha mi'i mchod phogs/ dga' ldan gyi rgyun ja rtse phyag las khungs nas gtong dgos phud/ se 'bras tshogs chen gyi rgyun ja dang se 'bras dga' gsum gyi rgyun thug gi dgos mkho zur du bstsal ba phud/dga' ldan gser sdong chen mo dang se 'bras dga' gsum gyi tshogs chen khag gi rten gtso'i dkar me/ snyan shal dang de dag la 'char can gyi zla ja/ zla mar/ de bzhin nye 'khor ri khrod che chung khag la rgyun gtan lha mi'i mchod phogs rgyun gtong yod mus thog dbyar dus char 'bebs rgyun tshugs kyi dgos cha zur du gtong deb gzhir bzung sprod dgos pa sogs bla phyag las khungs kyi phyi nang gtong 'gros che shos ni gtso bo lha mi'i(lha dang mchod 'bul pa dge 'dun)mchod phogs kho na red/bla phyag las khungs khongs bla brang khang gnyer rtse drung gcig dang / bzo khang do dam rtse drung gcig yod pa dang / khang gnyer gyi las 'gan ni bla steng rtse gzim chung khag dang / 'gag e wam tshoms chen phun tshogs 'dod 'khyil/ tshoms chen khams gsum gzil gnon/ gzhan yang bla phyag las khungs kyi mdzod khang steng shod bar gsum dang / khyams rwa bcas kyi pho brang le lag la do dam thog khang gnyer gnyer tshang las khungs kyi nang zan gcig rtse shod khyams rwa bsdoms gad pa mi grangs nyi shu skor gyi 'go 'doms kyang byed dgos/bzo khang do dam rtse drung des lha sar yod pa'i lha bris dang / 'tshem bzo yongs kyi 'go 'dzin gyis srid gzhung gi gzhung las che chung rnam grangs ga 'dra zhig yod kyang / lha bris pa dang / 'tshem bzo'i khongs nas mi grangs ji dgos gtong dgos pa dang / gzhung las batho mi'i khongs med pa'i sger gyi 'tshem 4spre

las sam/ lha bris pa yod na so so'i lag shes chu tsharwa 9ka gzhigs pa'i bzo khang par lag khrul rgyag dgos pa bcas red/bsher khang las khungs/bsher khang las khungs ni dbus gtsang sogs rgya khyab yongab/ la mi gsod rkyen thal byung rigs kyi dmigs bsal thag gcod byed pa'i las khungs shig yin/ der gnas lnga pa'i las tshan pa'i go thob yod pa shod drung gnyis dang /do dam so sos sger btsugs kyi drung yig gnyis/ shar rgyud khang gnyer dang gad pa bcas mi grangs bcu skor yod/ sa gnas gang du mi gsod thal cha byung tshe spyi khyab bka' shag las khungs su snyan zhu 'byor bstun snyan zhu'i yig cha dang sbrags bsher dpang las khungs nas 'dri gcod dgos pa'i bka' phab kyi yod cing / des sa gnas nye 'gyangs gang du yin rung dza drag che chung la gzhigs pas rta shad a drung dang / bkod rgya zhus te do bdag le 'khri dang bcas pa bskong 'gugs thog zhib brtsad bcad de le can byed gter khrims yig zhal lce gzhir bzung phyogs lhung med pa'i nyes chad lci yang gi 'char gzhi bkod de srid skyong yod na bka' shag brgyud shod 'gag tu phul te srid skyong gi phyag rtags zhu dgos pa dang / de min bka' shag gi chog mchan zhu dgos/ mi bsad skor gyi gyod don che chung gang 'dra zhig yin rung bsher dpang las khungs nas gong bzhin thag gcod byed dgos pa dang / gzhan yang jo bo shākya nu/ nis gtsos gcug lag khang sku/ sku brnyan che chung khag gi dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ do t+yā/'a/ sogs rab 'bring khag dang / gser gyi lhung bzed/ mdun sgrigs gser dngul gyi mchod kong dang / mchod ting /snyeḥ

gser ngang mu tig gi maṇ+ḍal/ jo bo'i mu tig gi sku'i snam sbyar sogs rgyun bar ‘ ga ba rngo/ 0/sngu/ma yī sku'i na bza' nyer spyad/ lhag par jo rnga ḍosde dbu rgyan /snyan rgyan/ makul rgyan khag la rin thang bral ba'i phra pha lam dang / mu tigagazi/ g.yu byur/ bod g.yu/ spos shel sogs re re bzhin〈rten deb〉tu 'khod pa ltar bsher dpang las khungs nas zhib bsher gyis rten sgam la dam bsnan thog dkon gnyer dpon la rtsis sprod byed dgos pa dang / gsar du 'bul sbyo ra dbu rgyan snyan rgyan sogs 'bul spam che rigs smos med thog tha na g.yu byur rdog grangs re gnyis yan〈rten deb〉la bkod de bka' shag gi dam zhu byed dgos pa bcas red/ rtsis khang las khungs/de yang snga sor dbus gtsang sogs rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khag la sa tho zhib gzhung dang / khrul rigs sgrub lam sogs zhib phra'i kang grangs kyi gtan la phab pa zhig dang / bkar rgya dang / yong sdud/ bogs bsdu gsum gyi 'bab deb/ 'brog thang thogs rigs kyi ga gzhung(phyugs zog mgo grangs kyi gzhung khra)sogs rtsa 'dzin 'pher ba'i yig cha cher med kyang / rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta(1642) lo dga' ldan pho brang pa dbu brnyes rjes sa gnas srid gzhung gi chab srid kyi go rim dang / spang blangs kyi byed sgo phra zhib ston pa gnang ba'i nang nas mdo stod/ mdo smad dang / dbus gtsang dwags kong soṭa la sa mi zhib gre/cod /spag bgos kyis mngags te rdzong gzhis rngo/ ga gi sa ming dang /khrul rigs sgrub lam/ mnga' khongs ser skya so so'i sngar gyi sa khang bdag thob gang yod rang so /ra bzhag ste gzhung sge ra cho rnga/ gamu ma so so'i 'dzin dbang bdag 43
