thob dbye 'byed dang 'brel sa khang / 'brog thang gi ri klung bdag thob dang /rdzong gzhis sa khul so so'i thon khungs rnam grangs ji yod bcas rab byung de ga'i me khyi (1646) tsam nas 'go btsugs tedz+nyos tho zhib gzhung〉rim par bkod pa rnams la he bag sbug 'dren dang / thal lus yod med sogs rtsis dang yi ge'i lam nas gtan la 'bebs dgos pa ltar las don 'di rang la dmigs bkar rtsis kyi las khungs shig ched btsugs thog bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtsa ba'i dpal 'byor 'byung rtsa zhing 'brog gnyis kyi thon skyed la brten rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khag gi〈sa tho zhib gzhung 〉dang / rkang 'don gyi grangs 'bor/ 〈sgo khru mi gzhung〉/ bkar yong bogs gsum gyi('bab deb〉lho byang stod smad 'brog thang so so'i sa rgya che chung dang / rtswa chu bzang zhan bcas rdzong dang / tsho shog sde khag so so'i khongs su sbra dud re re bzhin/gnag phyugs/ rta mdzo/ ra lug bcas gang yod kyi mgo grangs ga gzhung dang /mi tho bcas mdor na ker leb skur gsum(mi sa phyugs gsum) gyi khrul sner gtogs pa'i 'bab deb sogs rtsa 'dzin yig cha gsar sgrig byas pa de dag la lo lnga drug re'i mtshams su zhing 'brog gnyis khongs sa zhing dang / phyugs grangs 'phel sgrib la gzhigs pas bskyar du zhib gzhung gsar 'god dang /mgo rtsis bya dgos pa dang / rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khag la lo ltar gzhis 'bru bkar 'jug mi sna dang / khrul sne brgya phrag brgal ba'i yong sdud mi sna bsko rdzong gis gzhis 'bru'i thon tshad mtho dma' dang / yong 'bab lag sdud che chung rtsis khang las khungs nas zhib 'jug byas te rje 'bangs gnyis lo'i lhag bsam gyi khrul 'bab spus 'bor gnyis ldan dus thog bsdu len byas pa rnams la bya dga' dang / rdzong gzhis so so'i gzhis 'bru'i thon tshad dma' ba dang /yong khrul spus zhan sla bcos kyis 'bab khungs rtse shod phyagye/ mdzod khag la mo 44

ltar chad thog chad brtsegs kyi sgrigs 'bul ji bzhin ma byung ba rnams la sun phyung ba'i sgo nas byas byung rnam dbye'i go rim ma 'dres par ston pa'i gdan thob dang / gnang cha'i rim pa/ mdor na 'thung sdod bzang zhan dbye ba'i thon bskor gral gyi rim pa ang gi dang po'i gras la gdan grum 'jab thog stag gdan/ 'thung sgod dkar sang yu ring / mdzod btags legs pa'i sba dar/'bru gzhor khal 15bal bskor ba'i gnang cha/ ang gnyis pa'i gras la gdan dang 'thung sgod gong bzhin thog bsod btags legs pa'i sba dar/ 'bru gshor khal 1ri0la bskor ba'i gnang cha/ ang gsum pa'i gras la gdan sngo grum 'jab ring / 'thung snod sngo khru yu ring / bsod btags legs pa'i sba dar/ 'bru gshor khal 110la bskor ba'i gnang cha bstsal ba sogs ang dang po nas drug pa bar gdan dang / gnang cha go rim bzhin sgrigs pa dang /ang bdun pa'i gras su rdzong gzhis che 'bring gang 'dra zhig yin rung / gdan med/ 'thung sgod dwags po'i can ni/ gzhis 'bru'i thon tshad/ yong khrul sogs kyi chad rjob che chung la gzhigs pas rtsa ba'i gzhung 'bab nas nyes chad drug zur/ brgyad zur/ bcu zur re 'gel dgri byed dgos pa sogs 'char 'phar las 'gan che bas rab byung 1shrīs yos(1699) lo nas bzung rtsis khang las khungs su do dam rtsis dpon mi gsum(srid skyong rwa sgreng dus las 'phar gcig bcas bzhi)dang / rtsis pa gsum/ yig tshags gcig bcas las grub pa'i rtsis khang phun tshogs bkod pa zhes gsar du btsugs te sngar yod las 'gan thogashod skor yab gzhis/ sde dpon mi drag sger drag 'bring dkyus gsum bcas gzhung zhabs shod drung gi khongs su gtogs pa rnams la 'go 'doms kyis pha gzhis rjes 'brel zhabs sdod ngo 'gro yod med zhib bsher byas te zhabs sdod med rigs la lo gnyis gsum ring ngo dod ces rten gnas rgya khyon che chung la 4ca

gzhigs pa'i dngul ṭam dkar srang 1rngi5nas sra nga 175bar rtse yig tshang las khungs su phul thog de nas gzhung zhabs rigs rus khungs ldan gyi zhabs zhu byed dgos pa las zhabs rten ming stong du bzhag mi/ chog shod drung zhabs sdod zhu dmigs kyi bu phrug thog mar sger gnyer slob grwar btang thog phal cher lo grangs bcu nas bco lnga skor la slebs mtshams yig rtsis sbyong brdar dang /gzhung zhabs kyi sgrigs lam mig stos goms 'dris kyi slad du rtsis phrug pa zhes thog ma'i yig tshad rdol rgyugal phul te rtsis khang las khungs su zhugs thog de nal yig rtsis bskyar sbyong gis rgyugs lon mtshams zhabs zhu zhu dgos/ rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khag gi gzhis 'bru'i ma deb rtsis khang las khungs su yod stabs dmag phogs sogs gzhung mkho'i 'bru rigs 'don sprod gang yod kyi bcug bton rtsis khang las khungs su zhu dgos pa dang / bar skabs sger chos khag la dmigs bsal gyi byas rjes sa sdon/ sa tshab sogs ming 'dogs sna tshogs kyi sa zhing drag gras gzhung khongs nas phyir chod mang ba dang / rka chad/ bye non du gyur pa/ gzhung rgyugs nang khul rkang grangs gcig mtshungs yin rung / sa zhing do mi stoms pa'i gnas tshul sogs gzhung 'bangs spyi byings rnams la khrul riṭa sgrub 'gan mi bzod pa'i dka' ngal ci che byung rkyen slar yang rab byung 14pa'i lcags stag(1830) lo dbus gtsang rgya khyab sa leb rtsis kyis sger chos 'don thog 'don bsgril byas pa rnams 'dur slong (byas rjes sa snon sogs gsar chod byung rigs khag gcig 'don grangs ma bzos par sbug zornga dran 'dru/la gyis sngar yod sa zhing thog bsgril ba de rigs lcags stag zhib gzhung bzo skabs rgyug pa leb 'dur gyis 'don kha bslangs par 'dur zhes zer) dang 'brehā/ sgrub bzhin pa'i rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khrul rigs dang / sa rten he bag yod med/ chag cha gtong 'os che min skabs so so'i gtan tshigs yig rigs la zhib 'jug byas te phyin chad sa khang 46

'khrigs/ gnas byed dang mi byed bcas sgrub chag 'dzags gsum gtan 'bibasajibyas pa'i rtsegs sta ga rtsa 'dzin zhib /kazhung gsar bkod byar+sā pa dang / de mtshungs bsdu nga/ tong las khungs che chung khag dang / rgya khyab rdzong gzhis bcas 'a/ bre 'o ba/ srang 'etre/ga mi byung ba'i rtsis khang las khungs nas bre srang tshad 'beb 'ju ga gco na byed dgos/ lhag par bod ljo/ngas tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms dang /hrag bsdurngage rgyas pa bcas srid gzhung gi tshogs 'du gal che'i skabs su rtse mkhan drung bzhi dang / rtsis dpon bzhi nas tshogs 'du'i 'go 'doms byed dgos/ pa ma zad/ skabs 'gar gzhung don gal che'i skor la drung rtsis brgyad sbrel dang / de min bzhi sbre'/ dang nyis sbrel 'tshob/ dgos pa/ gzhan yang rtse rnam gan dang / zhib khang / grwa bzhi dngul khang / 'bab zhib/ bde zhib/thebs sbyar bcas las khungs khag la'ang rtsis dpon re phebs te gcig lcogs byed dgos pa bcas red/ sna/zhib khang las khungs/byub khang las khungs ni do dam rtse skor mkhan che gcig dang / rtsis dpon gcigre/ las bya rtse mgron gcig rtsis pa gcig rtse drung gnyis bcas las grub pa zhig yin zhing / de'i las 'gan ni sa gnas srid gzhung dang /phyogs mtha'i spyi khyab dang / rdzong gzhis khag bcas /kyi 'dzugs skrun las khungs che chung khag sigs gzhung gron gtong dgos pa'i rigs dang / gzhan yang bsdu gtong las khungs khag gi lo re'i gtong yong rtsis khru khungs so sdos bka' shag tu phul bar bka' shag nas der 'byor tshes bkag ste zhib khang la bstsal ba de dag 9spru byung song za 'bor kha 'thab kyi lhag chad he bag yod med zhib khang 47

las khungs nas rtsis khru 'bul mkhan do dam mi sna dngajimanyam du rtsis zhu zhib 'jug gis lhag chad gsal po gtan la phab ste slar yang rtsis khru bka' shag tu phul thog gzhi nas rtsis khrur dag mchan zhu dgos pa dang / lha zhol grong khyer dang / las khungs so so'i 'brel yod gyod don phud/ de byings phyogs mtha'i rdzong gzhis khag nal gyod don snyan zhu bka' shag tu 'byor rigs rnams zhib khang las khungs su bstsal te zhib dpyad 'char 'bul zhu dgos pa red/de snga'i bod nga/mag gi gnas tshul/ bod 'dir snga rabs btsan po'iriskabs su dmag don sgrig gzhi rgya che la dpung stobs btsan pa sogs kyi lo rgyus yod kyang 'dir ma spros/ bod sil bu'i skabs nas bzung bar skabs dmag don sgrig gzhi cha tshang ldan pa'i gcig gyur gyi dmag dpung zhig med kyang rab byung 10lcags phag(1617) lo tsam la gtsang pa'i dus kyi rgyal thog gnyis pa phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi skabs khal kha tshu khur sog dmag bod 'dzul mthar sprod gtong skabs su stod gtsang khul nas rta rkang zhes sa rten la 'gel dkri byas pa'i dmags rta mi go rang 'grigs dmag grangs sum stong drug brgya skor bskong 'gug byas te seng ge rtse g.yas ru dang po'i khongs sogs g.yas ru dang / g.yon ru'i dmag mi 'khri khungs khyim tshang dang yul tshan so so/ dmag 'gro'i mi ming lo grangs dang bcas pa'i dmag gzhung bkod de lhun po rtse/ seng ge rtse/ rta nag rin chen rtse sogs rtse gsum sgar dpon gyis sne drangs khru dpon dang / lding dpon bcas kyi go ming sprad thog lo ltar zla dang po nang nyang smad bsam grub rtser sdebs 'dzoms kyis zla gnyis ring go bsher dmag sbyong byed pa dang / dmag rtsal 48

stso nga baṣ+pe/ra byed pa'i dmigs yul ni skabs der nyen kha che shos sog demag la kha gtad gcog rgyu de yin stabs gi sgra ring thung dang / dza drag che chung gi sgra dang bstun te rta thog nas rgyang ring me mda' 'phen rgyu dang / 'phrul mdung lung ring klad la bskor nas 'phen rgyu/ rta thog gri rtsed bcas red/('di gtsa'i dus skabs kyi gzhis rdzong go mdzod dkar deb 'go brjod du gsal) de rjes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i skabs sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos pho brang yas mas la nyen srung bskor g.yeng dang / gzim sgo spung ba bcas kyi las 'gan yod pa'i zhol bskor gzim pa dang / gzim pa dngos gzhi ni yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung gi nang tshan rkang dmag gam/ dpung bu chung zer ba'i dmag dpung gsar 'dzugs bskyangs shing / de dag gi 'khri khungs ni lho kha khul gra phyi nang dang / lce zhol/ gong dkar/ chu shur/ gnam/ ljang / mnyes thang / rnam sgang / sne'u/ stod lung bde chen rdzong / shun pa 'du khongs bcas nas thog ma'i dmag gzhung nang gsal dmag grangs nyis stong brgya skor gtong dgos kyi yod kyang / phyis dmag rten rka chad/ bye non dang / sger chos khag la phyir chod mang ba sogs la brten dmag grangs bzhi brgya lnga bcu skor las med pa red/gzim pa 'di bzhin las 'gan lci la rnam kun sgrigs khrims dam pa dang / khrub rmog mda' gri mdung gsum dang / phub bcas drag chas cha tshang spral te dmag sbyong rnam grangs mang po rgyugs sprod byed dgos pa sogs kyi rkyen pas dmag 'gro'i thad dbang po skyon med kyi grong mi khungs ldan zhe ga ci4/ las gang byung gi gla pa gtong bde mi chog pa sogs kyi gtan 'bebs bzos yong/ pa dang / gzim rten rkang rer son khal 1risdeskor la phyi nang khrul rigs rtsa chag bstsal ba sogs dmigs bsal chen po yod pa'i dmag dpung 49

zhig ram̐d/ de rjes jun gar dmag bod na tra/ mthar bskrad rjes shar a mdo stod zhi smad nas nub sger rtse bar byas so nyen rtog pa ring thung 'dzugs dgos kyi so gzhung gtan 'a bebs nang gsal dmag grangs brgyad brgya drug cu skor la rang khungs rdzong 'go tro/ so ri nang khral yong 'bab thog nas dmag phogs sprod dgos pa dang / ga yul 'gyed skabs g.yul sa na ṭ+wāṃshaṃ phob pa'i dngos po che phra dmag don byas rjes su 'go dmag nye stoms kyis bgos chog pa'i dmag srol yod pa red/ thog mar byang dmag gsar 'dzugs skabs dmag rten nor lug grangs bcad kyi khrul 'khri med par tsho shog so so ra rtsis sprod yod stabs phyis byang so ring thung gi so mi tsam las de byings dgos gal nam byung mtshams skong 'gugs bya rgyu las rnam kuca/ rang khungs su slo ga pa de dag gi sa nas dmag dod babs mtshungs bsdu len byed lam yod/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa dang srid skyong rta tshag bstan pa'i mgon po'i sku dus su bod du gor dmag gi btsan 'dzul snga phyi byung stabs man ching gong ma chan lung gi bkas mngags blon chen phu si krung thang gis bod skyong byed sgo'i sgrig yi ga don tshan nyer dgu gtan 'bebs byas pa'i nang tshan rgyal mtshams brtan srung ched bod rang khungs nas dmag dpung rtsa 'dzugs byed dgos pa'i dgongs don ltar rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags khyi(1790)lo rgya sbyong bod dmag sum stong gsar 'dzugre/sa bya rgyur gtan 'khel gyis/ dbus gtsang rdzong gzhis so so'i de snga'i sa tho khag la zhib 'jug thog gzhung sger chos gsum leb bsdur gyis 7/nga grangs mang nyung la gzhigs pas dmag dang / 'dur(dmag rkang min pa'i gzhung sger chos gsu ma gyi sa zhing yongs la)zer zhes zhi drag khrul rten dbye bcad cha gses thog dmag rteca/ dbus gtsang 'dra ba rer sa rab 'bring la ga giṭa 60

pas son /bal lnga bcu nas bdun cu'i bar dang / 'khri tu/ ngas so sos dmag 'gro go sgang re ngo 'dzugs byas phyin de byings kyi khrul rigs rtsa chag btang ba dang / nga/ magle mi'i rtsis 'khri'i go lag sogs bor brlag so/nga rigs dmag 'khri so sos khungs sgrig byed dgos pa bcas kyi dmag shog bka' tham 'byar ma re dmag 'khri do bdag so sor sprad de dbus khul nas dmag grangarnga chig stong tham pa dang / gzhis rtse nas dmag grangs chig stong tham pa/ rgyal rtse nas dmag grangs snga brgya tham pa/ ding ri nas dmag grangs lnga brgya bcas bsdus thog dmag grangs lnga brgya rer spyi khyab mda' dpon re dang / ru dpon gnyis/brgya dpon lnga/ lding dpon nyi shu/ bcu dpon lnga bcu tham pa re rtsis dbus mda' dpon gnyis/ gzhis rtse mda' dpon gnyis/ rgyal rtse mda' dpon gcigading ri mda' dpon gcig bcas spyi khyab mda' khag drug yod pa dang / 'go dmag gi phogs thob thad spyi khyab mda' dpon so sor mda' gzhis re/ ru dpon man dang / dmag dkyus 'dra ba rer zla re 'bru khal gnyis bre bcu/ ja mar 'os 'tshams/ sha dod dngul zho do stsa/ra lnga re rtsis ru dpon la ngo skal lnga/ brgya dpon la gsum/ lding bcu 'dra bar ngo ska'/ gnyis re bcas 'go dmag gzhis byes gang du 'gro sdod byas rung gzhung phogs khang nas dmag phogs rgyag dgos pa dang / dbyar dgun spyon chas dmag 'khri so sos lo ltar sprod dgos pa/ skabs de'i dmag mi'i dmag rtsed dang / sgrig srol ni man ching gong ma'i dmag srol ltar lag bstar byed kyi yod pa red/ gong gsal rgya sbyong bod dar+ṣa/ka sum stong tham pa gsar 'dzugs byas pa dang chabs cig phogs khang gsar ridzags kyi do dam mkhan chung gcig dang / rim bzhi gcig las bya se ra skya ngazhi bcas yod pa de dag gi gtso bo'i las 'gan ni dbus gtsang khul dmag phogs ma dngul gsar 'dzugs byas pa'i lo lo'i bskyed 'bab bsdu len 51

gyis dmag sgar so sor dngul phogs dus thog tu rgyag dgos pa dang / skabs der gtsang dmag khongs nas gro mo sa srung du lding khag gnyis gsum tsam ma gtogs de byings dmag dpung tshang ma phyogs thon ma dgos par dbus gtsang rang du sdod mus la brten rtsa ba'i dmag phogs ni gtsang khu/ la 'brum pho lha gzhis dang / rgya shar gter sna gzhis/ rgyal rtse nub gling gzhis/ snye mo smon mkhar gzhis 'og 'brong rdzong shar nub/ dbus khul stod lung nyan sgang skyid gzhis/ mthong smon chu 'khor gzhis/ skyid gshong shar phyogs gzhis/ sne gdong ban rtsa gzhis bcas kyi gzhis 'bru'i thog nas rgyag dgos pa dang / de dag gis 'dum min byung na 'bru 'bor ji dgos do dam pas bka' shag la snyan seng dang 'brel khad nye'i rdzong gzhis khag gi bcu zur gzhis 'bru'i bkar steng nas bton rgya zhus te phogs dpon mkhan rim res mos kyis lo ltar gtsang khul 'bru dngul phogs rgyag tu bskyod dgos pa/ phogs dpon rim bzhir pha gzhis rten gnas dang 'brel ba yod stabs dmigs bsal phogs thob med cing /mkhan chung la stod lung sgang skyid gzhis nas lo re 'bal gro ru'i khal miju0dang / lci rgyab 75re sprod lam yod pa bcas red/de rjes rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu byi(1912)lo lu'u cun rgya dmag mthar 'bud btang rjes chu glang(1913)lo tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po ston 'khor rgya gar nas lha sar zhabs sor 'khod rjes lha sa'i dmag don spyi khyab mkhan drung byams pa bstan dar la dmag don byas rjes su bka' blon bla ma bsko gzhag thog mdo smad khul gyi zhi drag spyi 'doms su las bya dpon rigs dang bcas bsko rdzong gnang tshab spyan bsal gnam gang zla bzang dgra 'dul la dza sag thog dmag spyi che ba'i gnas go dang / rtsis dpon khri smon nor bu dbang rgyal la tha'i ji'i thog dmag spyi chung ba'i go gnas bcas bsko 6ཿ

gzhag gis bod ljongs dmag spyi khang zhes rtse po ta la'i mdun ngos zhol go mdzod rdo rje gling du drag po'i spyi 'doms las khungs gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad/ thog mar las khungs der rgyun tshugs las bya'i khongs su dmag drung gnyis/ las bya rtse drung gnyis/ lha sdod dmag sgar khag nas yig 'bri sding dpon kha shas/ phyis 'phar las bya shod skor rim bzhi gcig dang / rtse skor las tshan pa gcig bcas las grub cing / las khungs de'i gtso bo'i las 'gan ni srid gzhung de'i drag dpung khag gi spyi khyab 'go 'doms byed dgos pa dang /lha sdod ngamag sgar dang / phyogs thon dmag sgar khag gi phogs 'bru skyel 'dren dang / dbyar dgun gyon bsdu/ go lag rdzas mdel skyel 'dren gyi dos rta lam yig sogs las khungs de nyid brgyud bka' shag nas zhu dgos pa/ dmag sgar khag gi mda' dpon bsko 'then bka' shag nas 'char phul gyis tā la'i bla ma'i phyag rtags zhu dgos pa dang / ru dpon bsko 'then skabs dmag spyi khang nas 'char phul gyis bka' shag gi phyag rtags zhu dgos pa/ brgya sding gnyis dmag spyi khang nas bsko 'then byed lam/ chu byi 1912lo nas bzung mdo smang khul sa srung rgya che khag bgos kyis gtong dgos pa dang / lha sar gtan sdod tā la'i bla ma'i sku srung dmag sgar/ grong khyer bde 'jags srung — dmag bcas kyi dgos mkhor gzhigs te de snga'i bod dmag sum stong tham pa'i thog 'don dmag nyis sna/ bzhi sna/ brgyad sna/ bcu gnyis drug sna(gzhung rgyugs rkang bcu gnyis dang / sger chos 'don drug la zer)/ gzim pa sding dpon gyi dmag rten/ grong drag dmag dpung bcas bsnan ka dang sku srung dmag sgar nas ma dang grong drag dmag sgar bar gsar 'dzugs 'phar sdon byas pa red/dmag rtsed ni de snga dbyin ji'i skad brda'i dmag rtsed yin rung / de rjes bod skad du bsgyur ba dang / ka dang sku srung dmag sgar tsam ma gtogs de byings 53

dmag sgar tshang ma'i gyon chas bod zhu ga sa zhe gcika red/dmag mi gsar 'dzugs byed phyogs dang / rnam kun 'go dmangs so so'i sgrigs srol/ go bab lam lu gas/ phyogs thon skabs nyin ltar thon dngacirting gi sgrigs 'dzugs ldan pa'i 'go nas shar bskyod byed pa las/ lam 'khel yul 'brog gang sar dmag dmangs rang dgar 'gro bskyod mi chog pa sogs sngar nas sgrigs lam yod rung / phyis dmag khrims gnon sdem dang / dmag rtsal sbyong brdar sogs dus bstun gsar bcos ma gnang mthu med kyis rab byung 1stolcags stag 1949lo dmag khrims don tshan sum cu so lnga gsar sgrig byas pa gsham gsal dang / de snga dbus gtsang mda' dpon so sor phogs rten mda' gzhis re yod kyang / phyis mda' dpon rim 'phar la brten mda' dpon rer lo re phogs dngul srang dgu brgya re bstsal te mda' gzhis so sor spyi 'gre'i 'bab bzo mdzad/ de snga bod dmag ri0sde0las med kyang / phyis dmag grangs rim 'phar la brten rab byung 1'is lug(1919)lo zhol spyi phogs khang btsugs pa der do dam mkhan rim gnyis dang / las bya ser skya gnyis/khang gnyer/ 'bo kha/ gad pa bcas mi grangs bcu skor yod cing / de'i gtso bo'i las 'gan ni 'phan po dang byang stag lung / lho kha khul gyi rdzong gzhis khag dang / bstan bla gzhung chod gzhis khag gi gzhis 'bru'i bkar steng nas lha sdod dmag sgar khag gi phogs 'bru bton rgya zhus te spyi phogs khang du gsog nyar byas thog dmag phogs dus thog tu rgyag dgos pa dang / phogs dngul ji dgos 'dzin sgyur gyis lor khang nas zhu dgos pa bcas red/ 54

lha sa gnyer tshang las khungs/lha gnyer rtse drung gnas lnga pa'i las tshan pa gcig dang / shod drung las tshan pa gnyis/ drung yig drung tog yod pa gcig gnyer tshang nang zan nyi shu skor bcas yod pa de dag gis gtso bo ni gtsugs lag khang steng shod bar gsum la me rkun srung 'doms byed dgos pa dang / rgyun gtan khyams ra dang /se ra ltag sgo sogs kyi gad khungs khag la 'go 'doms gnyer tshang nang zan re 'jog dgos pa ma zad/ dgong dro rtag par mtshan mo'i chu tshod 10tsam la lha gnyer ngo ma gcig dang nang zan kha shas bcas nas gtsug lag khang gi sgo rwa ba dang / khang gnyer/ gad pa/ lha khang khag gi dkon gnyer bcas sa khungs so sor bsdad yod med dang me rkun gnyis la gzab grung dgos pa'i bskor g.yeng yang byed dgos pa/ lho brag seng ge rdzong dang / do rdzong / lha khang gzhis/ kong po jo rtse zho gsum(jo mo rdzong / rtse la rdzong / zho kha gzhis sdod)bcas nas 'bab deb nang gsal gyi spang leb spyan spang dang / dkyus spang / mal gro rdzong khongs nas rdza chas me tog khog ma g.yu rtsi ser po dang ljang khu che chung sna tshogs/ 'jag ma dang / sug pa bcas bsdu len gyis pho brang yas mas kyi thugs mkhor 'bul dgos pa/ grong khyer lha sa'i srang lam khag la sa 'og btsog chu shar gtong thub pa'i chu yur nyams gso dang / gsang spyod gsar rgyag gzhan yang sger khang rgya bskyed kyi rkyen pas khrom lam dang srang lam khag la gnod rkyen mi yong ba'i bkag 'gog tshod 'jin byed dgos pa/ lha gnyer res bskor gyis lo ltar smon lam spyi khyab pa re 'gro dgos pa/ gzhan yang mtshams khung dgon gyi btsun ma dang / lha sdod hu'e rigs kyi 'go 'doms byed dgos pa bcas red/56

snang rtse shag snang shag las khungs su mi dpon gnas lnga pa'i shod drung las tshan pa gnyis dang / drung yig gcig gnyer pa gnyis/ khang gnyer gcig pu li si dmag sgar brgya dpon gcig bcasdo mnyam 'dzoms dang / de 'og rags stobs 'go pa mi gcig bskor bya ba mi grangs nyi shu skor/ btson srung pa gcig rags stobs 'go pas bskor bya ba dang / rags stobs pa/ pi gtong ba rnams kyi 'go 'dzin byed dgos/ las khungs de'i gtso bo'i las 'gan ni/ lha sa grong khyer lte ba'i khongs kyi khrims 'doms byed sgo spyi dang /lhag par bde 'jags thog lha sa grong khyer nang sa cha khag bgos kyis bskor mkhan sa res zhes bskor bya ba re yod pa des so so'i sa cha'i thog gnas tshul ji byung dus thog las khungs su snyan seng zhu bar yong dgos pa dang / de bzhin sa gnas 'du 'gag che sar pu li si dmag mi re nyin mtshan rtag sdod kyis sa gnas khag bgos thog re mos kyis nyin mtshan kun tu bskor g.yeng du 'gro dgos pa/ gtso bo bde 'jags dang gtsang sbra'i thog blta zhib dang bskul lcag byed dgos/mi gsod rkun jag gi gnas tshul tshabs che thon skabs snang shag nas bka' shag la dgongs skor snyan seng dang 'brel zhib dpyad 'char 'bul zhu dgos pa dang / chung rtsag rnams snang shag las khungs rang nas thag gcod byed dgos shing / grong khyer nang chang ma grangs bcad khyim tshang dgu bcu tham pa gtan 'bebs thog zla re'i chang khrul bsdu len gyis rtsis zhu byed dgos pa r+pā

pacas/rab byung 15me lug(1907)lo ching gong ma'i bkas mngags bod don zhib dbyo da blon chen krang dbying thang(krang ta rin yang zer)gis srid skyong dga' ldan khri zur blo bzang rgyal mtshan dang / bka' shag la go bsdur dang 'brel bod ljongs bstan srid 'phel thabs su slob gso dang / sbyong brdar/ bzo tshong / 'brel gtugs/ lam bzo nags las/ so nam/ bde srung / dngul khang / ja tshwa bcas las khungs khag dgu gsar 'dzugs bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas rung / skabs der tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog rgya sog yul grur chibs sgyur bskyangs pas las khungs de dag dngos su tshugs thub med kyang / de rjes chu glang(1913)lo gong gsal las khungs dgu'i gras nas so las dang / ja tshwa/ dngul khang bcas gsar 'dzugs byas pa red/so nam las khungs/mi so'i(mi rtsa dang so nam skor do dam byed pa'i bsdus ming)las khungs ni spyi khyab do dam mkhan rim gnyis dang / las rogs las tshan ser skya gnyis/las bya ser skya bzhi/ drung yig gnyis bcas las grub cing / las khungs de'i gtso bo'i las 'gan ni rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khongs sger chos('byed khru〉dang /gzhung rgyugs〈zhib gzhung 〉nang gsal gyi bdag thob yod pa'i sa rigs phud/de byings sa stong dge bed spyod yul gang yod la 'brel mtshungs yul mi so sos khul tshod kyi gsar sbol rgya khyon gtan 'khel gyis sa zhing la so nam las khungs nas lag 'dzin blangs thog 'debs lo nas lo gsum bogs med dang / de nas son /rigro rdog bskor gyis sa rab 'bring la gzhigs pas thon tshad 'bring 67

bskor gyi lo re gzhung 'bab bcu zur ra sprad phyin sbra/ 'a—ren katan 'jags kyi sger bdag chog pa dang / phyugs lug gi rtswa za'i dase/ bed spyod yul khashaṃ gnod skyon ma byung phyin ri thang gang 'os su shing 'dzugs nakas bzo bya rgyu/ lhag par gzhung lam khag dang / grong dang grong rdal gyi 'gro lam/ khang skor bcas la sbyar lcang 'debs 'dzugs kyis 'brel mtshungs yul mi so sor rtsis sprod byas te lo re'i son tshad mtho dma' so nam las khungs dang / sa gnas rdzong gzhis so sos rtog zhib mjug gnon bya rgyu/ de mtshungs dbus gtsang rgya khyab khongs gzhung sger chos gsum gyi mi khongs su ma tshud pa'i mi bdag 'di yin med riṭa rnams la mi gzhung gsar du bkod de sa gnas rdzong sdod so sor〈mi gzhung bu deb〉re bzhag thog lo re skyes 'chi'i mchan 'god kyis mi bogs ṭam dkar skar phyed brgyad re rdzong sdod brgyud 'bul dgos pa/ lha sa grong khul du gzhung khang dang / sger khang / lha sa tsho pa sogs kyi sger khang bston med gang yin phud/ bstan bla gzhung chod kyi khang khungs le lag dang / sa stong khag la rang mtshams kyis khang pa gsar rgyag byas rigs bcas la so nam las khungs nas do dam gyis kha 'dzin rang 'jags su bzhag thog rgya khyon la gzhigs pas gzhung khang spyi mtshungs kyi khang gla dngul ṭam dkar zhe gcig bsdu len byas te rgya khyab mi bogs dang chabs cig lo ltar rtse rnam gan bkar khongs su lo lo'i bcug khru dang sbrags bkar 'jug zhu dgos/ja tshwa las khungs/ja tshwa las khungs ni do dam dza mkhan(mkhan chung) sbrel por las rogs mgron las(rtse mgron dang las tshan pa)gnyis dang / las bya skya ser bzhi/ drung bya8

yig banyis bcas las grub cing / las khungs de'i gtso bo'i las 'gan ni tshong rigs khag gis mdo ja dang yun nan ja ril/ nyin rdu'i ja ril bcas 'don 'dren byas pa de dag nas nag chu dang / lha ri 'go 'bri gung / phag ri bcas kyi sa 'gag tu ja khrul bsdu dgos shing / phag rir do dam rdzong sdod nas glecig ltogs byed pa phud de byings sa 'gag khag la ser skya mi sna bsko rdzong gis ja rgyab rer sgo khrul bcu gnyis zur re bsdu len byas pa'i ja 'bab rnams lo ltar rtse rnam gan du bkar 'jug zhu dgos/ de mtshungs stod byang tshwa kha khag nas byang tshwa 'don 'dren byas rigs de dag nas stod gtsang dang / dbus dang dbus stod/ lho kha/ dwags kong bcas tshong lam sa 'gag gtan 'khel so sor tshwa khrul bsdu dgos shing / do dam ser skya nyi shu skor sho phe'u dang byed sgo'i lag 'khyer dang sbrags ched rdzong gis tshwa bod rgya 1'i0re yod par g.yag rgyab re dang lug rgyab drug la g.yag rgyab re rtsis rgyab rer sho khrul dngul ṭam dkar zho drug re bsdu len bgyis te tshwa 'bor gang yong tshong mi so so'i ming rtags bkod pa'i sho phe 'dra ya'i nang gsal gyi sho dngul rnams ja tshwa las /shungs su rtsis zhu khams dwangs zhus thog gong gsal ja khral dang chabs cig rtse rnam gan du bkar 'jug zhu dgos/ gal te tshong rigs khag nas ja tshwa skog 'dren gyi he bag thon gleng byung na dngos po gzhung len gyis byed 'dzol la gzhegs pa'i nyes pa gcod dgos/ dar mdo sogs nas ja son sgrub 'don gyis 'debs yul kong po dang / bya yul/ spo smad/ pad ma bkod/ rdza yul sogacha/ rong sa sa drod che la brlan gsher yod pa'i ri rong gang 'os su thog mar tshod lta'i 'debs 'dzugs yang yang byas thog grub 'bras thon re yod sar ngal gron 'dzems med kyis rgyun bsring 'debs 'dzugs byed dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs yod pa bcas red/ 59

lor khang las khungs/rab byung 15sa rta(1918)lo/ lor khang las khungs gsar du btsugs pa der do dam gung mkhan(mkhan che) sbrel po/ las bya ser skya drug yod cing /sngar phan srid gzhung gi gron dngul bcu gsum zhe drug sogs kyi ṭam dkar kho na las med kyang / phyis ar las 'dzugs skrun dang / sman rtsis khang / dmag sgar khag sogs gzhung dngul gtong gron che stabs shog dngul dang / zangs ṭam gsar du par rgyag byas pa dang / ṭam dkar yang kha ris dga' ldan pho brang 'khod pa gsar bcos byas pa red/ bod lor gyi g.yas zur du lor khang gi las tham gru nar zhig phab thog dgos dngul sprod dgos pa'i las khungs khag la bka' shag nas bka' dam 'byar ma'i bka' 'dzin thon mtshams lor khang las khungs nas dngul 'bab grangs tshad sprod dgos pa bcas red/zhol las khungs/zhol las khungs ni rab byung 11shing yos(1675)lo sde srid blo bzang sbyin pas btsugs shing / thog mar zhol lcags ri phyi nang gi khrims 'doms byed po mi sna kha shas las med rung / de rjes nye 'khor gzhis khag bco brgyad kyi khrul bsdu khrims gnon dang / bsdu gtong gcig lcogs byed pa'i las khungs shig tu gyur shā( der do dam gnas lnga pa'i las tshan ser skya gnyis dang / las 'phar shod drung las tshan pa gcig zhol drung mi grangs nyi shu skor bcas yod cing / de'i gtso bo'i las 'gan ni po ta la zhol lcags ri phyi nang dang / nye 60

'khor gzhis khag 'bras bu gling / grwa bzhi/ glang ru/ lho mos/ 'brom stod spyi khyab/ tshal/ bde chen/ chos lung / sle'u/ rnam sgang / shel grong /sbrags/ phreng sgo/ lum pa/ gnam/ ljang / mnyes thang / gdong dkar bcas gzhis khag bco brgyad kyi khongs su mi bsad rgyu 'phrog sogs khrims 'gal che rigs spyi khyab bka' shag las khungs su snyan zhus kyis thag gcod byed dgos pa phud/ de byings khrul bsdu khrims gnon zhol gnyer rang khungs nas byed dgos pa dang / shar rags ka brag nas/ nub nor thod gling ka yan gyi skyid chu'i chu rags nyams gso sam gsar rgyag dgos rigs chu rags do dam rtse mgron gcig dang / zhol gnyer re 'khor nas lo ltar bskor zhib dang 'brel nyams gso ngagos rigs sa khungs 'gan dakhri gzhis khag so sos 'grub tshod yod na dang / de min lha zhol du ba gnam gtong bskul nas sra brtan phugs 'pher gyi nyams gso byas te lo gnangs chags su bka' shag gzigs skor gdan zhu zhu dgos/ chu shur rdzong / sbud bde/ zas gzhis sdod/ gnam/ ljang bcas la ljags gro 'khri rten sa zhing rang khungs so sor yod mus ltar gong gsal rdzong gzhis khag nas lo ltar ljags gro spus dag ru'i khal 57ba0skor dang / snye mo smon mkhar gzhis khongs phug khul nas ljags smin gsol zhab kyi rgyu 'bru phug dkar zhes 'bru dkar zhe gcig ru'i khal rishrī0skor/ gtsang khul rdzong gzhis khag nas phug dod 'bru dkar bcas bsdul thog ljags gro dang / ljags smin ang dang gnyis su bkod de rtse shod gsol thab tu nar 'bul zhu dgos pa ma zad/ drung ja'i nang ma mkhan sde yan gyi zhib phor yang bkang ste 'bul dgosakaudabus stod mal gro zi sbug dang / lcang gshongs/ rin chen gling / ru thogamanyes thang ma gling bcas kyi she khag rnams nas lo lo'i she mar dang / bzhes phyur bcas las khungs su she rtsis zhu dgos khongs rgyun gtan ljags smin dkar 61

rti zhes mar gsar khal rdar re gong ka/'i/kha/ she /bag so so re 'khor gyis‘‘gsol mar a khur’’(ljags smin ga ba/ra mar 'or 'dren zhu ca//span der zer)rtsi sa sprod zhu dogos/ gzhan yang dwags kong khul gyi sger chos khag dang / gling khag 'on chos lding / lo sems pa/ stod lung mtshur phu sogs bla brang che khag la 'chi med she 'bri rtsis sprod kyis lo lo'i she mar bsdu khungs che tsam yod pa de thog nas rtse shod gsol thab tu 'char 'phar gsol mar nar 'bul zhu dgos pa dang / rtse gser sdong khag gi mchod phogs bcas 'bul dgos/ lo re nye 'khor gzhis khag bco brgyad nas yong khrul gro nas sran gsum/ sha mar/rtsam pa/ snum bcas 'bab deb nang gsal gyi khrul rigs rnams lo re dga' ldan lnga mchod gong bogs dus gsum gyi khongs su gtsang 'bul zhu dgos pa dang / gzhis khag so sos 'bab deb la dag mchan zhu thub dang thub min gyi 5byasagibyung rnam dbye'i gral tho bkod de bya dga' gzengs bstod dang / nyes chad gcod lam yod/ las khungs de'i steng shod dang / btson khang gi gad pa kha ga gi 'go 'doms dpon po yong khang nas btson pa nag nyes che chung la gzhigs pas btson 'jug dang / btson sto bster phyogs/ rnam kun do dam bya rgyu bcas kyi 'gan 'khur yod pa bcas red/gor zhib las khungs/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa'i sku dus gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i gor zhib las khungs su do dam rtse mgron gcig dang / mi dpon/ larngage bya gnyer tshang drung yig gcig bcas yod cing / de'i las 'gan gtso bo lha sdod gor khongs bal po'i tshong rigs dang kha tsha ra rnams dang / bod mi'i dbar 'khru ga 62

rtsod byung rigs zhib gcod dang / gzhis chags kha tsha ra'i sdod khang / zar/'o lung / gnya' skyid rong gsum bcas gor bod sa 'dres khag la sa mi'i rtsod gzhi che gras sa gnas so sor zhib gcod mi sna gtong dgos pa dang / lha sar gor zhib mi sna mgron mi(rtse mgron dang mi dpon)sbre'asga po dang / gor+ṣa kab tan bcas mnyam 'dzoms gros bsdur gyis thag gcod byed dgos pa sogs red/tshe gling do dam las khungs/rab byung 1dzoshing 'brug(1844)lo rgyal tshab tshe smon gling 'jam dpal tshul khrims srid khri las phab ste tshe gling bla brang la de snga rgyal thog skabs gsar chod mchod gzhis dang 'brog thang / lha sa'i khang khungs bcas gzhung bzhes kyis tshe gling do dam zhes las khungs gsar 'dzugs gnang ba de ni do dam rtse mgron gcig dang / rtse drung dkyus ma gcig drung tog yod pa'i drung yig gcig gad pa khang gnyer bcas las grub cing / las khungs de'i las 'gan ni tshe gling gzhung chod gzhis khag dang / lha sa 'ong kha'i sa zhing gi ston 'bras/ khang gla/ mi bogs bcas kyi 'bab yong thog nas nor gling pho brang yas mas kyi gad pa khag la 'bru phogs rgyag dgos pa dang / gzhan yang bzo rigs/ ar las 'dzugs skrun khag la 'bru mar gtong sgo gtong dgos pa red/ lha sa sman rtsis khang /rab byung 1'ime sbrul(1917)lo lha sa sman rtsis khang btsugs pa der gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur las tshan mkhyen rab nor byu dang rtsis pa'i dge rgan/ cerge

gzhan yang sman don mi sna bcu phrag kha shas tsam yod/ de rjes rim bzhin sman rtsis khang chugs yukhaspru dang / sman bzo grwa sman don mi sna'i las shag bcas gsar rgyag gis lo 'khor gtong gron dngul 'bab rtse rnam gan nga/ngul bskyed do dam nas zhu dgos/ pa dang / dbus gtsang / lho kha/ dwags kong bcas kyi gzhis dgon khag nas sman rtsis slob gsar shes rig ldan pa'i grwa gzhon skong bsdu byas chog pa bcas kyi 'gan dbang yod pa red/'bab zhib las khungs/rab byung 1stos lug(1920)lo 'bab zhib las khungs btsugs pa der do dam drung rtsis gnyis dang / las bya rtsis pa gcig dang drung skya ser gnyis yod pa de'i gtso bo'i las 'gan ni/ 〈lcags stag zhib gzhung〉nang bkod tshun gyi gsar sbol sa zhing lcags zhib tu ma gsal ba'i khongs nas 'ga' zhig do bdag so sos skabs mtshams snyan seng gis son 'gro rang khungs nas tho phul bar he bag med dbang du cha bzhag 'bab bzo sne sel tsam dang /'ga' zhig khrul bogs gang yang med pa sba skung du bzhag pa/ sger chos che btsan khag gcig gis sngar gyi 'byed khru'i sa khongs yin tshul gyis sa zhing khyon che gsar sbol byas pa bcas la 'bab zhib do dam dang / rdzong gzhis sne sdod gtso drag sa 'dres/ gzhung sger chos bcas nas zhib tshags gang che'i son 'gro rdog bskor dang 'brel gzhung 'bangs gnyis gun med pa'i 'bab bzo gtan 'amebs byas te dbus gtsang so sor zhib 'phar bsdu dam ser skya nyis sbrer re bsko rdzong gis byed sgo'i〈lag rtsa〉dang / (bsdu gzhung〉bka' tham 'byar ma dang sbrags sa gnas so sor rdzong gtso gzhis byes 'khur mnyam len gyis bsdu sta

bcug byed dgos pa bcas red/lam zhib las khungs/lcags lugs(1931)lo lam zhib las khungs gsar du btsugs pa der do dam drung rtsis gnyis dang / las bya ser skya gsum yod cing / de'i las 'gan gtso bo gzhung don phyogs thon mi sna che chung dang / dmag phogs bskyel 'dren sogs la sngar lam srid tham dang bka' tham/ mdo spyi'i lam yig bcas las gtong srol med kyang / bar lam sgrig lad kyis spyi khyab rdzong 'go so sos gzhung don phra mor brnyad ngos lam gang byung gis btang ste chab 'bangs thog 'phar brdabs ji snyed cig byung bar brten lcags lug lo lam zhib do dam zur 'dzugs byas pa de nas bzung gzhung don phyogs thon mi sna che chung dang /dmag phogs bskyel 'dren/ rdzong gzhis khag gi sgrigs 'bul sogs rkang 'gro'i khrul sner gtogs rigs la srid/ bka'/ mdo spyi bcas kyi lam yig las/de byings ngos lam gtong bde mi chog pa'i rgyas dpyad dang 'brel lam gsal dos rta rer dpyad gla gtan 'bebs ltar 'khri khungs so sor le med sprod len thog rkang 'gro'i khrul 'gan che chung dang / ngos lam zhor brdzus yod med sogs rdzong gzhis so so nas zla ba drug re'i mtshams song khru he med rdzong gtso'i rtags dam 'byar ma re snyan zhu dang sbrags bka' shag tu phuspyo4 thog de dag la he bag yod med lam zhib las khungs nas zhib 'jug gis mjug sdon rgyun sring byed dgos pa bcas kyi las 'gan yod pa red/zhol 'dod dpal/zhol 'dod dpal du do dam gnas drug pa'i rtse drung gnyis dang / bzo 65

rigs khongs su lag rtsal mtho dma'i go rimyo/ gye drung to ga / —/dan tho ba yo da pa'i dbu che chung sogs rim pa yod cing / lag shes ba sho las khongs gse ra dngul zangs lcags kyi lug pa/ dkrug pa/ lcags dkro‘5/ hob tshags/ 'jam tshags/ gser dngul tir tshags sogs mdor na gser dngul zangs lcags kyi bod lugs mkho chas ma tshang ba med pa bzo skrun byed thub pa'i lag rtsal mi sna mkhas can brgya phrag kha shas yod/zhol mibs rwa las khungs/zhol chibs rwa las khungs su do dam chibs che gnal drug pa'i shod drung las tshan pa gnyis dang / chibs drung nang zan gnyis/ zhol chibs rwa mdo sbug gi zhal ngo gsum/ gzim drel zhal ngo / rgyugs ma zhal ngo bcas yod pa 'di dag gis rnam kun gzhung rta gzhung drel la gso tshags dang / dbyar dus yar 'brog dkar mo gling du rtsa gsos su btang ste gso tshags byed pa/zhol chibs rwa mdo nas rgyun gtan rta 'ul gtong nga/ gos pas/ lo lo rdzong gzhis khag nas gzim drel gyi sga gdan bsdu dgos pa dajiri / kong khul rdzong khag bzhi la gzim drel gyi ma rta rtsis sprod yod pa ltar lo ltarngeri drel phrug bsdu len byed dgos pa sogs red/ rtswa gnyer las khungs/rtswa gnyer las khungs su do dam rtse shod separi skya gnyis dang sger btsugs gnyer pa gnyis yod cing / dbyar dus dbus gtsa‘nga rdzong gzhis res 'khor gyis 6

'dam rtsa brnga 'dren gyi 'ul mi skong bsdu byed phyogs skor re'u mig nang gsal— ltar 'dam spyi rtse mgron dang / rtswa gnyer thun mong nas bka' shag la snyan seng gis bka' rgya zhu dgos pa dang / 'dam rtswa brnga 'dren gyis nor gling dang /zhol chibs rwa mdo sbug gzhan yang spyi mkhan sogs gzan rtswa gtong 555 khag la nar gtong byed dgos pa/ dbyar dus 'dam rtswa brnga rgyu'i las 'go ma tshugs gong 'dam rtswa skye tshad longs dang ma longs 'dam spyi rtse mgron dang /rtswa gnyer thun mong nas bskor zhib kyis 'dam rtswa skye tshad ring thung mkhan po tshang la gzigs 'bebs zhus rjes brnga bsdu gtan 'khel dgos pa dang / lo 'khor chibs gzan 'dam rtsa kho nas ldeng min la brten lha sa nye 'khor nas yul srol gzan rin sprad de gzan pa phon che nyo dgos pa bcas kyi gyong gun che tsam yod kyang / rtswa gnyer 'phos mtshams su gun gsab rdzong gzhis drag khungs re stsal lam yod/ rtsam bzhes las khungs/ne+e rī bhekha bheyi rtsam len rtse drung gcig dang / shod drung gcig yod pa de gnyis kyi las 'gan gtso bo ni smon lam brngod chen zhes smon lam tshogs bzhugs dge 'dun rer lo ltar bod zla 1 tshes 1rinyin tshwa rtsam bcu 'bo re/ tshogs mchod skabs zla ritshes ri5nyin dge 'dun bcu rer tshwa rtsam bcu 'bo re/ smon tshogs rirnga zhogs pa khur dod dang / tsha gra'i dod sngar lam dngul bsgril gyis rgyag dgos pa/ dga' ldan lnga mchod sogs kyi mchod snum/ bzo rigs las grwa khag gi dgos cha/ gzhung zhabs dang / sto zan/ bzo rigs bcas kyi phogs thob/ phyogs 'grul mi sna'i zur chas sogs bka' 'dzin nang gsal dang 'char 67

can gtong deb ltar sprod dgos pa dgung gsar tshes 1dang 'ikyi rtse tshoms chen mdzad sgo dang gzab gsol khag de min 'char 'phar mdzad sgo dang mgron ston dkar spro bcas kyi bzhes spro bsgar las byed dgos pa dang / rtsam bzhes nang gnyer gnyis dang / gar dgos phyi gnyer gnyis rtsam len ser skya so sos 'dzugs dgos/ 'bo kha mi gcig dang / lag g.yog mi grangs bco lnga skor gtan 'dzugs su yod/gong gsal gtong sgo'i 'bab dmigs rdzong gzhis khag nas rkang 'don cha gses kyis gna' dus khrul chen du grags pa'i rgya shing brngod gsum gyi nang tshan rtsam khang du 'bab pa'i smon brngod 'bab deb nang gsal rtsam rtsing dang /gro zhib/ snum/ ldur bcas khad nye'i rdzong gzhis khag nas ngo 'bul dang /thag ring rdzong gzhis khag nas dngul bsgyur gyis 'bul lam ltar lo ltar bsdu gzhung dang sbrags bka' shag nas bka' rgya zhus te zla 10tshes ri5tshun bsdu lam yod/ smon rngod kyi sngar lam dngul bsgril rtsam ru'i khal rer dngul zho gsum dang / gro zhib khal rer dngul zho bzhi/ ldur khal rer dngul zho do/snum zangs 'bo rer dngul srang gang zho lnga re yin pa de dag ni de snga bskal dus bzang po'i rin thang rang 'jags song stabs phyis rtsam len las khungs gtong yong kha ma 'dum par brten lo ltar gtong sgon 'bru khal stong phrag kha shas zhu dgos pa dang / rtsam len las khungs nas zhor lcogs zhu dgos gras gar dgos zhes lha sa tsho pa dang mnyam sbrel gyis sa tshig mi hreng dang khal ma bcas gtong dgos pa'i khongs smon tshogs tshogs shing dbor 'dren dang nor gling chibs rwar 'dam rtsa dbor 'dren zhu ched bong lag bzhi dang / klu sgrug shing rwa nas rtse shod gsol thab kyi zhugs shing dbor 'dren bong lag gnyis rjes 'gro dang bcas pa gtan 'dzugs byed dgos pa sogs kyis las khungs de yang 68

gtong yong kha ma 'dum pa'i gyong gun che stabs las 'khur 'phos rjes rdzong gzhis drag gras re stsal lam yod/shing gnyer las khungs/shing gnyer rtse drung gcig yod pa des sbrags phreng khul nas sngar lam shing khrul bsdu len gyis rtse gsol thab tu 'char can nyin re bong rgyab nyi shu tham pa re dang / mdzad sgo khag la 'phar 'bul/ de bzhin shod gsol thab/ bka' shag gsol thab bcas la rgyun shing nar gtong zhu dgos shing / der gtong yong kha 'dum min gyi gyong gun phran bu yod rung / rjes su thab rten gun gsab kyi las gnas 'gro khungs yod pa red/zhabs 'phar las khungs/zhol zhabs 'phar las khungs su do dam mkhan drung re 'khor thog las bya rtse drung gnyis dang / rtse gnyer nang gnyis bcas yod pa de dag gi las 'gan ni/ tā la'i bla ma'i sku phywa dang / bstan srid bde thabs kyi zhabs rim sgrub dgos pa'i dgos dngul gzhung dngul khang nas zhu dgos pa dang / dgos 'bru nye 'khor rdzong gzhis dang bstan bla gzhung chod kyi gzhis khag nas bton rgya zhus te 'bru dngul gnyis ka 'bor 'khur lag 'dzin du bkod de lo re bsdad song rtsis khru khams dwangs 'bul dgos pa bcas red/

ya mon 'phrul bzo khang /rab byung 1'ishing stag(1914) lo ya mon 'phrul bzo khang gsar 'dzugs kyi do dam mkhan drung tā bla ma dang / lhum pa sras gnyis bsko gzhag thog las bya mgron las gnyis dang drung dkyus ser skya gnyis/ rtse shod gnyer nang drug yod pa dang / lcags shing gnyis kyi dbu che chung gis gtsos lag shes bzo las khongs nas zhol 'dod dpal gyi dbu che chung phud/ de byings lag shes drag gras 'dems bsgrugs kyis mi grangs brgyad cu skor nas grib mdar batho grwa khag glecig btsugal shing / der 'phrul mda' yang chang zer ba dang / me skyogs chung chung 'khor lo yod pa/ spyogs mdel/ bod rdzas/ sta re/ rtse gri ring thung / mdung ring sogs bzos pa dang / de rjes lcags sprel(1920) lo gro stod nor bu mtsho skyid du 'phrul 'khor 'don 'dren gyi bzo grwa khag gcig btsugs te zangs kyi pad shag zho gang dang / skar phyed brgyad/ skar lnga/ skar phyed gsum/ gzhan yang bzo grwa de nas lcags regs khag gi dngos rdzas batho dbyibal gang dgos kyi dras gtub dang bzhu lug byas te dngos gzhi'i sgrig sbyor dang par 'debs/ 'jam phyob kyi tshags sogs ya mon 'phrul bzo khang nas bzos te lcags rigs kyi mkho chas sna tshogs 'do na gyi yod pa re da/zho la spos batho khang /thol spos bzo do dam rtse dung gcig dang / rtse phyag nang gcig rtse gnyer nang gnyis bcas yong// de'i las 'gan ni sdon dkar dmar gyis mtshon 70

spos rgyu gang dgos rtse phyag las khungs nas zhu dgos pa dang / spos brdung las mi sngar lam yar 'brog gling gzhis 'og nas kang 'don cha gses kyis mi grangs sum cu skor lo ltar zla 1rinas zhol shar sgo'i lcog tu spos brdung las 'go btsugs te zla 10tshes shar bar spos bzo'i las grwa de nas gtso bor gzim chung gzim spos dang / gzim 'dra/ dkyus spos bcas ang grangs gsum du dbye ste rtse phyag las khungs kyi 'bab deb nang gsal spus 'bor las ma zhan pa lo ltar zla 10tshes shrī5 nyin rtse phyag las khungs su rtsis 'bul zhu dgos pa red/ gser ṭam las khungs/sa lug(1919) lo nor thod gser ṭam las khungs btsugs pa de'i do dam dza sag tsha rong pa dang / rtse mgron phun rab pa/ las bya ser skya bzhi dang / zhol drung gnyis yod cing / de dag gi las 'gan gser ṭam lhad med par rgyag byed sgo dang / gser ṭam rer 'dza' thang pad lor srang nyi shu re brtsis 'grems spel gyis khrom rwa gang sar sprod len byed mus/ gzhan yang glog shugs kyis 'khel 'thag byas pa'i snam bu sa mdog dang / gro lo sogs srab mthug sna tshogs/ kam pā li tshos gzhi 'dra min sna tshogs bcas 'thag las byas pa red/ grwa bzhi blog 'phrul las khungs/rab byung 1stolcags lug(1931) lo/ grwa bzhi glog 'phrul las khungs 7rmi

gsar du btsugs pa de'i gtso bo'i do dam sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel dang / dza drung rtsis(dza sag drung yig che mo/ rtsis dpon) gsum/ las bya ser skya bco lnga skor bcas yod pa dang / de snga'i ya mon 'phrul bzo khang dang lor khang / gser ṭam las khungs gsum gyi bzo mi dang bcas grwa bzhi las khungs su zla bsgril thog lha sa dang rdzong gzhis khag nas lcags bzo'i lag rtsal drag gras skong 'gugs byas pa dang / dog bder chu shugs glog khang chung gras shig gsar rgyag gis glog shugs la brten nas dngul gyi srang gsum sgor mo dang ṭam bcu sgor/ pad shag shog dngul bcas par 'debs byed pa ma zad/dbyin mdar dpe blangs nas 'phru'/ mda' rtse gri mdel bcas gsar bzo/nor thod gser ṭam las khungs kyi larga/ rgyun ltar snam chas sna tshogs 'thag bshaṃs/gzhan yang lcags rigs kyi mkho chas gsar bzo bcas byed pa dang / no ra gling dang rtse pho brang / gtsug lag khang / lha sa grong khyer bcas la glog bzhu yang btsugs shing / skabs der grwa bzhi las khungs de ni srid gzhung ge gron dngul gtong gzhi'i nor srid dngul rtsa'i las khungs shig red/blog 'don khang / shing byi(1924) lo rgya gar nas glog 'don 'phrul 'khor yo chas cha tshang zhig bod du 'don 'dren gnang rgyu'i skabs der bod du glog las kyi shes yon yod pa byang ngos rig 'dzin rdo rje rgyus mnga'i babs kyi gtong gnang gis glog chas bod du slebs rjes dog bde sa gnas su glog khang gsar rgyag bgyis te thog ma ra nor gling pho bung yas mas su glog gtong 'go tshugs pa dang / de nas rim bzhin lha sa rje 'byam sgang du glog khang gsar rgyag gis grong khyer 7lha

dang / grwa bzhi glog 'phrul las khungs kyi thon bskyed la'ang bed spyod gtong thub pa byung zhing / skabs der glog khang gi thog ma'i gtso 'gan 'khur mi lha gnyer rim bzhi byang ngos pa rig 'dzin rdo rje dang / na de rjes lha gnyer thang smad pa bdud 'dur tshe ring red/ ོar po'i las khungs/gtan 'jags ar po'i las khungs su do dam dza mkhan gnyis dang /gnas lnga pa'i las tshan ser skya gnyis/ las bya ser skya bzhi/ phyogs 'gro'i gnyer nang brgyad bcas yod/ de'i gtso bo'i las 'gan ni/ rtse pho brang gis gtsos pho brang yas mas dang / gtsug lag khang / ra che sogs lha khang khagagazhan yang dmag sgar/ sman rtsis khang sogs gzhung khang gang yod la lo ltar nyams gso zhu dgos pa'i rigs dang / gsar skrun bcas las khungs de rang nas 'gan len zhu dgos pa dang / lo 'khor ar las rgya khyon la gzhigs pas 'bru dngul dgos rigs bka' shag spyi khyab las khungs la snyan seng gis 'bor 'khur lag 'dzin du bkod thog dngul 'bab grwa bzhi las khungs dang / 'bru 'bab ngabus gtsang rdzongatshogazhis gang 'os nas bton rgya zhus te lo 'khor gnyis gsum re'i mtshams bka' shag tu byung song rtsis khru phul thog zhib khang las khungs nas he bag yod med rtsis zhus kyis gzhi nas rtsis khrur dag mchan dang / do dam pad gtsang 'dzin zhu dgos pa bcas red/bde zhib las khungs/sa stag(1938) lor bde zhib las khungs btsugs pa der do dam

drung rtsis gnyis dang / las bya ser skya bapyi/ yo da ci nga / katso bo'i las 'gan ni/ spyi tshogs bde 'jags skor la lta rtog dang / lhag par lha sa grong khye/ ra gyis mtshon rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khag la slob grwa gsar 'dzugs kyis slob khang gsar rgyag dang 'brel zhing 'brog mi dmangardoge kyi bu phrug gzhi rgya ma chung tsam skong 'gugs thog rdzong gzhis so so'i las bya drung khang / gtso rgan/ gzhan yang sger chos khongs nas dgertergan ji dgos 'os 'dzugs kyi phogs thob gzhung gnas nas bstsal thog zla drug re'i mtshams rdzong gzhis sne sdod so sos slob 'bras gang 'dra byung yod med zhib 'jug dang 'brel bde zhib las khungs su thad kar snyan seng zhus thog rnam kun slob khang la lta rtog gnyer skyong byed dgos pa sogs kyi gtan 'bebs yod pa red/ de 'brel lha zhol grong khyer nang phyi lugs la dang zhen byed pa'i pho mo'i chas gos ya ma gzugs spras pa dang /g.ya' pheng dang rdo tha lkog tshong dang 'theca/ 'thung mi chog pa/ tho phi cu dang /mā cang brgyab nas rgyan 'dzugs mi chog pa/ gtan 'bebs chang khang las brgal ba'i myos rdzas gang byung du btsong mi chog pa bcas kyi khrims 'doms mjug sdon byed dgos pa dang / gzhan yang yul lung yar rgyas kyi ched du bsam zhib 'char 'god zhu dgos pa bcas red/phyi rgyal las khungs/lcags bya(1921) lo phyi rgyal las khungs btsugs shing / do dam par khang dza sag rgyal mtshan phun tshogs dang / dza sag khe smad pa rin chen dbang rgyal/ las bya se/ra skya gnyis dang / skad sgyur gre/cig de'i las 'gan ni phyi phyogs rgyal khab khag dang las don gang ci'i skor 'brel ba byed dgos pa'i rigs rgyu4

dang / phyi rgyal gyi mi sna 'byor rigs la thog ma'i sne len dang 'brel gtugs kyis gnad don che rigs bka' shag brgyud srid skyong dang tā la'i bla mar snyan seng zhu dgos pa phud de byings las khungs de nyid rang nas thag gcod byed dgos/ gong gsal dza sag ser skyatshosbrel po 'das rjes skabs shig las khungs der do dam mi sna med kyang / rab byung 1༄chu rta(1942) lo g.yung dgon dzatshosag dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang / zur zur dza sag dbang chen tshe brtan gnyis la bsko gzhag thog las bya ser skya bzhi dang / skad sgyur bcas yod pa'i las 'gan gong bzhin byed dgos pa red/ sbrag tar las khungs/rab byung 15sa rta(1918) lo sbrag tar las khungs btsugs shing / — sbrag khang las khungs kyi 'go 'doms sbrag spyi gnas lnga pa'i las tshan ser skya gnyis dang / lha sar sbrag drung gnyis/ lam 'khel rdzong 'go 'du 'gag che bar sbrag drung re yod pa dang / sbrag tshugaso so sor ring thung ma le cha stoms kyi sbrag bang sdod khang gsar rgyag gis sbrag tshugs 'khel yul sa khul rdzong gzhis de rang nas sbrag khang ji dgos yul mi do brtan gsar 'dzugs byed dgos/ sbrag spyi'i las 'gan ni lha sa nas gro spyi dang / gzhis rtse spyi rdzong / kong po rgya mida' bcas kyi bar yig zam btsugs yod pa de dag la do dam thog lo re sbrag spyi ser skya khag bgos kyis sbrag bang las don la zhib 'jug dang / sbrag phogs rgyag par bskyod skabs sa khul so so'i sbrag drung gis lag deb nang gsal sbrag 'dzin 'dra ya'i thog nas lo re'i sbrag gla rtsis zhu byed dgos pa red/tar khang las khungs su/ thog ma'i do dam phyi rgyal gyi skad yig dang tar 76

gtong len shes pa rtse drung rong dpal lhun chos ldan bstan dar red/ lha sa nas tar dang / kha par gtong len babs tshugs ni thog mar rgyal rtse tshong spyi dang / gro spyi khang bar yin pa dang / de rjes dbyin tar btsugs rjes phyi phyogs gang sar tar 'phrin gtong rgyu yod pa red/ drung 'phrin las khungs/me phag(1947) lo rlung 'phrin las khungs btsugs pa der 'gan 'khur mkhan dbyin ji phog sab ces pa zhig dang / las bya ser skya bzhi yodapa dang / yan lag rlung 'phrin khang mnga' ris dang / chab mdo/ nag chu/gro mo bcas sa khul khag bzhi la yod cing / chab mdor las byed dbyin ji pho the dang / de min sa khul khag la rlung 'phrin cha tshang gtong len shes pa'i bod ne+egs gor yig slob phrug dang / hu'e rigs bcas mi grangs bco lnga skor yod/'du 'god las khungs/sa byi(1948)lo 'du 'god las khungs btsugs par do dam bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / drung rtsis gnyis/ las bya mgron las gnyis yod pa dang / ser skya bzhi de'i las 'gan ni skabs der bod dmag sngon yod thog pa dang grong drag dmag sgar/ pha dang bcu gnyis drug sna'i dmag sgar/ ba dang kong dmag ma dang gtsang khul grong drag dmag sgar bcas skong 'gugs byas par brten dmag pho7kas sogs gang ci'i cha nas 'du 'god gzhi rgya che tsam zhig ma byas mthu med byung ste dbus gtsang / lho dwags 76

rdzong gzhis khag gi gzhis 'bru dang / 'bab zhib/ 'bru phogs/ so las bcas gzhung 'bru gang yod zla bsgril gyis bsdu gtong byed sgo khag las khungs de nas byed dgos pa dang / de mtshungs gron dngul gtong dmigs su rgya dngul srang bcu'i sgor mo kha ris su 'du 'god las khungs zhes 'khod pa par brgyab ste dmag phogs sogs kyi dgos dngul du gtong dgos/legs bcos las khungs/shing rta(1954)lo legs bcos las khungs btsugs/ do dam bka' blon gcig dza mkhan gnyis/ drung rtsis brgyad/ rtse shod las tshan pa dang / drung dkyus bsdoms mi grangs nyi shu skor/ gdan sa gsum gyi bla spyi dang / grwa tshang so so'i 'thus mi bcas khyon mi grangs drug cu skor yod/ de'i gtso bo'i las 'gan ni skabs de'i srid gzhung gi las don gang ci'i thad la rim bzhin dus bstun legs bcos byed dgos pa de red/ thog mar shing rta (1954)lo nas bzung rgya khyab rdzong 'go dang / gzhis sdod/ bla gnyer khag bcas gzhung 'dzin gyi ser skya mi 'gro so sor rdzong gzhis rgya khyon la gzhigs pa'i phogs thob sprad thog so sos sngar gyi 'bab debadenang gsal gyi khrul rigs gang na ci yod gzhung rtsis zhu phyogs thad lo ltar rdzong gtso gzhis byes 'khur mnyam len gyis phul ba'i byung song rtsis khrur legs bcos las khungs nas he bag yod med zhib 'jug rtsis zhu bya rgyu dang / gzhan yang las khungs chung rtsag khag khu bsdu zla bsgril/ skyel 'dren 'gro lam gyi 'phel phyogs dang bstun gzhung don phyogs thon mi sna dang / mkho sgrub skyel 'dren rlang 'khor gsar 'dzugs sogs kyi las 'gan yod pa bcas red/77

klod zhib las khungs/ me sprel(1956)lo gyod zhib las khungs btsugs pa der do dam dza sag gcig dang / mkhan rim gnyis/ de snga'i bsher dpang las khungs zla bsgril gyi gnas lnga pa'i shod drung las tshan pa gnyis/ drung dkyus las bya ser skya bcu skor bcas yod cing / de snga las khungs khag la las zhor gyod zhib bya rgyu khag mang yod pa rnams zla bsgril bgyis te byung 'byung gi gyod don tshang ma gyod zhib las khungs nas brtsad zhib kyis don gnad che rigs bka' shag brgyud tā la'i bla mar 'char 'bul zhu dgos pa phud/ de byings gyod zhib las khungs rang nas thag gcod byed dgos pa red/gzhung 'dru sbyi mdzod khang /me bya(1957)lo gzhung 'bru spyi mdzod khang btsugs pa der do dam srid zur glang mdun gung dang / dza tha'i gnyis/ mkhan rim gnyis/ las bya ser skya nyi shu skor/ drung yig gsum bcas yod/ de snga'i rdzong gzhis khag gi gzhis 'bru'i 'bab deb tshang ma rtsis khang las khungs dang / 'bab zhib las khungs su yod pa rnams dang / so nam las khungs dang / rtse shod gnyer tshang las khungs/ zhol gnyer/ zhol spyi phogs khang / lha sa tshe gling do dam/ dbus gtsang 'bru phogs/ chos 'bru do dam bcas 'bru rigs bsdu gtong las khungs khag gi khongs nas zhol gnyer nas rtse shod gsol thab tu ljags gro/ ji/gas smin phug dkar 'bul dgos pa sogs kyis rang 'jags su bzhag pa phud/ de nga8

byings 'bru rigs las khungs tshong ma zlo bsgril bgyis te gozhudzi 'ibru spyi mardzod khang nas sngar lam mchod rgyun khag dang / gzhung zhabs ser skya/ rtse shod nang zan/ gad khang khag gi phogs thob/ dmag phogs/ gzhan yang ar las dgos 'bru sogs 'char 'phar gyi 'bru rigs gtong gzhi gang yod nar gtong byed dgos pa bcas red/phyi'i sbyi khyab khagabod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mtha' mtshams dang / tshong lam/ sa gnas 'du 'gag che sa khag la spyi khyab srid 'dzin las khungs re bsko 'dzugs byed lam yod pa red/ skor gsum spyi khyab/rab byung 11 me 'brug(1664)lor la dwags rgyal po seng ge rnam rgyal nas chos 'u/gas grub mtha'i phyogs lhung gis phyogs de'i dge ldan ring lugs 'dzin pa ru thog mtho lding dgon dang / spu hreng shes 'phel gling sogs la bsam sbyor ngan gshoms kyis chos byed dge 'dun pa rnams bzhugs bzod mi bde ba'i thog mi sde rnams la'ang khrul dmag gi mnar gcod ji snyed btang bar brten khul de'i yul dgon ser skya spyi nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa chen por skyabs bcol re 'bod zhu bcar skabs tā la'i bla ma lnga pa chen pos gdan sa chen po bkra shis lhun po'i chos khrims pa dga' ldan tshe dbang gtsor bor gyur pa'i bod sog 'go dmag gtos che dang bcas mnga' ris su mngags 79

rdzong gnang bsajil dwags rgyal po dpung bcas cham la phab nas mnga' ris skor gsum dbang 'og tu bsdus pa de nas bzung thog mar rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang rang nyid nas skor gsum spyi la dbang sgyur gyis lho nyin rdu/ nub la dwags/ byang shin cang bcas sa mtshams khag la so mi 'dzugs rgyu dang / nang khul ru thog rdzong / mang/'a pa kha/ rtsa hreng rdzong / spu hreng rdzong / dge rtse shar nub/ 'brong pa sto byang sogs skor gsum lho byang yul 'brog so so'i thon khungs la zhib tshags kyi khrul rigs 'bab deb gtan 'bebs dang / gser kha/tshwa kha/ tshong 'dus khag bcas la do dam bya rgyu sogs kyi srol btod/ lhag par sgar khongs rdzong 'go so sor spus 'bor mang nyung la ma stos par gser kha khag mang yod stabs rtse 'phral bde las khungs nas lo ltar gser dpon gzhung tshong pa zhes gtong lam yod pa ltar rdzong 'go so so'i thon 'bor la gzhigs pas〈'bab deb dbyig mdzod chen mo〉nang gsal gyi gser khrul 'jal dgos pa dang / de rjes skor gsum spyi khyab shod skor rim bzhi re gtong lam byung 'dugarab byung 1rdzishing lug(1835)lo tsam nas gnas lnga pa'i tog 'dzin shod drung gnyis la phyi'i thal ji'i go gnas bstsal te sgar dpon shar nub ces gtong srol yod/ mnga' ris ni bod kyi mtha' mtshams kyi sa khul la brten lho nub byang bcas kyi sa mtshams so sor dwogs can phyi'i mi rigs gseng shor mi 'byung ba'i 'brel yod rdzong 'go so sos bkag 'doms thog blo dwogs chod min rigs skor gsum spyi khyab par snyan seng zhu dgos pa dang / sa mtshams skor sogs gal che'i don gnad thag gcod mi thub pa'i rigal bka' shag la dgongs skor zhu dgos pa/ de min khrul bsdu khrims sgon dang / gser kha/ tshwa kha/tshong 'dus khag bcas la do dam dang / rta lo nam shar la‘‘rta lo skor chen’’0

zhis bod dbus gtsang khams gsum dang / nyin rdu/ la rwags khul bcas nas gangs ti si dang / ma pham g.yu mtshor gnas skor dad 'dus mi tshogs che zhing / sa zla'i yar tshes 15nyin sgar dpon shar nub dang skor gsum khul gyi rdzong sdod/ dgon sde khag gi bla ma las sne/ dmag dpon zhes rdzong 'go so so'i khongs kyi mi drag dpon rgyud khag bcas nas ti si'i skor lam du lo ltar dar chen sku bzhengs zhu rgyu sogs de snga rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang gi lam ltar byed srol yod/ shing yos(1915) lo ja tshwa las khungs btsugs te dbus gtsang rgya khyab tu tshwa bal sho khrul bsdu dam gtong lam bzhin skor gsum khul ru thog mda' pa kha/ spu gyeng / rgya nyi ma/ yan chod steng kha bcas la tshwa bal sho khrul bsdu dam rtse drung re gtong ba bcas/ —mon khul 'go 'dzin rta dbang bla gnyer/sman yul ni sngar btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs nas bod khongs bston med thog rgya sa kong jos bod kyi sa bkra brtsi skabs mtha' 'dul gtsug lag khang gi ya gyal legs po sa gnas su ru gnon lha khang brtsigs shing / rab byung 1stos phag(1959)lo phan mon sha 'ug stag sgo zhes pa'i lha khang der lo ltar gzhung gnas nas mtha' 'dul yang 'dul lha khang spyi dang 'dra ba'i mchod sprin spro mus sogs kyi yun ring lo rgyus yod pa dang / rab byung 11 lcags sprel(1680)lo tā la'i bla ma lnga pa chen pos zhal slob me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho dang / mtsho sna lding nam mkha' 'brug grags gnyis mon yul du gtong gnang gis chos dang / srid kyi sgo nas sngar gyi lo rgyus 'chad/ rim bzhin rta dbang dga' ldan rnam rgyal gling dgon btab/ se rag 81

blo mas sku tshe'i ring dgon gyi bla ma dang / yu'/ sdeshāre 'o tsho tshis mdzad/ de'i rjes thogs su rim bzhin rta dbang bla gnyer ḍā/sa kanas lnga rnga/'i rtse drutā ri re bsko gzhag gis rta dbang dga' ldan rnam rgyal lha rtse dgon gyis gtsos mon khul lha mi'i sde dgon tshang ma'i khral bsdu khrims gno na dang / sa mtshams skor sogs dmigs bsal gal che'i rigs gzhung gnas la dgongs skor zhu dgos pa dang / de byings rta dbang bla gnyer dang / mcho sna rdzong sbrel/ dgon pa'i las sne/ 'tsho shog khag gi lding dang / 'go rga na bcas sngar lam bzhi sbrel lam/ drug sbrerka4 gyi thog nas thag gcod byed pa las/ rta gnyer gcig pus thag gcod byed dbang med/ spyir btang mon khul 'di bzhin sa rgya ha cang che la gdod ma'i nags tshal gyi gseb tu rtsa che'i gcan gzan dang bya/ ri dwags che chung sna tshogs kyis khengs pa/ rtswa sman/ shing sman/ rdo sman/ shing 'bras sna tshogs/ gla rtsi/ dom mkhris/ khrug rwa sogs rtsa che'i sman rigs/ btsodajidang / gla rdzab/ shug rdzab/ be rdzab la sogs pa'i rtsa che'i shing rigs sogs rang byung khams kyi thon khungs phun sum tshogs po yod pa bcas/nyag rong spyi khyab/rab byung 14 chu glang (1853)lo nyag rong mgon ngo rnam rgyal phyogs gtogs dang bcas nas brag 'go dang / stong 'khor/ sde dge/ 'ba' li sogs la rim bzhin dpung 'jug gis blangs te sa khul de tsho'i mi ngan 'ga' zhig la 'go ming btags thog mthar bod du dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i dmigs yul yod par brten skabs der sde dge sa spyod pa lo na phra stabs mdun 'khor rnams dang / yul dgon 'go mi gros bsdur gyis sa gnas su ya bzung thub re 8lha

med stabs mthun lam gang mkhas byas pa dang / nyag dgra'i cho spyod gnas tshul dang / rting ma'i dmigs yul bcas zhib phra 'khod pa'i lha sar gnas tshul skyel mi mdun 3khor bsam khang lha dar can nam nyin shad rdzong byas don ltar sa smad kyi gnas tshul zhib phra bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas shes rtogs byung rjes srid skyong dang bka' shag bod ljongs tshogs 'du bcas go bsdur gyis nyag dgra mthar sgrod gtong rgyu'i spyi khyab zhabs pad phu lung pa tshe dbang rdo rje dang dbus mda' khri smon pa/ mdo mkhar ba tshe dbang nor bu/ dbus gtsang dmag dpung chig stong brgyad brgya skor/ phogs dpon rtse mgron skal dar dang / shod drung las tshan zur lci ba ngo las bcas 'phral thon dgos pa'i bka' bsgyur dang 'brel/ khams khul nas ri chab(ri bo che dang chab mdo) sho star lho gsum (sho pa mdo/ star rdzong ste dpal 'bar/ sto rdzong ) smar mdzo sa gsum(smar khamaṭa /mdzo sgang ༈ sa ngan)bcas nas yul dmag mi go rang 'grigs skong 'gugs kyis 'go 'doms yul dgon so so nas 'os 'dems thog dmag phogs rang khungs rdzong gzhis so so'i bkar khongs nas 'don 'dren dgos rgyu'i bkod mngags bcas rtse drung las tshan chang khyim pa dang / shod drung gnas gsar ba shad rtsol gyis btang thog dngos gzhi'i dmag dpung dang / spyi khyab ngo las lha sa nas 'phral thon bgyis shing / mdo smad du gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms kyis spyi khyab bka' blon ngo las dang / dmag dpung gtos che bcas sa smad du thon dang thon rtsis yod pa sogs kyi sbor grags che khar/ bar skabs sde dge man chad du yul dgon gang sar nyag jag gi mnar gcod ci che byung stabs sde dge stong 'khor/ brag 'go hor khog tshun gyi sde dgon mi dmangs nar+sā nyag jag la dngos shugs su ngo rbol gyis btsan bskul dmag mi phyir 'then byas pa sogs mgon rnam dmag dpung shugs ma thub kyis nyams zhan du phyin yod kyang / da 83

dung kho tsho'i daXg dpung khag gcig 'bri chu'i nub rgyud du 'byor zhing / bod dmag rnams lho byang khag bgos kyis thon te lho phyogs dmag dpung sho star lho gsum dang / sa ngan yul dmag khag gcig gi 'go 'doms su darnga 'a shod lde 'chang ngag rnam dang / de'i gcung po dmag don/ lho rdzong lding bkras rab can nas dgra bo'i dmag dpung 'jo mda' khul du 'byor ba shes stabs thog mar dpung bskyod ma byas par 'jo mda' dpon tshang lha can la gsang gros kyis dus bkag bzos nas glo bur dgra bor bskor bcom mtshan 'gebs btang ste dgra dmag bsad pa dang / bzung dmag kyang srog thog btang ba sogs drag rtsub kyis dmag 'thab byas stabs nyag dmag lhag 'phro rnams 'bri chu brgal nas sde dger bskyod dgos byung bas bod dmag khag bgos kyis sde dger 'byor nye yong lugs sogs kyi grags sbir khyab stabs sde dger yod pa'i nyag dpung rnams kyang slar yang dpung 'jug byed rngo ma thogs par sde dge nas rim bzhin phyir bshig byas par brten bod dmag dang dmigs bsal dza drag gi dmag 'thab che rigs byed dgos ma byung yang / nyag rong sa gnas su byed gte mgon rnam dang / khang gsar lha dar sogs mi ngan 'ga' zhig dang / dmag dpung bcas nas rnam kun 'grul bzhud byed sa'i brag la chu 'thab g.yang gzar can gyi lam 'phrang khag la 'gog spung btsan rdzong dam bzung byas yod stabs bod dmag shar bskyod ma thub pa'i thog mi gron yang gang tsam byung zhing / 'on kyang brag 'go bla ma lha skyabs sogs khul de'i yul mi 'ga' zhig nas sa sna lam rgyus kyis gsang lam khag gnyis nas dpung bskyod byas mthar mkhar rdzong btsan bzung byas rigs gtor pham btang ba sogal dmag 'thab dus thung tsam las byed dgos ma byung bar mgon rnam phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa cham la phab rjes thog mar nyag khog spyi khyab gra phyi phun rab pa tshe ring dpal ldan la

thari ji'i go gna.ā+oṃdang/ las bya shod drung gnyis bcas bsko gzhag gis sa mtshams skor sogs gal che'i rigs bka' shag la dgongs skor zhu dgos pa las/ de byings khrul bsdu khrims 'doms tshang ma nyag spyi ngo las nas byed pa dang / sa srung 'go da mag zur du yod/ nyag spyi dza sag hor khang pa'i rjes su spyi khyab zur du ma dgos par sa spung mda' dpon nas gcig lcogs byed lam yod pa bcas red/mdo smad spyo khyab/rab byung 15chu glang(1913)lo lu'u cun rgya dmag bod sa nas/ phyir 'bud byas rjes mdo smad khul gyi zhi drag spyi 'doms bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar ngo las bsko gzhag gis chab mdo sa gnas su bka' shag spyi khyab las khungs dngos su btsugs shing / der las bya rim bzhi ser skya gnyis dang / phogs dpon mkhan rim gnyis/ mgron las gnyis/ bka' drung gcigabaka' mgron gcig gzim 'gag gcig las bya dkyus ma rtse shod ser skya bcu skor bcas yod/ las 'gan ni/ mdo smad khul gyi sa srung mda' dpon dang / rdzong 'go gzhis sdod bcas kyi mi 'gro bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas bsko gzhag gnang rung / sa srung 'go dmag sa gnas gang du bca' sdod dgos min mdo spyi nas thag gcod gnang rgyu dang / rdzong gzhis so so'i khrul bsdu khrims 'doms byed phyogs/ 'char 'phar rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khrul rigs nye mi stoms pa'i rigs la sa mi'i zhib gcod/ dmag phogs 'du 'god/sa 'gag khag tu ja tshwa spu bal/ pags rigs/ sman rdzas la sogs pa'i sho khrul bsdu dam bsko gtong bcas mdor na khul de'i zhi drag byed sgo'i nang nas 85

sa mtshams thob shor gyi rtsod bsnyad yo lang rigs bod sa gnas srid gzhung la dgongs bskor zhu dgos pa las/ de byings mdo spyi rang nas thag gcod byas chog pa bcas red/sde dge spyo khyab/shing stag(1914)lo mdo spyi bka' bla byams pa bstan dar nas mdo smad khul sa srung 'go dmag khag bgos kyis gtong gnang mdzad khongs sde dge khul du dmigs bsal spyi khyab zur du ma dgos pa rnam kun khrims 'doms byed sgo sa srung mda' dpon nas gcig lcogs kyis sa mtshams dang /gzhan yang byed don che gras mdo spyir snyan seng zhu dgos pa las/ de byings sa srung mda' dpon nas thag gcod bya rgyu'i srol 'dzugs ltar lam byang du gyur pa red/sog phogs khang / khume 'brug(1916)lo mdo spyi bka' bla byams pa bstan dar nas mdo smad khul gyi phogs khang mkhan rim sbrel pos mi khyab pas hor tsho pa sa dgu'i khongs dang / sog nag chu tshun la 'brel mtshungs phogs khang gsar 'dzugs yod pa zhes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum par snyan zhus ltar hor tsho khul dang / so ga nag chu/ gnam ru/ nag tshang tshun gyi byang rigs sa srung khag 'a/ sozla/ phob/rosu khang do dam mgron lari ri/rnasbrer po bsko gzhag gis rtsa ba'i phogs dmigs haṃr tsho khu/sda steng chen dang / ser tsha/ 'bri ru khul bcas nas ne(/

'bab nge/ba nang gsal gnas zhing thog phud kyi gzhung 'bab ji yod sog phogs khang du rgyag dgos pa dang / phogs 'bru kha sgon dgos rigs dwags kong rdzong gzhis khag nas 'don 'dren zhu dgos pa bcas red/hor sbyi/me 'brug(1916)lor hor tsho pa sum cu so dgu'i spyi khyab mkhan chung grags pa da ma rgyal dang / las bya rtse drung gnyis/ sa srung brgya dpon gcig dang / lding dpon bzhi bcas kyi rtsa ba'i spyi khyab las khang de steng chen du yod pa dang / hor tsho de bzhin sngar phan tsho shog so sor lding dpon/brgya dpon/ blon po/ rgan po bcas so sosagyurang khungs su khrims 'doms byed pa las/ sa gnas spyi khyab khrims 'dzin 'go 'doms dmigs bsal med stabs shog khag phan tshun nam/ stod smad tshong 'grul/ nang khul bcas la mi dpung dgra bsdebs kyis dgra jag rgyag res mi bsad rgyu 'phrog gi 'che ba rgyun mi chad pa yong gi yod stabs thog mar hor spyi grags rnam nas kyang nyes can byed gte srog thog dang / dbang po gcod breg sogs gang la de 'tshams kyi drag pori khrims gcod dang 'brel dril bsgrags yang yang byas rkyen rim bzhin tshang ma rtsa ba'i cha nas bag yod tshul gnas su gyur te mi gsod rgyu 'phrog byed mi je nyung du song ba ma zad/ rgya khyab tu ri klung skam gsher la gnas pa'i srog chags tshun la mi 'jig sro ga gi skyabs sbyin ri klung rgya sdems bstsal ba ltar khyung po khul du'ang rngon rgyag byed mi je nyung du song ba bcas mdor na khrul khrims 'aku/ ra shes byed kyi yod pa red/ spyir btang srid 'dzin spyi khyab yin na'ang 'dra/ rjo nga 'go gzhis sdod su 'dra zhig gi durnga yin rung / khyung po khul der 87

yun ring mi bsrun brlang spyod kyi mig ltos ngan 'phel dbang gis thog mar hor spyi grags rnam la skabs 'phral thag gcod byed thabs skor zhi drag thabs sgo gang mkhas kyis spyi dmangs bde 'jags kyi ched du thal lus med pa dgos rgyu'i dmigs bsal gyi bka' 'khrol yod pa red/ dpon khag brgya dpon/rgan lding dang / grub mtha' 'dra min gyi dgon sde che chung khag gi 'tsher sa lhas mal nor lug sogs sngar gyi thob thang gang yod dpon gnas so so'i go ming gdan thob dang bcas pa rang 'jags thog bar skabs g.yo khongs su sbug nyar byas pa'i nor lug rtsa yul/ sa ma 'brog khul du sa zhing bcas la spyi 'gre'i ga gzhung dang / sa tho 'god 'go btsugs te hor spri mkhan chung grags pa rgya mtsho tsam gyi bar ga gzhung dang / sa tho 'god rgyu mjug bsgril zin pa red/ tsho pa so dgu'i khongs sngar lam yul dmag chig stong skor gyi 'go 'doms mda' ru lding dpon dang bcas pa rang khungs tsho zhog so so'i 'go dpon spyi mos che ba drag 'dems kyis bsko gzhag thog dmag khrims dang /sgrigs srol tshang ma bod dmag spyi 'gre ltar tsa dang dmag sgar du bsgyur pa bcas red/ rgyal rtse tshong spyo/shing yos(1915)lo bod dbyin 'brel ba tshugs rjes rgyal rtse sa gnas su tshong spyi mkhan chung gcig bsko gzhag gnang zhing / de'i las 'gan ni skabs der rgyal rtser dbyin ji'i sbrag tar babs tshugs lte ba zhig dang / rgyal rtse nas gro mo bar sbrag tar babs tshugs le lag bcas btsugs yod pa de dag la do dam dang / dbyin ji'i tshong don spyi khyab ngo las dang / slob grwa'i lha

dacha/ rgan che chung / dmag mi bcas rgyal rtse lcang lor bca' sdod gtan 'khel rjes/ dbyin ji'i mi snar gzan shing dang / gzhan yang yul babs kyi nye mkho spus 'don/ bod phrug dbyin ji'i skad yig slob grwa ba rnams bskong 'gugs kyi bkod sgrig byed phyogs/ tshong don 'gag sgo'i las don bcas la spyi 'doms rgyal rtse tshong spyi mkhan chung dang / rgyal rtse rdzong sbrel zhogs 'degs kyis las don sgrub dgos pa bcas red/—gro spyo/me sbrul(1917)lo gro spyi rim bzhi mi rgyab pa bsko gzhag gis gro stod dba' gling sgang du gro spyi las khang gsar rgyag thog las bya yig 'bri soṭa gro mo stod smad khul nas gong 'thus zhes sngar lam mi ser gyi 'go 'tsho byed mkhan khag gcig yod pa de khongs nas drag 'dems kyis byed dgos pa dang /de'i las 'gan ni gro mo stod smad khul gyi khrims 'doms byed sgo spyi dang /lhag par shing yos nas bzung bod nyin tshong lam 'gag sgo phye stabs bod phyogs nas bal rnga pags rigs sogs spyir btang gi tshong zog ma yin pa'i gla rtsi/khrug rwa/ dom mkhris/ rtswa sman gyi rigs sogs rtsa che'i sman rdzas kyi rigs dngos shugs su 'dren tshong mi chog pa dang / phyi phyogs nas rdo tha/ shig ras/g.ya' phing / gzhan yang myos rdzas kyi rigs 'don 'dren mi chog pa'i tshong lam 'gag sgo'i do dam byed sgo dang / bod gzhung gi bka' dang ma 'brel bar phyi rgyal mi rigs su 'dra zhig yin rung bkag 'gog sa 'dres 'bras/ 'bruganyin rdu bcas kyi sa mtshams gal che'i gnad don rigs bod sa gnas srid gzhung la dgongs skor zhu dgos pa dang / mi ser phan tshun rtswa za chu 'thung 89

dang / mi rtsa'i skor la rtsod gleng rigs gro spyi khang rang nas thag gcod byed dgos pa bcas red/gzhis rtse spyi rdzong /gzhis rdzong bsam grub rtse ni de snga gnas lnga pa'i rdzong 'go'i gras shig yin rung / shing yos(1915)lo gzhis rtse spyi rdzong zhes gtsang khul gzhung khongs rdzong 'go gzhis khag spyi'i 'go 'doms su mkhan rim gnyis bsko gzhag gis gzhis rdzong rang gi 'char can khrul bsdu khrims gnon byed dgos pa smos med thog gtsang khul rdzong 'go gzhis khag so so'i gyod don dang / gzhan yang khrul rigs rgyugs phyogs skor sogs rdzong sdod so sos thag gcod ma thub pa'i rigs spyi rdzong du gtugs bsher byed dgos pa dang / des kyang thag gcod ma thub pa'i rigs khrims sa gong mar zhu gtugs byed dgos pa bcas red/mchan 'grel/ (gzhung bla'i dbar gyi gros don la gzhigs te shing rta (1954)lo gzhis rtse spyi rdzong sngar lam rdzong dkyus su btang ba dang / gtsang khul gzhung khongs rdzong gzhis khag gi spyi khyab tu gtsang spyi rim bzhi smon gling pa bsko gzhag byas pa red)/lho kha sbyi khrab/me sbrul(1917)lo nas bzung sto spyi mkhan che gcig bsko gzhag byas pa de'i las don byed phyogs thad gong gsal gzhis rtse spyi rdzong dang 'dra mtshungs red/ 90

byang spyi/rab byung 1༄chu rta(1942)lo hor tsho so dgu de snga gnas lnga pa'i rdzong 'go khag drug tu bgos te rdzong sdod ser skya nyis sbrel re bsko gzhag byas shing / nag chu 'di bzhin de snga gnas lnga pa'i rdzong 'go che gras shig yin rung / chu rta lo/ nag tshang shan rtsa rdzong / gnam ru sogs byang rigs sde bzhi dang / ru drug dpon 'go/ hor tsho pa so dgu'i khongs rdzong khag drug bcas byang rigs /zul gyi spyi 'doms byang spyi nag chu mkhan rim gnyis dang / las bya ser skya gnyis bcas bsko gzhag gis las don gal che'i rigs ma gtogs/ de byings zhe drag gi spyi 'doms byang spyi mkhan rim gnyis nas thag gcod byed dgos pa red/dwags kong spyo khyab/shing rta(1954)lo nas bzung dwags kong spyi khyab rim bzhi gcig bsko gzhag byas pa'i 'gan dbang spyi khyab gong mtshungs red/la stod spyi khrab/'di yang shing rta(1954)lor shel dkar rdzong sdod sbrel por bsko gzhag byas te shel dkar dang / mkhar rta/ rong shar/ rdzong dga'/ skyid grong /gnya' nang / sa dga'—/ 'brong pa bcas kyi khyab khongs 'gan dbang spyi sgob gong mtshungs red/91

phyogs mtha'i rdzong gzhis gras/stod sgar dang la stod lho byang khul/ ru thog rdzong sdod/ rtsa hreng rdzong sdod/ mda' khar rdzong sdod/ spu hreng rdzong sdod/ rdzong dga' rdzong sdod/ skyid grong rdzong sdod/ gnya' nang sho pa/ rong shar sho pa/ 'brong pa lho byang spyi khyab ('di rtse mkhan drung gi thab rten) sa dga' 'go sbrel/ shel dkar rdzong sbrel/mkhar rta gzhis sdod/ gtsang khul gzhis rtse rdzong sbrel/ rgyal rtse rdzong sbrel/rgyal rtse dpal chos mkhan po/ gting skyes rdzong sbrel/ srad rin chen rtse rdzong sbrel/ phag ri rdzong sbrel/ 'dus byung gzhis sdod/ pa rnam rdzong / dbang ldan gzhis sdod/ rin spung rdzong / gling dkar gzhis sdod/ lha bu gzhis sdod/ rgya mtsho gzhis sdod/ rnam gling rdzong / shangs dga' chos bla 'dzin('di gzim dpon mkhan po'i thab rten)/ nyug chos 'khor gling bla 'dzin('di rtse gzim 'gag khri pa'i thab rten)span rgya rgan gzhis sdod bcas dang / skya ser 'gro khungs gzhis sdod chung kha'i gras/ bo gdong bkras sgang gzhis/ rta nag rang byon gzhis('di bka' blon bla ma'i thab rten) chu dbar star gdong gzhis/ rgya shar gter sna gzhis/ rong bya bzang gzhis/ pa rnam bya tshang gzhis/ rgyal rtse lung dmar gzhis/dbus khul stod lung bde chen rdzong / snye mo smon mkhar rdzong / mar rkyang 'go pa/ yangs can rdzong / sbal tshang 'go pa/ 'phan po na leṇ+ḍa bla gnyer('di rtse mkhan mgron che ba'i thab rten)/ 'phan po lhun grub rdzong('di 9ཿ

rtse mkhan drung gi thab rten)/ za dam gzhis sdod/ mkhar rtse gzhis sdod/ glang thang gzhis sdod/ stag rtse rdzong sdod/ mal gro gong dkar rdzong sdod/ chu shur rdzong sdod/ zad gzhis sdod/ ljags smin ma gling she dpon/gzhis sdod chung kha'i gras/ chu shur lha gshongs gzhis/ mal gro rnam gling gzhis/ blon po gzhis/ rdzong 'og gzhis/ gyang grong gzhis/ gad hor gzhis/lho kha khul gong dkar rdzong sbrel/ sne gdong rdzong sbrel/ gra phyi gzhis sdod/ gra nang gzhis sdod/ dol dkyil thang gzhis sdod/ bsam yas rdzong sdod/'phyongs rgyas rdzong sbrel/ 'ol dga' gzhis sdod/ 'on gzhis sdod/ zangs ri gzhis sdod/ dar ma gzhis sdod/ lha khang rdzong sdod/ do rdzong rdzong sdod/ seng ge rdzong sdod/ bya yul gzhis sdod/ gri gu mthong smon rdzong sdod/ lhun rtse rdzong sbrel/ sbyor ra gzhis sdod/ mtsho sna rdzong sbrel/ yar 'brog gling rdzong sdod/ sna rtse rdzong sdod/ dpal di rdzong sdod/ kha reg lcags bam gzhis sdod/gzhis sdod chung kha'i gras/ sger pa gzhis sdod/ gla 'od gzhis/ gong dkar gnas gsar gzhis/ skyid gshongs gzhis/ pho brang gzhis/dwags kong khul/ dwags stod chos 'khor rgyal gnyer sdod/ snang gzhis sdod/ skyem stong rdzong sdod/ sku snam rdzong sdod/ rtse sgang rdzong sdod/ dga' rab bla gnyer/ de mo chab nag las 'dzin/ zing phu gzhis sdod/ jo mo rdzong sdod/zho kha gzhis sdod/ rgya mda' rdzong sdod/ lha ri 'go pa/ rgyal sgor gzhis sdod/byang rgyud khul/ shan rtsa rdzong sbrel/ gnam ru 'go sbrel/ hor tsho pa so dgu'i khongs sbra chen rdzong sbrel/ snyan rong rdzong sbrel/ nag shod 'bri ru rdzong sbrel/ steng chen rdzong sbrel/ gser kha rdzong sbrel/ sto nim khri rdo 'go sbrel/mdo smad khul/ rmar khams 'go pa/ sa ngan 'go pa/ gsang sngags ma (lha/snyi

chos rdzong / go 'jo gzhis sdod/ mdzo sgang rdzong sdod/ ri che bla gnyer/ rgyal ston gzhis sdod/ lho rdzong rdzong sdod/ star rdzong rdzong sdod/ sho mdo gzhis sdod/ rji tho lha gnyer/ 'dan ma mdzod pa/ go'o bla gnyer/ dar dgon mkhan po/ spo stod chu mdo rdzong / spo bo chos rdzong / spo smad yul gong rdzong /gong gsal yul 'brog rdzong gzhis che chung dang / bla gnyer 'gro khungs khag bcas kyi rgya khyon rkang 'don gyi grangs 'bor dang / 'brog pa'i sbra dud mang nyung / yul 'brog so so'i lo lo'i khrul sner gtogs pa'i rnam grangs sogs re re bzhin bkod kyis mi langs pas 'dir rdzong 'go che 'bring chung gsum dang /ser skya 'gro khungs gzhis sdod chung khag bcas nas dpe mtshon re bkod par/rdzong 'go che gras/gnas lnga pa'i rdzong gzhis che gras nas shel dkar rgyal rtse khul gzhung rgyugs rkang bzhi brgya bcu med gcig dang lnga cha gcig nyer bzhi'i cha/ chos gzhis 'don nyis brgya nyi shu phyed rtsa bdun dang brgya cha nyi shu'i cha/ sger pa 'don bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi datre bcu cha gcig dang / brgyad cu tham pa'i cha/ 'brog pa sbra dud lnga bcu nga gsum/ bkras lhun chos gzhis rkang bzhi bcu phyed zhe gcig dang drug cha gcigargyal rtse rdzong yongs kyi yong 'bab gras/ bzang 'bru ru'i khal sum khri bdun stong brgya med sum cu so gsum bre bzhi phul phyed gsum/ chu yos rtsa tshig dgongs don khal rer dngul skar phyed brgyad re'am/ 'bru rkyang gang bde len pa 'bru khal chig khri chig stong brgya med bcu med gcig dang bre do phul med lnga cha gcig zong 'bru zhes pa ru'i khal lnga bcu nga dgu bre bdun phu 'a/ 94

bzhi/ rtsam khal nyis brgya lnga bcu nga lnga bre bcu gsum phul phyed gsum/ snum khal nyis brgya btsa brgyad bre bdun phul lnga/ phyur phye khal bcu bzhi bre bcu drug tshwa khal lnga bcu nga gcig bre gsum phul bzhi/ rgya tshos khal bdun cu tham pa dang bre gsum/ nyung skam khal bcu bdun bre bcu phul bzhi/ gser sgor zho bcu bdun/ dngul srang dgu dang zho lnga skar lnga/ ja nga hang rmar 'degs khal bcu gsum nyag med spor do/ mar brdzis 'degs khal brgyad brgya dgu bcu go lnga nyag bcu bzhi spor phyed gsum dang / mar dkrog 'degs khal brgya dang bcu gnyis nyag gang / sha dkar 'degs khal chig khri lnga stong dgu brgya dgu bcu tham pa dang nyag bcu drug spor phyed gsum/ tshag sha 'degs khal brgya dang bcu tham pa dang nyag bcu dgu/ ra sha 'degs khal nyis brgya sum cu so lnga nyag dgu spor do/ tshil 'degs khal bcu gnyis nyag bcu drug spor do/ rnga dkar dang rnga nag bsdoms 'degs khal sum brgya sum cu so gsum/ ser bal spus legs 'degs khal lnga brgya bcu med gcig dang nyag do spor do/dkyus bal 'degs khal nyis stong lnga brgya lnga bcu nga drug nyag bcu gnyis spor phyed do/ ra spu 'degs khal brgya dang sum cu so gsum nyag bcu bzhi spor gsum/ dmar tshos spus legs 'degs khal sum cu so brgyad nyag bcu bzhi spor phyed gsum/ lcags dkar dang / ñca gas dkrol 'degs khal brgya dang sum cu so bzhi nyag do spor gang / lcags rdzog 'degs khal nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig nyag bco brgyad spor phyed/ rtsa snam spus 'bring 'dom drug cu re drugaja snam spus 'bring 'dom brgya dang brgyad cu gya gcig khru do mtho med sor brgyad/ yul snam spus 'bring 'dom lnga bcu nga gnyis/ gtsang snam dkar po 'dom bcu drug zong snam spus 'bring 'dom sum brgya brgyad/ gzhung snam spus 'bring 'dom brgya dang nyi shu tham pa/ snam sag 'dom nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ rnga snam 95

'dom bdun dang khru do/ khul snam 'dom nyi shu rtsa bdun khru do dang / cung spus zher 'dom drug cu re drug re snam 'dom drug cu re dgu/ ra spu'i thag pa 'dom bcu drug dang khru gsum/ rtsa thag 'dom bzhi brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu khru gsum/ gos bkras thag ngo gnyis/ rgyal thag ngo gsu/ma/ sman rnying kha bzhi/ras rab yug sum cu so gsum dang / 'bring yug gcig pen 'dab ngo bdun cu don gnyis/ bal dril yug gnyis/ lho ras spus 'bring yug bco lnga/lcags dkrol ngo bcu drug dgra mda'i mde'u tshad mtshungs cha chig stong sum brgya tham pa/ gri chung mkhyid re yod pa ngo sum cu so lnga/ snyung bu ngo gsum/khab chen gsum/ lcags ras gang rung ngo sum cu so lnga/ phag shog bre kha brgya dang drug cu re yod pa'i dum pa gsum/ phying leb gru bzhi ma bcu/ snam byang ngo bdun dang drug cha gcig bal rgyab long gcig phad bu brgyad cu/ rta sga gcig ko bub nyi shu rtsa gsum bzhi cha gcig snyug slom che ba lnga dang / chung ba bcu/ chang tshod phyed gnyis/ chang ltir sum cu so brgyad/ rdza phru drug cu/rdza lter cha gcig 'jam lngags zer ba'i bal sna thung sbyar ba ngo nyis brgya bcu med drug tshags sbub gcig lug khog nyi shu rtsa gsum/ rtsid sha brang med mjing sbyar khog bcu bzhi/ lug mgo brgya dang lnga/ ra mgo gcig lug brang lnga/ ngang sgong chig stong nyis brgya lnga bcu/ bya sgong bdun brgya bcu bdun/ nya sha khru tshad longs pa nyis stong drug brgya lnga bcu/ sgog rdog bzhi bcu re yod pa'i chag nga bzhi bcu zhe gcig dang / sum cu re yod pa'i chag pa bcu dgu/lug rgyab 'byar gnyis/ ra thong lnga bcu nga brgyad/ g.yag so drug pa gsum/lug thong brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ ra tsher mo bzhi bcu/ sngo rtswa sdud rgya'i rgya ma nyis brgya lnga bcu nga gsum/ sngo rtswa 'degs khal bzhi stong brgya dang sum cu so lnga/ ljang skam 'degs khal drug cu re brgyad/ yog rtsa 'degs khal bzhi 96 —
