stong drug brgya suca/ cu so dgu/ skya rtswa 'degs /bal nyis khri su/myo/ stong brgya dang brgyad cu gya bdun nyag do/ shing skam 'degs khal dgu stong nyis brgya bcu gcig lci skam 'degs khal nyis stong nyis brgya dang dgu bcu go gcig nyag gsum spor do/ bsang shing 'degs khal brgya dang sum cu so gsum dang /rlon 'degs rgya ma bdun cu don lnga/ gla shing rlon 'degs khal nyis stong bzhi brgya sum cu so gnyis nyag do/ skya tsher rlon 'degs kyi khal dgu brgya tham pa/rta sbangs skam 'degs khal bzhi brgya sum cu so lnga/ shing rgyab drug cu tham pa/ rnga mong sbangs rlon 'degs khal chig stong nyis brgya dgu bcu go lnga/ rtswa 'khur tshad sum cu tham pa/ cho lo sgye tshad sum cu tham pa/ la spang leb ngo chig khri lnga stong bdun brgya bzhi bcu zhe lnga bcas rnams/rdzong gzhis 'bring gras/gnas drug pa'i rdzong gzhis 'bring gras rin spungs rdzong khongs gzhung rgyugs rkang nyis brgya nyi shu phyed rtsa brgyad bzhi cha gcig chos gzhis 'don nyi shu phyed rtsa bzhi dang sum cu tham pa'i cha gcig sger pa 'don dgu bcu phyed go gcig lnga cha phyed gnyis dang brgyad cu tham pa'i cha gcig bkras lhun chos gzhis 'don rkang brgya dang phyed nyi shu tham pa dang brgyad cha gcig 'brog pa sbra dud gsum/ rdzong yongs kyi 'bab bzang 'bru ru'i khal chig khri chig stong lnga brgya drug cu tham pa dang bre do phul gsum/ bra'o khal bdun cu don snga bre brgyad phul lnga/ chu yos rtsa tshig dgongs don khal rer dngul skar phyed brgyad re len pa'am yang na 'bru rkyang gang bde len pa 'bru khal su/ma stong bdun brgya bcu med gnyis dang bre bcu gcig rtsam khal bcu dang bre gang phul gsum/ 97

rdzong gzhis chung gras/gnas bdun pa'i rdzong gzhis chung gras rgya mtsho gzhis sdo da khongs gzhung rgyugs /rkang bzhi bcu zhe gnyis dang dru ga cha gcig chos gzhil 'don bcu drug dang bzhi cha phyed gnyis// sger pa 'do na nyi shu rtsa bdun dang brgyad cha gcig bcas yong pa red/ rdzo nga yongs kyi lo 'khor gcig gi yong 'bab gras bzang 'bru ru'i khal lnga stong brgya med brgyad cu gya lnga bre bcu bdun phul do/ chu yos rtsa tshig dgongs don khal rer dngul dkar phyed brgyad re'am/ yang na 'bru rkyang gang bde len pa/ 'bru ru'i khal dgu brgya bzhi bcu zhe gcig bre med phu ge phyed/ tshwa khal brgya dang drug cu tham pa dang bre dgu phul gsum/snum bre sum cu so lnga/ bzang ja 'degs / bal bco brgyad/ mar brdzis 'deṭa khal brgya dang dgu bcu ngo/ bdun nyag bzhi spor phyed/ phyur ba 'degs tsā/ la bcu gnyis dang bre phyed do/ sha dkar 'degs khal nyis stong brgya med brgyad bcu gya dgu nyag bzhi spor gsum/ nag sha 'degarnga khal sum brgya drug cu re gnyis nyag dgu spor gsum/ lug mgo gsu ma/ lug brang gcig g.yag grus gcig lug thong gnyis/ ra thong gnyis/ sngo rtswa 'degs khal chig stong brgya med bcu med bdun dang nyag bcu/ skya rtswa 'degs khal chig khri lnga stong bdun brgya lnga bcu nga sa/sumyo/ nyag do/ lci ba 'degs khal chig khri bdun stong drug brgya lnga bcu nga gcig nyag gang spor do/ sol ba 'degs khal bzhi brgya brgya da cu gya lnga/ la spang leb brgyad brgya sum cu so brgyad bcas rnams/seh+phu skya 'gro khungs kyi gzhis sdod chung ba'i khongs nas 'bring gras rgyal rtse rngo nga khongs lung dmar gzhis nas gzhis sdod ngo g.yog bzhi dang / rmang 9pyi

zan pho mo/ phyugs ri3sa gzan chas bcas kyi phyi 'gro phud lo ltar gzhis 'bru ru'i khal nyis stong drug brgya bcu bdun dang bre bcu gnyis phul phyed gsum re de snga rgyal rtser bkar 3jug rgyag dgos kyang sa rta nas bzung rgyal rtse/ phag ri khul gyi sbrag phogs kha sbrags su btang zhing / rgyal rtse rdzong yongs su 'bab pa/gzan rtswa 'degs khal sum stong brgyad brgya bcu bdun/ yong khrul lug sha chung khog bcu gnyis/ lug mgo bco brgyad/ yong 'bru khal sum cu so gcig bre gsum phul do/ yul snam spus legs 'dom bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ sbra snam 'dom bcu gnyis/ ra khul rgya ma sum cu so gnyis bcas rnams/gong gsal rdzong che 'bring so sor lo ltar bkar rgya yong sdud pa zhes ser skya mi 'gro gnyis re dang / chung gras la mi 'gro re bcas rtse shod ser skya las med khongs nas res 'khor gyis gtong lam bzhin lo re'i yong khrul bsdu len dang / gzhis 'bru'i bkar 'jug sogs rdzong sbrel dang / yong sdud pa/bkar rgya ba/ las drung / gtso drag rgan po bcas gzhis byes 'khur mnyam len gyis bsdu len thob/ gzhung rtse shod phyag mdzod sogs las khungs khag la 'char can sgrig 'bul zhu dgos pa phud/ rdzong gzhis khungs so sor mchod rgyun gyis gtsos gtong deb nang gsal phyi 'gro chad lus med pa btang thog bkar khang khag la bkar rgya bas sgo rgya thel bsnan gyis rdzong gtsor rtsis sprod byed dgos pa dang / bkar yong mi 'gro so sor las rgyun phogs thob 'char can yong /sga/ ka thog nas len dgos pa bcas red/ tshwa sho khagargya khyab tshwa bal/ pags ri gas ja bcas kyi sho khrul bsdu dam ser skya'i 100

'gro khungs gras/ ru thog tshwa sho/ spu hreng tshwa sho/ yan chod steng dkar tshwa shi ('di rtse mkhan drung gi thab rten)'brong pa lho byang tshwa sho/ lha ngam phun gsu ma tshwa sho/ bzhad rta tshwa sho/ lha rgya rnam gsum tshwa sho/ 'od yug gling dkar tshwa sho/phag ri ja sho/ khang nag tshwa sho/ mar snye tshwa sho/ yangs can tshwa sho/ sbas tshang tshwa sho/ 'bri gung tshwa sho/ mdo smad khul rmar khams tshwa kha lho'i tshwa sho/ smyug gru tshwa sho/ 'dan khog tsha sho/ sde dge skam thog tshwa sho/ sto rdzong tshwa sho/ tsho stod tshwa sho/ tsho smad tshwa sho/ nag chu tshwa sho/ ri che lcags zam tshwa sho/ spo bo stod smad tshwa sho/ gong gsal mdo smad khal gyi rdzong gzhis so so'i tshwa sho'i yong 'bab cumado spyir rtsis zhu dang / dbus gtsang stod sgar bcas kyi tshwa sho'i sho khral dngul 'bab rnams ja tshwa las khungs su rtsis zhu dang 'brel lo ltar rtse rnam gan du ja khrul dang chabs cig bkar 'jug rgyag dgos pa bcas so / 101

de snga'i bla drang rgyal mtshan mkhron po'i srid 'asdan sgri ga gzhi spyi'i gnas tshul/sle zur 'jigs med dbang phyagabade zur rin chen dbang 'dus/paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos/ kyi rgyal mtshan dgung grangs so gcig bzhes pa'i tshe rab byung bcu pa'i lcags glang (spyi lo1601)lor gdan satshobakra shir+sha/ lhu na po'i chos kyi khri 'phang mthon por mnga' gsol ba nas bzung bkrar+sā lhu/na 'di nyid paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi skyong yul gdan sar gyur pa dang / paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sku tshe'i stod char thos bsam sgom gsum dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum sogs chos phyogs kyi mdzad pa wo/ na bskyang pa las/ srid 'byor zang zing gi nyams bzhes mdzad mi 'dug 'on kyang skabs de'i bod kyi srid dbang skyong mi gtsang pa rka/ma bstan skyong dbang po chos lugs grub mtha'i rmongs zhen phyogs lhung che bas zhwa ser gyi bstan pa dang / de 'dzin gyi bla ma dgon sde sbyin bdag dang bcas nga/ ra sdang sems gnod 'tshe rim par bgyis stabs zhwa ser ring lugs kyi bstan pa ru /nga skyo ba dang / lhag par rgyalnga/ dbang sku phreng bzhi pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin banadasmya/ zhu bya rgyu'i thad 'a/ sde srid nga/tsang pa'o 'bo/ga /rkyen sel thabs su sku ngal 10 4

'dzems med dang thabs rnam du ma'i sgo nas phyag las mang po gnang dgos rte 7 (byung / mthar rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta(1642)lor dge lugs pa'i rgyab rten sog po go shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis drag shugs la brten nas gtsang pa rgyal po'i srid dbang mgo rting bslogs ste tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang rgya mtsho bod ljongs kyi srid dbang bdag por mnga' gsol ba dang /dga' lngan pho brang gi srid gzhung dbu brnyes pa dang chabs cig paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyal la'ang sbog to zhes pa'i mtshan dang chos gzhis sbyor 'jags sogs bkur bzos chen po zhub/ pa dang bcas dge lugs pas srid dbang 'dzin pa'i dus rabs 'go tshugs pa dang bstun nas gdan sa bkra shis lhun por yang de sngon rgyal dbang dge 'dun grub pa'i sku dus su chos gzhis phyug gzhung dar rgyas gcig pu las med pa nas paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa'i skabs mnga' khongs gzhis khag nyi shu lhag tsam bar 'phel rgyas byung ba dang / srid 'dzin las khungs bla brang rtse dang / shod/ gnyer tshang bcas gsum gsar btsugs gnang zhing / rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing smrel(1644)lor paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyal gyis se chen chos rje pho nyar mngags brdzong gnang ste man ching gong ma rgyan kri la gong bkur 'brel gtugs zhu gnang mdzad pa dang / gong mas kyang paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyal la‘‘bla na med pa ’zhes pa'i mtshan dang / bkra shis lhun po'i bdag por dbang bskur ba sogs kyi gzengs bstod bdag rkyen gnang ba bcas las de snga chos phyogs rkyang pa'i zhwa ser ring lugs kyi dgon sde zhig nas chos srid zung 'brel du gyur pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon po'i srid dbang sgrig gzhi'i thog ma'i rmang gzhi chags pa dang / rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu sbrul( 1713)lor ching gong ma khang shi bde skyid rgyal pos paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes la gzengs bstod kyi 'ja' sa dang / 〈bka' yis bkur 103

ba'i paṇa chen er ti ni'i tham ga〉zhes pa'i gser tham bstsal ba dang chabs cig srid 'dzin las khungs 'phar snon dang / mnga' khongs rgya skyed je cher phyin pa bcas ching gong ma'i lung las tham ga dang 'brelnga ba'i gtsang khul du rang tshugs kyi srid dbang dngos su chags shing / de rjes/ paṇa chen sku phreng rim pa'i sku dus so sor chab srid sgrig gzhi dang / mnga' ris rgya khyon rim bzhin 'phel rgyas byung ste mthar paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i sku dus bar te rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa phag( 1959 )lo'i skabs dngos yod phyi nang srid 'dzin las khungs dang tshan pa gsar rnying bsdom 60 skor/ rim pa bdun pa zhabs sdod yan gyi ser skya zhabs 'bring mi grangs 270lhag tsam dang / drung thob dang /drung 'dra/ kan pu'u/ las mgron/ gnyer nang gzan/ zhal ngo / lag do/brang mchod pa zer ba sogs kyi spyir btang sto gzan las don mi sna bsdoms mi grangs 600 skor/ 'phrul 'khor slob grwa ba mi grangs 200 lhag tsam/ rtse slob grwa ba mi grangs 80 skor/ sku spung dmag mi ying shog gcig srid gzhung gis skyong khongs su gtogs pa'i rdzong 3dang rdzong dang 'dra ba'i gzhis ka che gras 5 / gzhis ka 'bring chung 68 / sa zhing son khal khri 20 lhag tsam/ 'brog ra 26 / gnag phyugs mgo grangs khri 2lhag tsam(sger chos gnyis kyi sa rten dang 'brog ra tshud med)/ mnga' khongs dgon sde 220 skor bcas yod pa red/de yang bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po zhes pa'i ming gi 'byung tshul ni rgyal dbang sku phreng dang po rje dge 'dun grub pas rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos(spyi lo 1447)lor dgon pa bkra shis lhun po phyag 'debs gnang mdzad thogarje nyed kyi bzhugs gnas bla brang gsar bskrun gnang zhing / nub gcig rje nyid kyi mnal lam mtshan ltas su bla brang gi rtse mor rgyal mtshan bcu gcig btsugs pa zhig rmis pa la brten nas ming de ltar btags par grags so/ / 104

rtse skor las khyangs gras/yongs 'dzin lgang /yongs 'dzin gnyis sam gcig gang rung gnang srol yod pa dang /yongs 'dzin la srid phyogs kyi mtshan gnas rim pa dmigs bsal med kyang /chos phyogs nas paṇa chen rin po che mchog phud/ de min bla sprul dang / ser skya dpon rigs su 'dra zhig las kyang mtshan gnas dang gdan thob mtho ba yod/ yongs 'dzin gyi thugs 'gan gtso bo ni/ paṇa chen rin po cher mdo sngapa/sa chos kyi sku yon slob 'bul gnang rgyu de yin pa dang / gzhan yang mtshan zhabs pa dang / phyag dpe zhus dag pa sogs la 'go khrid bka' bkod gnang rgyus cha/tshon pa'i chos phyogs kyi mdzad sgo gang cir zhal ta slob ston gnang dgos pa red/mtshan zhabs pa gsum ni/ gzhung bka' pod chen po lnga la gsan sbyangs mthar phyin pa'i bkras lhun gdan sa'i dge bshes kyi nang nas drag 'dems bsko bzhag gnang gi yod pa dang / rim pa drug pa las tshan pa'i gdan thob yod/ de'i las 'gan ni yongs 'dzin gyi 'go khrid 'og paṇa chen rin po cher mtshan nyid rtsod 'bul gnang rgyu de yin/phyag dpe zhus dag pa gcig ni/ gdan sa'i dge 'dun khongs nas ming rtags gang rung yod la/ rig gnas chu tshad nges can yod pa zhig la bsko bzhag gnang gi yod pa dang / rim pa bdun pa zhabs sdod pa'i gdan thob yod/ de'i las 'gan ni/ yongs 'dzin gyi 'go khrid 'og paṇa chen rin po 10bya

che'i gzigs dpe khag la zhib zhus bya rgyu de yin/ sku bcar gsol gzim mchod gsum/gsol dpon mkhan po dang / gzim dpon mkhan po/ mchod dpon mkhan po gsum la rtse drung rim pa bzhi pa che ba mkhan che'i go gnas yod/gtso bo'i las 'gan ni rgyun du paṇa chen rin po che mchog gi sku'i gam bcar zhabs zhu gnang dgos pa dang / nang gses gsol dpon mkhan pos rtse gsol thab dang / gsol ba sgang gi spyi 'doms 'go khrid dang / gzim dpon mkhan pos na sgang gi spyi 'doms 'go khrid/ mchod dpon mkhan pos mchod dpon khang gi spyi 'doms 'go khrid bcas gnang dgos pa red/rtse gsol thab/de ni gsol dpon mkhan po'i thad ka'i bkod 'doms 'og rim pa drug pa'i ma chen rtse drung las tshan pa gcig dang / rim pa bdun pa'i gsol thab rtse drung gsum/ chab bsu rtse drung gcig chab drel zhal ngo skya bo gcig dang lag do gnyis/ chu ma gnyis/ gsol thab lag g.yog grwa pa gsum dang bkru gad pa gcig zhib rdzog pa gcig shing len pa skya bo gnyis/ gsol dkrum ljags smin 'go pa drung gtogs gcig dang / bcu gsucha/ zhib rkyal(zla re'i tshes 13 nam yin la 'bul dgos pa'i ljangs smin gsol zhib)'go pa drung gtogs gcig bzhes tshal ljags smin 'go pa drung gtogs gcig da dung paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i sku dus nas rgya zas ma chen rgya rigs gnyis dang / lag g.yog kha shas bcas yod pa red/106

larnga 'gan thad/ rgyun gtan nyin ltar rtse'i ljags smin dang / yongs 'dzin/ sku bcar/ phyi'i sku mgron bcas par skabs bstun rgyanag badzu sa sna tshoṭa kyi gsol tshig nyin ltar zhogs pa'i drung ja bcas 'bul katong zhu dgos thogadagung gsar dang / bcu gsu/ma mchod/ dbyar kha'i smon nam/ gzigs mo che mo/ chang/ zhugs/ dgu gtor sogs mdzad sgo khag gi skabs 'phar ma'i ljags smin gsol tshigs 'bul gshoms dang / zhabs 'bring ser skya dang / phyi mgron rnams la gsol ja dang gro 'bras/ bzhes thug sogs gtong dgos/rtse gsol thab tu rgyun spyod dngul dkar dngul sde ra gyis mtshon pa'i yol go yo chas rtsis rikhrir yod mus thog dus chen mdzad sgo khag gi skabs rin chen sna tshogs kyi phra ldan gser gyi zo lag bzhes skyogs rang 'grig dang /gser gyi gsol lter/ dngul gco/nga dang dngul t+tar sogs gsom dpon mkhan po brgyud skabs bstun rtsis sprod zhu dgos/tso gsol thab dang / gsor ba sgang gnyis kyi 'char 'phar dgos cha mang che ba bla brang phyag mdzod dang / khag gcig rtse phyag nas zhu gtong byed dgos pa bcas red/gsol ba sgang / 'di yang gsol che mkhan po'i thad ka'i 'go khrid 'og rim pa drug pa'i gsor khudegs rtse drung las cha na pa gcig dang / bzhes bsgar lag rtsal pa grwa pa gsuca// lag g.yog bzhi/ shing len thab g.yog mi gnyis bcas yod/ de'i gtso bo'i las 'gan ni rtse'i ljags smin bzhes gsol gyi rigs dang / gsol dkrumyo/ rdog sha'i rigs bzo 'bu' zhu dgos pa'i thob/ da dung rtse gsol thab la 107

gzhogs 'degs kyis skabs bstun ljags smin gsol tshigs bzo rogs zhu dgos/ lhag par ṭīdzad sgo khag gi mar btsos bzhes gsol sna tshogs bsgar dgos pa/ dper na/ mar sol/ 'bud bsgril/ rmyag thung / nya bshags/skam sregs/ 'bu lu'u/ sin tog bzhes kham mam spel zhi/ go ra/ skrag sgor sogs gang dgos ldeng nges gsol ba sgang nas bsgar batho 'bul gtong zhu dgos pa bcas red/na bza' sgang /sku bcar gzim dpon mkhan pos gtso 'gan 'khur 'og gzim 'gag khri pa dang spyan bsal lam sku'i gam bcar zhabs zhu ba tshos paṇa chen rin po che mchog gi rgyun bzhes na bza' bdag gnyer dang / mdzad sgo'i na bza' go sgrig sgron 'bul/ na bza' gsar 'tshems zhu rgyu sogs kyi 'gan 'khur zhu dgos pa red/ mchod dpon khang /sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po'i thad ka'i 'go khrid dang bkod 'doms 'og rtse mchod dpon dang rim pa drug pa'i rtse drung las tshan pa gcig dang mchod bzhengs pa kha shas yod pa de tshos rgyun gtan gzim chung khag gi sna lnga'i mchod sprin dang 'phar ma'i zhabs rim dang mja da sgo khag gi nyer mchod kyi dgos cha rnams 'brel yod las khungs nas zhus te sgrig 'bul zhu dgos pa red/108

rtse gzim chung 'gagartse gzim 'gag ni 'go 'dzin rtse drung rim pa bzhi pa'i mgron gnyer che mo gcig dang / las bya rtse drung rim pa lnga pa'i mgron gnyer mi grangs drug bdun tsam/ rtse drung rim pa drug pa las tshan pa'i go gnas yod pa'i gzim 'gag mi bzhi bcas las grub pa zhig yin pa dang / rtse gzim 'gag nas thad kar do dam bkod 'doms byed yul gyi tshan pa dang mi sna'i gras su phebs byams 'go pa dang / gar pa/ rtse 'grems pa/ gdan gnyer/ brang mchod pa/rtse gad pa bcas yod/ rtse gzim 'gag gi gtso 'gan 'khur mi ni mgron gnyer che mo yin zhing / de'i gtso bo'i 'gan dbang ni paṇa chen rin po che ma chog la phyi nang gang thad nas snyan zhu dang / snyan seng mjal phyag bcas zhu 'byor rigs bdag sprod gong zhu gnang rgyu dang / zhabs 'bring gsar bsko dang / gnas spar/ gnas dbyung / chad gcod sogs kyis mtshon pa'i paṇa chen rin po che'i phyir phebs kyi bka' mtha' dag bsgyur rgyu/ 'char 'phar rtse'i sku tshab tu mgron che ngo ma'am/ mgron gnyer mngags gtong gnang dgos riṭa kyi 'khur 'gan sgrub rgyu/ nyin re'i drung ja dang / dgung gsar gyis gtsos pa'i lo re'i 'char 'phar mdzad sgo che phra/ phyi dang gzim chung gi mjal phyag bcas tshang ma'i sgrig bkod do dam gnang rgyu sogs red/mgron gnyer rnams kyi las 'gan ni mgron che'i bka' bkod 'og mgron cher gzhogs 'degs zhus te rtse gzim chung 'gag gi 'gan bab las 'gan zhu sgo rnams 'thus tshang legs bsgrub yong ba byed dgos pa red/gzim 'gag bzhi'i las 'gan ni mdzad sgo dang mjal kha tshang ma'i gus 109

lugs sgrig lam gnon 'doms byed rgyu dang / rgyun gtan res bskor gyis nyin gang paṇa chen rin po che'i bzhugs gnas pho brang gi gzim sgo'i 'gag tu sdo da gdan mthon po zhig gi steng sku'i srung bya lta bur bsdad de gus lugs dang mi 'tshams pa'i snang tshul thon rigs bkag 'gog bkod 'doms byed dgos pa/zhogs pa gzim chung so so'i gad 'phyis byed dgos pa sogs red/ gzim 'gag ni bkras lhun dgon gyi khams bod grwa rigs nang nas gzugs stobs che shos bdams gses kyis bsko bzhag gnang gi yod pa dang / gzim 'gag tshang mar rgyun du tsan dan yu can gyi rta lcag re 'khyer rgyu yod pa dang / da dung chibs bsgyur skabs 'phar du‘‘'bog lcag’rices gzig lngags rgyong can ril mo skud dmar 'dzar ldan zhig 'khyer te paṇa chen rin po che'i phebs sner bskyod nas phebs lam g.yas g.yon mi tshogs kyi sgrig srung bdod 'doms byed kyi yod/gzim 'gag gis sgrig lam gnon 'doms byed skabs sgrig 'gal byed po dpon dmangs ser skya drag zhan su 'dra zhig yin rung rta lcag bzhu ba dang / gshe gshe gtong chog pa'i dbang cha yod pa red/bla sman ba/bla sman pa rgan pa rim pa drug pa'i rtse drung gcig dang / gzhon pa rim pa bdun pa'i rtse drung gcig yod cing / gtso bo'i las 'gan ni paṇa chen rin po che mchog gi sku khams la brtag dpyad dang / gsol sman 'bul rgyu sogs sku'i 'phrod bzhes kyi snyun khams la sman bcos zhu rgyu dang / bod sman bzo sbyor dang slob phrug gso skyong gi las 'gan yang 'khur dgosdo/ pa red/ zhar byung du spyi tshogs thog gi nad par yang lta gi yod pa red/110

rtse mgon khang pa/'di ni paṇa chen sku phreng bdun pa'i sku dus rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing bya(1826)lor kun skyob gling pho brang gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / chabs cig rtse mgon tshogs pa gsar btsugs gnang zhing / ming gzhan rtse sku sger grwa tshang srid gsum rnam rgyal gling yang ther/ tshogs pa 'di'i dbu 'dzin gtso bo rdo rje slob dpon gcig dang / de 'og dbu mdzad dang / 'cham dpon/gnyer pa sogs 'go byed dang las sne kha shas yod pa dang / tshogs pa yongs la mgon khang pa ste dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu lhag tsam yod pa red/de'i las 'gan ni/ gzhis byes gang du yin rung paṇa chen rin po che mchog gi chos lugs mdzad sgo che phra mtha' dag gi chog zhabs zhu rgyu dang /chibs ba/sgyur khag gi skabs sku'i nyer chas gdan zhu dang / spyan 'dren rgya gling gtong rgyu/ gzim brda snyan seng gi dung rgya gtong rgyu sogs yin pa dang /tshogs spra 'di'i rgyun gtan chos lugs kyi gnang sgo ni spya rdor dang / phyag rdor 'khor chen/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa/ rnam rgyal ma bcas kyi cho ga dang /lo ltar bod zla 8pa'i zla stod la gzigs mo chen po zhes kun skyob gling dang /bde chen pho brang gang rung du(deng sang bkras dgon skyid nar byed pa)k+ṣi ṭa pa'i dus gtor gar 'cham zor 'phen dngos gzhi nyin gnyis dang / de'i gong 'og gi nyin gnyis la 'cham rgyugs dang / rten gsol(sku rtsed kyang zer)zer ba bcas khyon nyin bzhi'i ring gar 'cham 'khrub ston gnang dgos pa dang / paṇa chen rin po che mchog zhabs 'bring ser skya yongs rdzogs dang bcas pa 'cham gzigs mdzad sgor phebs kyi yod pa red/ de'i skabs sa khul phyi nang gang sa 111

naskyurga yong ba'i ltad mo ba mi grangs khri kha shas 'du 'dzoms byed pa dang chabs cig gling gtong spro skyid kyi byed sgo rgya che spel gyi yod pa red/rtse mgon khang pa'i lha mi'i mchod rgyun dgos gron mang che ba rtse phyag nas zhu gtong byed dgos pa dang / tshogs pa de rang la spyi gsog mchod rgyun ma rtsa yang khag gcig yod pa red/ rtse mdzod sbugalas khungarngashrī 'di'i gtso bo'i 'gan dbang ni/ paṇa chen rin po che mchog sku sger gyi gser dngul dar gos la sogs pa'i phyag rdzas che phra ji yod kyi bdag gnyer do dam zhu rgyu dang / sku sger khongs kyi gzhis khag dang she 'brog khag nas deb gsal khrul 'bab rnams bsdu len bya rgyu/ dad sbyin khag la gzim chung mjal kha zhus stsal gyi 'bul dngos rnams bsdu 'jug zhu rgyu/ 'bab steng nas sngar lam deb gsal dang 'phar ma'i mchod rgyun gtong sgo'i rigs dus thog tu gtong dgos pa sogs yin zhing / chu phag(1923)lor paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa rgya sog yul grur gsang phebs mdzad dgos byung rjes gdan sa'i gzim chung khag gi sku chas la dam gnon gyis sku gnyer so sor rtsis sprad de mdzod sbug las khungs rang bzhin med par gyur pa dang / mgron gnyer che mos 'go pa byed pa'i mdzod chung zer ba zhig btsugs nas de'i gtso bo'i byed sgo ni sngar yod mdzod sbug gi ma dngul rnams skyed bun la gtong len bya rgyu dang / skyed dngul yong 'bab thog nas chu shar mo dgon sogs mdzod sbug khongs gtogs kyi dgon pa so sor sngar lam mchod phogs sprod rgyu sogs tsam red/ 11ཿ

chu 'brug(1952)lo paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod rjes lhan bcar mdzod sbug gi rmang gzhi'i thog sngar gyi mdzod sbug las khungs bskyar gso legs sgrig gnang zhing / mdzod sbug gi 'go 'dzin sku bcar gsol gzim mchod gsum thog drung yig rtse mgron gcig dang / nang rnam gcig las bya ser skya dang btang thung las ka byed mkhan bcas mi kha shas yod pa red/ de nas bzung mdzod spug gi sngar yod 'gan dbang khyab khongs bskyar gso rang 'jags thog rjes su da dung mdzod sbug gi thad gtogs tshong don las khungs 'phar 'dzugs gnang ba red/'phrul 'khor do dam las khungs/'di ni shing lug(1955)lor 'phrul 'khor slob grwa gsar btsugs gnang ba'i rmang gzhi'i thog chu khyi(1968)lor gsar btsugs gnang ba zhig yin pa dang / de'i 'khur 'dzin pa gtso bo tā bla ma gcig dang / rim bzhi skya bo gcig las bya zhabs 'bring ser skya khag gcig bcas yod pa red/las khungs de'i 'gan dbang ni/ 'phrul 'khor las khungs dang / rtse mgron chas sne phen las khungs kyi las don la thad ka'i 'go khrid do dam byed dgos pa de red/'phrul 'khror las khungs la rlangs 'khor dang / glog brnyan/ bzo las/rta rtsal bcas ru khag bzhi la khyon bcu shog bcu bdun dang / ru mi nyis brgya lhag tsam yod pa dang / ru khag bzhi la ru dpon rim pa drug pa'i las tshan pa ser skya mi grangs drug dang / bcu shog rer bcu dpon rgan gzhon gnyis re (bcu dpon rgan pa mang che ba zhabs sdod go ming yod pa)bcas yod pa red/ ru 113

khag so sos ru dpon gyi bkod 'doms 'og rnam kun 'gan bab las don dang / ched las lag rtsal slo ba sbyong byed rgyu phud/ da dung bod mig snyan su/ d+ngha / dag byed dang / rtsis rig rgya yig lus rtsal/ rol mo/ glu gzhas bcas slob sbyong byed dgos pa dang / sbyang 'bras rgyugs len yang byed kyi yod pa red/rtse mgron chas sne len las khungs kyis paṇa che na rin po che mchog nar+sā sku mgron che khag la gsol ston 'bul gshom gnang skabs mkho ba'i mgron chas dngos rigs bdag gnyer do dam dang / mkho sprod las 'gan 'khur sgrub zhu dgos kyi yod pa red/ de'i 'khur 'dzin pa gtso bo rtse gzim dpon ma/ban po dang mgron ches byed cing / de gsham rtse ma chen dang gso la 'degs pa sogs las bya ser skya khag gcig yod pa red/tshong don las khungs/'di ni bod me sprel( 1956 )lo'i lo stod gsar du btsugs gnang ba'i tshong las gtso gnyer byed pa'i mdzod sbug gi thad gtogs las khungs shig yin zhing / de'i 'go 'dzin la rim bzhi skya bo gsum dang / las bya rtse mgron gcig nang rnam gcig las tshan pa ser skya lnga/ drung rigs ser skya bdun/da dung tshong las pa dang tshong g.yog sogs khyon mi grangs lnga bcu skor yod pa dang / thog ma'i rtsa ba'i ma dngul bod dngul ṭam rdo lnga khri skor dang / 'bru ru khal bdun khri skor(khrom rgya khri brgya dang dgu bcu go drug skor)yod cing /tshong las bya thabs ni bod nas bal rnga pags rigs phyir gtong dang / rgya gar nas tshong zog sna tshogs nang 'dren byed rgyu de red/ zhib phra'i tshong las byed stangs ni/ lo ltar dpyid dus bla khongs gtso bor byas pa'i byang 'brog khag la 114

'bru rtsam dang / gro zhib/ ja/ ras cha/ bu ram sogs mkho dngos tshong 'grems dang / ston dus de dag gi sa nas bal rnga pags rigarngarga bsdu nyo byas te gro mo brgyud rgya gar la phyir gtong byas thog rgya gar narngasu bod mkhori tshong zog sna tshogs nang 'dren byed kyi yod pa red/ nang 'dren byas pa'i tshong zog gi gras su lag 'dogs chu tshod dang / smyu gu/ ther ma/ 'go snam/ gos chen/gru'u tse/ ras cha/ spun dog dkar yol/ mdzes chas/ rtsed chas/ par chas/rkang 'khor/ sbag sbag rlangs 'khor/ gser dngul/ kan tshal/ mngar cha/tha mag a rag ja/ 'bras/ yang man gro zhib sogs dang / gzhan yang nyin mkho'e 'dzad spyod dngos zog sna tshogs yod pa red/ nang 'dren byed pa'i tshong zog de dag gi khongs nas rtse'i thugs mkho 'bul 'jog zhu dgos rigs phud/ de byings mang che ba tshong khang btsugs te spyi tshogs thog tshong bsgyur byed kyi yod pa red/tshong don las khungs kyi las don dgongs bskor snyan seng dang / zal thon rtsis zhu sogs tshang ma rtse mdzod sbug la zhu dgos pa red/rtse phyag las khungs/'di ni paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos rgyal gyi sku dus gsar btsugs gnang zhing / de'i skabs rtse phyag sku/ 'khur 'dzin pa der‘‘rtse'i sde pa lags’rizer ba las chab srid go don gzhan dag yod tshod mi 'dug la gsham du las bya yang drung yig gnyis dang gnyer pa gnyis tsam larngage med 'dug cing /phyis paṇa chen sku phreng bdun pa blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi mari sku dus tsam narnga / bzung rtse phyag do dam pa rim pa bzhi pa'i mkhan chung gcig dang / rim bzhi 115

skya bo gcig las bya drung rigs ser skya 'ga' shas/ gnyer pa gnyis/ rtse phyag 'ded pa zhes 'degs gshor btang thung pa mi brgyad bcas yod pa red/las khungs de'i 'gan dbang ni paṇa chen rin po che sku sger khongs kyi zhing 'brog las kyi yong 'bab spyi dang / lhag par stod chos lung byang rtse nas ched dmigs ljags smin gsol mar dang / gam pa rdzong nas lug sha skam sos/ de bzhin khang gla/ mi bogs/ khang bogs/ lcang bogs/ rtswa rin/ gser kha'i khrul/ sha mar sogs deb gsal 'bab yong bsdu len bya rgyu dang / yong steng nas sngar lam rtse mgon khang pa'i rgyun ja dang / rtse'i khongs ri khrod kyi grwa btsun pho mo'i mchod phogs/ 'phar ma'i zhabs rim dang / 'bul slog gnang cha/ rtse gsol thab kyi dgos cha/ chibs ra khag gi gzhung spyod dgos cha dang /zhal ngo / lag do bcas mi sger gyi sngar lam dngos po'i thob cha/ pho brang yas mas nyams gso zhu dgos skabs kyi 'gro gron bcas gtong dgos/ gzhan yang dad ldan 'das gson khag gi 'bul dngos bsdu 'jug zhu khongs nas sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs rgyur 'gro ba rnams rten rgyur gtong ba dang / de byings dgon sde khag la mang bskol dod rgyur gtong ba/ gyon chas nyung shas lha mo'i 'khrub chas su gtong ba/ da dung rtse'i thugs mkho dang / rten bzhengs/ mngasnyebasgo/ la/ gnang cha sogs kyi dgos mkhor dar sna tshogs dang / ja/ ras cha/mngar cha/ shing 'bras rigs sogs gtong dgos/ gzhan yang lo ltar rdzong sgo lha ngam phun gsum khul du rtse phyag 'bru 'jug ces rtse phyag ngo las gnyer pa bcas lo res bskor gyis sa gnas su ngo bskyod dang 'brel 'bru rigs bsdu 'jug gi las 'gan 'khur dgos pa red/116

chibs dpon che mo/paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes kyi sku dus man ching gong mas pe cin du gdan zhus chibs sgyur skabs chibs ra'i 'gan 'khur byed mi zhal ngo dang / lag do las chibs che zer ba med kyang / paṇa chen sku phreng bdun pa bstan pa' nyi ma'i sku dus re zhig bod kyi srid skyong thugs 'gan bzhes gnang dang bcas rang gzhan srid phyogs kyi mdzad pa rgya cher phyin pa'i dgos mkhor gzhigag te sngar yod zhal ngo dang / lag do'i thog chibs ra mno sbug khag gi 'go 'doms chibs dpon che mo rim bzhi skya bo zhig gsar du bsko bzhag gnang zhing / de rjes paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku dus chibs dpon che mo ba'i gsham du chibs spug dpon po zhes pa'i rim pa bdun pa'i shod drung gcig nas gnyis bar gsar bzo gnang thog chibs rta drel gyi rnam grangs thad la'ang gzim drel dang / lha drel/ chibs pa 'gros ma/ chibs gseb/ chab drel/ mdo drel bcas khag drug yod pa dang / de dag so sor zhal ngo dang / lag do kha shas re bcas khyon chibs ra mdo spug la chibs che gcig dang / dpon po gnyis/ zhal ngo bco lnga skor dang / lag do sum cu skor yod pa de tsho'i las 'gan ni/ gzim drel gyis paṇa chen rin po che mchog phyogs phebs chibs bsgyur skabs sku'i nyer chas dang na bza' sogs gdan zhu dang / lha drel gyis phyogs phebs lhan bsnams stabs bde'i gzim chung gi sku gsung thugs rten dang / phyag dpe/ sku thang / mchod pa'i yo byad sogs gdan zhu/ chibs pa 'gros ma paṇa chen rin po che mchog chibs thog chibs bsgyur gang yin gyi chibs rta drag 'dems kyis gtong dgos pa phud/ da dung yongs 117

'dzin dang / sku bcar gsol gzim mchod gsum dang / ga zi ma (na spya/ / ce gsol thab pa sogs rtse'i khongs kyi sku 'khor tsho'i chibs rta drel yang ri gro /sa cha/ dang lha drel gnyis kyi khongs nas gtong dgos/ chibs gseb ni rgyu na gtan spyan gzigs lta bu yin kyang / dgung gsar tshes gcig zhogs pa rten gsol zhes chos skyong so so'i sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rta gseb kyi spu kha bdams nas rang rang gi bskang rdzas gdan drangs te bla brang bde yangs su chibs sbug dpon po dang / zhal ngo lag do bcas pas chibs khrid nang bskor lan gsum rgyag dgos/ chab drel gyis rgyun gtan rtse gsol thab kyi chab gang dgos dang /phyogs phebs skabs sa gnas kyi babs la gzhigs pas bzhes chab 'deng nges 'dren dgos/ mdo drel gyis phyogs phebs skabs rtse phyag dang bla brang shod phyag mdzod gnyis ka'i khongs kyi rta khal lam thog la btang na mi 'a grig pa'i cung 'gangs che'i rigs kyi sku chas rnams dbor 'dren zhu dgos pa bcas red/phebs byams 'go pa/paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang e/ shes sku na mtho smin skabs phebs byams 'a/ bzhugs 'thus ching gong mas bkur bzos gnang don bzhin byams pa'i sgrig gzhi gsar du btsugs pa zhig yin zhing / der gnas drug pa'i phebs byams 'go pa las tshan skya bo gnyis dang / phebs byams pa sum cu so gnyis/ byams 'degs pa bzhi bcu('di gzhis rtse'i sa spung bod dmag khongs nas chibs bsgyur dngos gzhi'i skabs so sor bcar gtong byeblo srol) bcas yod pa red/phebs byams 'go dmangs kyi las 'gan ni mgron gnyer che mo'i bkod 'doms 'og paṇa chen sku phreng na rim gyi mchog sprul gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod 118

skabs phebs bsu dang po zhu rgyu nos bzung lo ltar gzigs mo che rma'i dus jijigator skabarngashaṃ bkra shis lhun po nas kun khyab gling ngam bde chen pho brang banang rung du phar phyir 'char can chibs bskyur gyis mtshon pa'i chibs bsgyur che mo'i rigs mtha' dag la paṇa chen rin po che mchog phebs byams la gdan 'dren zhu dgos shing / chibs bsgyur gong nyin bco lnga tsam ring phebs byams 'go pa gnyis dang / phebs byams pa rnams kyis byams 'gyogs sbyong brdar byed dgos/gzhan yang gzigs mo che mo'i gtor rgyag skabs gtor rgyab me mda' 'phen mi phebs byams rnga4'i khongs nas 'gro dgos pa sogs red/phebs byams pa rnams la phebs sbyong skabs ja mar sogs kyi gnang cha zhu rgyu yod pa ma zad/ rgyun gtan so so'i las rigs kyi lag shes la bla khongs lag shes pa byings dang mi 'dra ba'i darmi gas bsal lag khrul chag yang yod pa red/gur pa/'di ni paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes gong ma chan lung gi bka' ltar pe cing du bas bsgyur skabs las tshan bcu gsum zhes pa'i nang gi gras shig red/ dbu gur ka kha gnyis kyi 'go byed gur pa zhes rim pa bdun pa'i rtse drung gnyis dang / lag g.yog bzhi/ dbu gur phub mkhan brang mchod pa mi grangs bcu skor bcas yod/ dbu gur ka pa dang kha pa gnyis spus ka dang mang nyung 'dra yang ka kha gnyis su 'byed dgos/ don ni phyogs phebs chibs bsgyu/ra che mo'e skabs phebs sgrig nyin snga rting byas te dbu gur sgron dgos kyi yod pas red/ khag re re'i khongs mjal gur che mo dang / gzim 119

chung dbu gur gyis gtsos pa'i gur che chung lnga btsu nga brgyad skor dang / da dung gzim mal gnang yul stag gzig gi patho/sa pas btums pa'i sog gur phub rgyag zhu dgos/ dbu gur de rnams la 'deng ba'i rgya rum nga nga / gtsang rum gyi sa gdan dang kha gdan/ phebs ras gtsang rum dang ras ser me tog ris so so nas bubs bcu skor bcas kyang rang 'grig yod pa red/ rgyun gtan dbu gur rnams gur khang so sor bcug ste gur pas bdag gnyer do dam zhu dgos pa red/gar pa/gar gyi sgrig 'dzugs ni/ paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa'i sku dus tsam nas byung skad/ sgrig 'dzugs der mgron gnyer che mo bas bkod 'doms byed pa'i 'og gar dpon drung gtogs gcig dang / dge rgan gnyis/ gar pa mi grangs bcu skor/ gar phrug nyi shu tsam bcas yod/ gar pa'i las 'gan zhu sgo ni paṇa chen rin po che mchog chos srid kyi mdzad sgo khag la chibs bsgyur gnang skabs dang /pho brang yas mas dang / phyogs phebs chibs bsgyur rgyas pa'i skabs bcas par gar pa rnams lhan bcar dang 'brel gar rol gyi phebs bsu phebs skyel zhu dgos pa dang / dgung gsar gyis mtshon mdzad sgo dngos gzhi'i skabs phebs sgo zhes gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang dkar spro'am sder kha phebs mtshams so sor mgron ches lag brda gtong ba dang bstun nas gar gyi sgyu rtsal 'khrub ston zhu dgos/ gzhan yang dus mchod khag so so dang / dbyar smon gos sku 'grems skabs sogs la mdo dar sur sgra'i rol mo'i mchod dbyangs 'bul dgos pa bcas red/ gar dpon la drung gtogs spyi 'gre'i phogs thob yod pa phud/ da 120

rdung gar dpon dang gar pa gar phrug tshang mar dus chen so so'i skabs sder kha sogs kyi gnang cha yod pa ma zad/ rgyun gtan phebs byams pa ltar dmigs bsal lag khru/ spru chag yang gi khe dbang yod pa red/bstan don las khungs/'di ni shing lug(1955)lor paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa mchog sku ngo mas gdan sa bkra shis lhun po dang / bla khongs grub mtha' ris med kyi pho mo'i dgon sde tshang mas rang lugs kyi phyag len nyams bzhes chos mthun mi nyams 'thus tshang yong ba dang / thos bsam slob gnyer dang bshad sgrub gong 'phel sogs lung rtogs kyi bstan pa dar rgyas yong bar skul 'ded gtong ched btsugs pa gnang ba'i gdan sa bkra shis lhun pos gtsos pa'i bla khongs dgon sde yongs kyi chos phyogs byed sgo spyi bye'i 'go 'doms las khungs shig yin pa dang / las khungs 'dir rgyun gtan gyi 'khur 'dzin byed mi sku tshab dang / do dam pa rgan gzhon/ 'gan 'khur las rogs zer ba sogs kha shas yod pa red/ bstan don las khungs kyi zhib phra'i las 'gan byed sgo rtsa 'dzin don tshan bco brgyad gtan 'bebs gnang yod pa red/ / spyi sa las khungs/'di ni bkras lhun dgon pa'i dge 'dun 'dus dmangs kyi spyi 'bab mchod rgyun ma rtsa dang / srid 'dzin do dam byed mkhan gyi las khungs shig yin/'di'i 'go 'dzin byed mi de snga ja rgyab no yon zhes rim pa drug pa'i rtse drung 121

zhig las med kyang / de rjes paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku dus shing byi (1924)'o nas bzung no yon rim rnga/ lnga pa'i rtse mgron gre/cig dang / rim pa drug pa'i rtse drung las tshan pa gcig zung sbrel gyis 'khur 'dzin thog gtong yong gzhung 'dzin bum pa sim blugs bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs gnang ba red/ no yon sbrel po'i gsham du grwa tshang gsum(shar rtse / dkyil khang / thos bsam gling)gyi khongs nas bskos pa'i spyi sa'i sde pa zhes yig rtsis shes pa'i grwa pa mi brgyad skor dang /rgan g.yog ces shugs las byed mi grwa shar go thang drug mdo gnyer pa zhes gad pa mi gcig bcas yod/spyi sa las khungs kyi gtso bo'i 'gan dbang ni/ dad sbyin khag nas thebs rtsar 'bul 'jog byas pa'i 'bru dngul rnams skyed gtong dang / 'das gson gyi 'bul dngos le 'gyur byas te de dag gi 'bab thog nas 'dus tshogs la bsnyen bkur zhu rgyu dang / sngar lam rtse shod phyag mdzod so so nas ja mar tshwa bul 'bru rigs sogs kyi dgos cha zhus te dus mchod so so'i dgos gron gtong rgyu/ 'dus tshogs la mang 'gyed sogs bsnyen bkur zhu mir sne len dang / bsnyen bkur gyi 'gro lugs khag bsgrub rgyu sogs dang / srid 'dzin thad dgon nang grwa pa'i gyod don thag gcod dang / grwa par las ka bskul bkod/ sgrig lam gcun 'doms/ gzhan yang dge bskos la gzhogs 'degs byas nas chos khrims gnon 'doms bya rgyu sogs red/gtong 'dzin las khungs/de ni bkra shis lhun po'i tshogs chen dge bskos grwa tshang gsum gyi mi tshan res bskor gyis bsko 'dzugs byed dgos pa dang / des las 'gan lo gcig 122

'khur dgos pa'i ring chos khrithes gnon sdom byed rgyu phud pa'i da dung las gnas rjes 'brel gyis 'char can mchod rgyun gtong sgo mi nyung ba zhig gtong dgos zin yod kyang / phyis nyo thang rim 'phar gyis dge bskos 'khel yul mi tshan dang dge bskos byed mkhan mi sger bcas par gtong yong 'go mi thug pa'i 'phar gron dka' ngal che bar brten gnad don de thag gcod byed ched sa byi (1948)lor bla brang srid gzhung rang nas gtong 'dzin las khungs zer ba ched mngags gsar btsugs byas te dge bskos kyi sngar 'a ma dpal 'byor gtong yong gi 'gan yongs rdzogs las khungs des 'khur rgyu gtan 'khribs byas pa red/bsdu yong gi gras su/ spyi sger nas sbyor 'bul byung ba'i mchod thebs ma rtsa 'bru dngul bun gtong byas pa'i skyed 'bab dang / sngar lam gzhis rtse khrom ra'i tshong khrul/ ston dus bsod stoms zhal 'debs rtsa 'bru sogs yod pa dang / gtong sgo'i gras su/ 'dus tshogs dge 'dun yongs la tshogs spos dang / dgag chen dgag chung zhes pa'i snum bsregs kha— zas/ gung ja bu ram zhes pa'i bu ram bsgar ma sogs gtong dgos pa red/gtong 'dzin las khungs kyi gtso 'gan 'khur mi rim pa bzhi pa'i rtse drung rma khan chung gcig dang / rim pa drug pa'i rtse drung las tshan pa gcigagashamadu zhib phra'i las don byed mi 'gan babs las ka'i shes bya 'jon thang cung che ba'i grwa pa mi drug de 'ong/ las don mi sna bcu skor bcas yod pa red/thebs sbyar las khungs/dad ldan 'byor phyug khag gis nya stong brgyad gsum(bod tshes brgyad dang bco lnga sum cu bcas la zer)dang bod zla dang po cho 'phrul zla ba'i dus chen/123

bod zla bzhi pa sa ga zla ba'i dus chen/ de bzhin rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa dang paṇa chen sku phreng na rim gyi dus mchod bcas so sor bsnyen bkur zhu rgyu'i thebs rtsar phul ba'i ma rtsa dngul 'bor khyon che yod pa de dag bkras lhan dgon gyi spyi so las khangasakyis skyed gtong dang 'brel bsnyen bkar zha rgya zir ring ring ripa dpe nus pas lcog min la brten shing bya (1945) lor thebs sbyar las khungasazur du btsugs shing de'i 'gan 'khur ba rim pa bzhi pa'i mkhan chung gcig dang /rim pa lnga pa'i mgron gnyer gcig las bya rim pa drug pa'i las tshan ser skya gnyis dang / rim pa bdun pa'i rtse shod drung dkyus lnga/ sku gnyer dang gad pa mi grangs gsum/ 'ded pa mi drug bcas yod/ las 'gan ni/ ma dngul rnams tshong rigs kyis gtsos ser skya su rung la lo 'khor brgyad skyed(ngo bo ṭam rdo rer skyed srang brgyad re yin pa)bun gtong byas pa'i skyed dngul thog nas dus mchod so sor bsnyen bkur chad med zhu dgos pa de yin zhing / 'gan 'khur do dam pa rnams las gnas 'pho 'gyur skabs ma dngul rnams gsar par rtsis sprod khams dwangs byed pa las yal yol rab rib byas mi chog pa'i gtan 'be+ebs rtsa 'dzin gyi lag rtsa kha gsal yod pa red/ —dkon gnyer che mo/dkon gnyer che mo rim pa drug pa'i rtse drung las tshan pa gcig yod pa dang / 'di'i las 'gan bkra shis lhun po'i tshogs chen 'du /tha nga steng gtsug lag khang gi lha khang che chung sum cu skor gyi dkon gnyer tshor thad ka'i 'go khrid dang bkod 'doms byed dgos pa ma zad/ mi rkun nyen zon byed sgo'i 'gan yang lci po yod la/ dkor za'i yong 'bab kyang che tsam yod pa red/ phyis nyen 124

'gan chung khyad dkon che gzhon pa rim pa bdun pa'i rtse drung zhig 'phar bsko gnang yod/ par dpon/ /'di ni paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes kyi sku dus su byung zhing /par snadapon rim pa drug pa'i rtse drung las tshan pa gcig dang / gsham du par pa dang par g.yog mi grangs nyi shu skor yod/ de'i gtso bo'i las 'gan ni/ bkra shis lhun po'i par khang che mo dang / snar thang par khang che mo'i nang bzhugs su gsol ba'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dang / bstan 'gyur gyis gtsos pa'i chos dpe'i par zhing yongs rdzogs kyi do dam dang par 'debs 'gan 'khur rgyu de red/ nyer brgyad sku mchod do dam pa/ 'di ni paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i dus mchod bsnyen bku/ra 5ba mkhan zhig yin pa dang / shing bya(1945) 'or gsar du btsugs pa zhig red/ der do dam pa rim pa lnga pa'i lde 'chang pa gcig dang / rim pa drug pa'i las tshanaser mo ba gcig gsham du 'degs gshor dang brang mchod pa bcas mi lnga yod/ de'i las 'gan ni dus mchod kyi bsnyen bkur zhu dmigs kyi ma rtsar dad sbyin khag nas phul ba'i sa zhing deng / 'bru dngul rnams bogs ma skyed gtong thog lo re'i yong 'bab steng nas lo ltar bod zla 10tshes 'i8 dus mchod nyin bkras lhun dge 'dun 'dus tshogs 'a 'bru 'gyed dang dngul 'gyed sogs — — 1lha6

'bul dgos pa de red/rtse 'grems pa/rtse 'grems rnga/ drung gtogs mi gcig yod pa de'i las 'gan ni/ mgron gnyer che mo ngo las kyi thad ka'i bkod 'doms 'og dgung gsar gyis gtsos pa'i mdzad sgo khag gi dkar spro sder kha dang / paṇa chen rin po che mchog la mjal phyag zhu mi bla sprul dang / ser skya dpon rigs sogs phyi nang mi sna che 'bring chung gsum la sder kha sgrig gtong bya dgos rigs mtha' dag 'brel yod las khungs nas dgos cha zhus te shing sder ram ko sder nang go babs la gzhigs pa'i dgu sder dang / bdun sder/ lnga sder/ gsum sder/ rkyang sder bcas rim pa dbye ste sgrig gshoms byed dgos pa de red/ bla brang phyag mdzod kyi shod gzim 'gag la'ang shod 'grems pa zer ba zhig yod pa de'i las 'gan yang gong dang mtshungs/ 'grems pa zer ba'i don ni/ sder kha gtong khungs so sor gtan 'bebs gzhir bzung gi thob skal bkye 'grems byed mkhan gyi don yin/ rtse shod 'grems pa gnyis la las 'gan rjes 'brel gyi dgos mkho'i rtsis 'khri phra lcog dang / lteb lcog sogs lcog rtse che chung nyi shu skor re dang /shing sder dang ko sder lnga brgya skor re yod pa red/gdan gnyer/gdan gnyer zhes pa drung gtogs mi gsum dang / gdan g.yog mi lnga yod pa de tsho'i las 'gan ni/ mgron che ngo las kyi bkod 'doms 'og 12ne

gzigs mo che mo dang / smon lam chen mo/ dgung gsar sogs 'char 'phar gyi mdzad sgo'i skabs gdan tho gzhir bzung bla brang gi zhabs 'bring yongs rdzogs thog phyi phyogs kyi sku mgron tsho'i go gnas mtho dman la gzhigs pa'i gdan lcag tshang ma go babs ma 'chol ba sgron rgyag zhu dgos pa dang / mdzad sgo grol rjes bsdu gsog bdag nyar byed dgos pa red/ khong tshor gos sbol dang /gos kha gos rkyong / stag rkyong / gzig kyong / snam skyong / lcog rtse'i rigs sogs rtsis 'khri khyon che yod pa red/ shod skor las khyangs gras/brad 'dzin nang sgang u yon lhan khang /nang sgang u yon lhan khang ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing rta (1954)lor rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis chog mchan bsko bzhag gnang ba brgyud sngar yod sa smad bzhugs sgar paṇa chen nang ma sgang gi rmang gzhi'i thog bskyar sgrig gnang nas btsugs spro zhig red/ las khungs 'di ni paṇa chen rin po che mchog gi dbu khrid 'og de snga'i phyag mdzod skyabs dbyings dza sag bla ma'i 'gan dbang spyod pa'i bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i srid 'dzin spyi khyab mtho shos de yin/de'i gtso bo'i 'go khrid pa sku ngo'i gdan thob yod pa'i rim pa gnyis/ pa'i dza sag bkras mthong 'jigs med grags pa(ci'i 'jigs med kyang zer)dang / lha smon ye shes/ tshul khrims gnyis nas kru'u rin rgan pa gnang ba'i khyon kru'u rin rgan gzhon dang u yon bsdoms mi grangs bcu bdun las grub pa zhig red/'on kyang khongs mi gzhan rnams dmigs bsal don gal che ba'i gros mol tshogs ram̐27

zhugs gnang 'os yod na skabs bstun gnang ba las/ de min nang sgang gi rgyun gtan las don che phra tshang ma'i gtso skyong thag gcod kru'u rin dza sag gnyis rang nas gnang ba ma gtogs kru'u rin gzhon pa dang u yon rnams rgyun phebs gnang dgos kyi med(khong rnams tshang ma las 'gan gcig spyogs gnang mkhan sha stag yin)/ kru'u rin dza sag gnyis ka phyogs phebs sogs kyis bzhugs min skabs kru'u rin gzhon pa gang rung zhig rgyun phebs kyis las don gtso skyong gnang gi yod pa red/ nang sgang u yon lhan khang gi 'gan dbang ni/ ser skya zhabs 'bring gsar bsko dang / gnas spar ram gnas dbyung / las khungs khag dang rdzong gzhis khag gi mi 'gro bsko 'then sogs kyi 'os 'char paṇa chen rin po che mchog la 'thus min snyan zhur phul te phyag rtags zhu rgyu/ rtse skor las khungasakhag gcig phud pa'i de min srid gzhung gi las khungs dang tshan pa che 'bring chung gsum dang / rdzong gzhis tshang mar spyi 'doms 'go khrid gnang rgyu dang / spyi dang bye brag gi las don che phra sna tshogs zhib 'jug gtan 'khel dang bka' 'bebs bkod gtong gnang rgyu(dmigs bsal gal che'i rigs paṇa chen rin bo che mchog la snyan seng chog mchan zhu dgos)/ phyi nang las khungs tshan pa khag dang /rdzong gzhis khag nas yig thog gam ngo bcar gyis las don snyan seng dang dgongs bskor zhu 'byor rigs thag gcod gnang rgyu/ mnga' zhabs mi ser dang / ser skya mi sger nas don gnad sna tshogs kyi bde sdug snyan zhu phul 'byor rigs thag gcod gnang rgyu/ gyod don sna tshogs kyi zhib pa gtan 'khel dang / zhib pa nas phul ba'i thag gcod bya thabs kyi 'char snyan la zhib 'jug chog mchan 'god rgyu sogs yin cing / phyi phyogs su rgyal srid spyi khyab khang dang / spyung gung bod las don ā yon lhan khang la skubs bsgrun snyan seng /3

ldagolnges bskelnge snye 'os rigs zhu chorgyu dalnge / gzhis rtse yan lag las don u yon lhan khangarī dang 'brel yod las don gang ci gros bsdur mnyam las gnang rgyu/bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang 'brel gtugs gros mol gnang— rgyu sogs kyi las 'gan 'khur skyong gnang gi yod pa red/de min da dung paṇa chen rin po che mchog phyogs phebs chibs bsgyur skabs kru'u rin dza sag gnyis nas gang rung gcig mgron drung las bya nyung bsdus dang bcas lhan bcar nang sgang zhes chibs zhabs su bcar phebs gnang dgos pa red/ 7 nang sgang yig tshang /'di ni nang sgang u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes pa dang bstun nas sngar yod lhan bcar nang sgang yig tshang gi rmang gzhi'i thog rgya skyed dang cha tshang du btang ba zhig red/ las khangs 'di'i sgrig gzhi ni rtse drang rim pa lnga pa'i mgron ning ri sa gnyer gnyis dang / rim pa drug pa'i drung yig las tshan ser skya gnyis dang /rgya drung gcig yig 'bri rim pa bdun pa'i zhabs sdod ser skya gsum dang /gnyer pa rtse drung zhabs sdod gcig bcas las grub pa zhig yin pa dang / da dung gsham du ma chen dang yig skyel dzi mi grangs bcu skor yod/ mgron gnyer gnyis kyi las 'gan ni/ yig tshang khyon yongs kyi srid 'dzin las ka'i do dam bya rgyu dang / nang sgang u yon lhan khang la spyi sger gyi snyan zhu 'bul mi dang snyan seng zhu mi gang yod gong zhu bya rgyu dang / phyir phebs kyi bka' bsgyur rgyu sogs yin/ drung yig gnyis kyi las 'gan kru'u ren dza sag rnam gnyis kyi bka' don ltar nang sgang gi mtshan thog nas spel rgyu'i bka' rgya dang / 'go mchan/ lag 1ཿ

khyer/ brda tho sogs gzhung me+eka /shā tso/ cha/ zin pyi r+sha/ bkod de 'grig min spyan zhu bstar rgyu dang dam zhu bya rgyu/ nang sgang gi nyin re'i tham deb 'bo/da rgyu so gas yin/ yig 'bri gsum gyi las 'gan ni/ drung yig gi bkod sgrig 'og gzhung yig khag gtsang bshu bya rgyu mtshon pa'i yig 'bri'i las 'gan bsgrub rgyu de yin/rgya drung gi las 'gan ni/ rgya bod mnyam sbrel gyi 'du tshogs che gras khag gi thog dza sag gnyis nas gnang rgyu'i gsung bshad zin bris ba zo rgyu dang / nang sgang nas rim pa khag gi tang srid dmag gi las khungs la 'bul dgos pa'i yi ges mtshon pa'i rgya yig spyod dgos pa'i rigs mtha' dag gi yig 'bri'i las 'gan bsgrub rgyu dang / gzhan yang yan lag las don u yon lhan khang dang nang sgang dbar rgyun gtan gyi 'breka gtugs byed sgo'i las 'gan 'khur dgos pa sogs red/ gnyer pa'i las 'gan mgron gnyer gnyis kyi bkod 'doms 'og phyag mdzod khag nas zhu len byas pa'i bza' bca'i ri gas kyi dngos rdzas rnams gnyer tshang du bsdu 'jug bdag nyar thog rgyun gtong gi ja thag dang / 'phar ma'i gsol tshigs stabs bde'i rigs sgrig gtong byed dgos kyi yod pa red/bla brang phyag mdzod/'di ni paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos rgyal sku dus gsar btsugs gnang ba dang / phyag mdzod dang po lhun gling rje drung blo bzang chos grags yen zhing / skabs de'i phyag mdzod /la chab srid /kyi go ming gdan thob 'di zhes bya ba med la gsham du las bya yang ser mo ba mi grangs lnga drug tsam las yod chi da mi 'dug kyang / de rjes re ca/ bzhin rgya cher phyin te shod gzim 'asag dang / shod gsol thab/ las bya lde 'cha nga pa dang / gzim chung 'gag 130

pa sogs phyag mdzod sgrig gzhi cha tshang chags pa dang / paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa'i sku dus phyag mdzod las thog bcu pa lha ri sgang rje drung blo bzang tshe dbang la ching gong ma chan lung gis dar han gyi cho lo gnang ba nas bzung / phyag mdzod rim byung la cho lo dang 'brel ba'i rim pa gnyis pa sku ngo'i gdan thob lkedang / skyabs dbyings dza sag bla ma'i go ming yod cing / phyag mdzod las khungs tshugs yul ni bla brang gi thog brtsegs gsum pa'i khang pa ka bzhi ma zhig yod pa dang / de'i nang skyabs dbyings bzhugs gdan gos 'bokhashaṃ gsum brtsegs khri cog bla bre rgyab yol dang bcas pa yod/bla brang phyag mdzod thog ma byung ba nas bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing rta(1964) lo nang sgang u yon lhan khang dbu ma brnyes bar bla brang phyag mdzod ni paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng rim byon gyi dbu khrid 'og gi rgyal mtshan ca/thon po'i chos srid dpal 'byor tshang ma'i spyi khyab srid 'dzin las khungs mtho shosarda yin zhing / der brten paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang /phyag mdzod skyabs dbyings rnam gnyis lhan du bsdus par skyabs mgon rtse shod ces zhu srol yod pa red/ phyag mdzod dang po lhun gling rje drung blo bzang chos grags nas phyag mdzod mjug ma rong dpal lhun thub bstan bsam 'phel ('ditsho sa gnas srid gzhung nas mngags gtong byas pa'i skyabs dbyings tar khang zer ba de yin) bar phyag mdzod las thog nyi shu rtsa dgu byung ba dang / de dag gi srid 'dzin 'gan bzhes gnang yun khyon bsdoms lo sum brgya lhag tsam song yod pa red/nang sgang u yon lhan khang gis de snga'i bla brang phyag mdzod kyi spyi khyab srid 'dzin gyi 'gan dbang tshab skyong gnang rjes bla brang phyag mdzod kyi las khungs sgrigre gzhi mi sna'i khongs nas mgron gnyer dang gzim 'gag gnyis shod 131

gzim chung 'gag tu rgyun sdod ma dgos pa tsam las gzhan dag sngar mus ltar las 'gyur ldog cher byung med kyang / phyag mdzod ngo ma'i go gnas dang 'gan dbang la 'gyur ba byung ba red/ 'gyur ldog byung rjes kyi bla brang phyag mdzod kyi sgrig gzhi dang 'gan dbang ni gtso 'gan 'khur mi rim pa gsum pa'i rtse drung tā bla ma gcig las bya rim pa lnga pa'i lde 'chang pa mi grangs gsum nas bzhi bar dang / gzim chung 'gag pa zhes rim pa bdun pa'i rtse drung zhabs sdod pa bcu skor/ shod gsol dpon dang shod ma chen rtse drung gnyis/ 'phral si dang gad pa zhes pa'i btang thung las byed mi khag gcig bcas yod pa dang / gong du gsal ba ltar bla brang phyag mdzod ni de snga paṇa chen rin po che mchog gi dbu khrid 'og gi rgyal mtshan mthon po'i chos srid dpal 'byor tshang ma'i srid 'dzin spyi khyab las khungs mtho shos yin pa nas phyis rtse dang nang sgang gnyis ka'i dbu khrid 'og dpal 'byor do dam gyi 'gan dbang rkyang pa tsam spyod pa'i las khungs su gyur cing / des dpal 'byor do dam byed sgo'i 'gan dbang gtso bo ni 'ja' sa she bam dang gser dngul dar gos sogs rtsa che'i dngos rdzas 'jug yul rnam sras bang mdzod zer bas mtshon pa'i bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i phyag rdzas rgyu nor rtsa 'gangs che shos rnams 'jog sa'i mdzod khang khang mig bzhi yod pa de dag gi 'jug 'don bdag gnyer do dam bya rgyu dang /ris med dad sbyin khag nas paṇa chen rin po che mchog lacomajal phyag chos zhu'i 'bul dngos(rtse phyag dang mdzod sbug so sor 'bab pa'i 'bul dngos phud)rnams bsdu 'jug zhu rgyu/ gzhan yang mnga' khongs bod 'brog rdzong gzhis khag nas lo ltar bla brang phyag mdzod la sngar lam deb gsal sha mar/ bal rtsid/ tshwa bul/ pags rigs/ snam rigs/ sbra snam dkar nag yul zog thon rdzas dang / lag shes batho las kyi thon rdzas sna tshogs sogs k+ṣamirna rigs yong 'bab 132 tre—

'bor che bsdu len bya rgyu/ phyi phyogs nas lo 'khor dgos mkho'i dar gos dang / ras ṇa/ ja/ mngar cha'i rigs/ shing 'bras skam gsos rigs/gser dngul zangs lcags rigs/ shing cha sogs mkho dngos sna tshogs ldeng nges nyo sgrub bya rgyu bcas dang / 'char 'phar gyi 'bab steng nas deb gsal mchod rgyun gtong sgo sna tshogs dang / rtse shod gsol thab khag gi rgyun gtong dgos cha/ lo ltar dgung gsar gyis mtshon pa'i 'char 'phar dus chen mjod sgo khag gi dgos gron/ phyi mgron khag la sne len zur gsos bcas gtong dgos pa ma zad/ gtsug lag khang dang / lha khang / pho brang yas mas bcas kyi nyams gso gsar skrun zhu dgos rigs dang / sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs zhu dgos kyis mtshon pa'i bzo skrun las gra sna tshogs gnyer rgyu'i do dam dang de dag gi dgos gron mkho 'don bya rgyu/ gzhan yang rtse dang nang sgang so so'i bka' dgongs 'phar ma'i dngul dngos dgos gron gtong dgos rigs mtha' dag dus thog mkho 'don zhu dgos pa sogs red/thod gsol thab/ 'di ni phyag mdzod las bya shod gsol dpon dang shod ma che'i bkod 'ango/mas 'og phyag mdzod skyabs dbyings ngo las kyi gsol tshigs dang / gsol ja batho 'bul zhu rgyu'i 'gan 'khri sgrub mkhan sde tshan zhig yin zhing / des sngar khungs 'brel yod las khungs nas dgos cha zhus te phyag mdzod ngo las kyi nyin re'i gsol tshigs dang gsol ja bzo gtong zhu dgos pa ma zad/ nyin ltar drung ja'i gong shod 'gag tu bar ja zer ba zhig gtong dgos pa red/ zhib phra'i 3gan khur byed mi shod ma che dang / shod gsol dpon rim pa bdun pa'i 133

rtse drung gnyis dang / de 'og bar thab pa dang / thab g.yog chab bsu ba/chu ma shing len bcas mi grangs bco lnga skor yod/bla zang yig tshang/'di ni paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes kyi sku dus gsar btsugs gnang zhing / de'i skabs drung yig chen mo ser mo ba gcig dang /drung yig chen mo gzhon pa gcig gsham du yig tshang pa zhes yig ribri drung 'khor skya ser bdun tsam las yod tshod mi 'dug phyis drung yig chen mo rtse drung tā bla ma(rim pa gsum pa)gcig dang / rim pa bzhi pa'i mkhan chung gcig drung che sku gzhon rim pa lnga pa che ba'i ser mo ba gcig yig tshang dge rgan rim pa drug pa'i las tshan pa ser skya gnyis/ yig tshang las bya drung rigs ser skya bco lnga skor/ da dung zhabs sdod zhu dmigs yig rtsis sbyong brdar byed rmi las mgron zer ba'i slob phrug lnga drug tsam/ yig tshang sku gnyer zhes khang gnyer rgan gzhon gnyis/ brda skyel brang mchod pa mi gcig bcas yong pa red/ las khungs de'i gtso bo'i 'gan dbang ni/ paṇa chen rin po che mchog gi mtshan thog nas phyi nang drag zhan mi sna khag la stsal rgyu'i sbug dam chab shog dang / sa khang bdag thob skor gyi gtan tshigs 'ja' sa she bam/bla ma mkhan pori nges rgya thugs dam sogs 'bri rgyu dang / de bzhin bla brang shod phyag mdzod kyi mtshan thog nas spel rgyu'i 'char 'phar bka' rgya dang /lag 'khyer/ bka' 'dzin sogs kyi 'char zin 'god rgyu nas dam zhu bya rgyu'i bar gyi la sa 'gan dang / gzhan yang zhabs 'bring go gnas bsko 'then dang /rdzong gzhis sne sdod mi 'gro'i 'os 'char bzo rgyu dang / rdzong gzhis khag dang /134

pho brang yas mas/ gtsug lag khang sogs kyi sprod bsher sku tshab bsko gtong /rdzong gzhis khag gi gtong yong rtsis rgyag zhib bsher/ tshags yig bdag gnyer do darme/ bya rgyu sogs rtse shod gnyis ka'i yig don gyi bya ba che phra yongs rdzogs kyi 'gan dbang yod pa red/ gnyer tshang las khungs/'di ni paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa'i sku dus su btsugs pa'i las khungs rnying gras shig red/ las khungs der de snga sku zhabs gnyer tshang sku bgres zer ba'i ser mo ba mi gcig dang / zhib cha'i las ka byed mkhan gnyer tshang sku gzhon zhes pa ser mo ba gcig 'bo kha ba kha shas bcas las med 'dug kyang /rjes su gnyer che rim bzhi ser skya gnyis dang / de'i gsham rim pa drug pa'i gnyer tshang sku gzhon rtse drung gcig las bya rim pa drug pa dang bdun pa'i rtse drung dang / shod drung kha shas/ gnyer drung nang bzan bdun brgyad tsam/ 'bo kha ba('degs gshor byed mkhan)drug 'phral si zhes btang thung gar dgos las byed pa mi grangs bcu gsum tsam/ gnyer tshang bogs 'ded pa zhes grwa shar mi grangs bcu gnyis bcas yod/ las khungs de'i 'gan dbang gtso bo ni/ bla khongacha rjo nga gzhis gzhung sger chos gsum nas gro/ 'bru/ sran ma/ snum/ rtsam pa/ gro zhib/ sha sogs deb gsal khrul rigs khyon che bsdu len bya rgyu dang /de'i thog nas gdan sa bkra shis lhun po'i dgi 'dun gyi zla re'i 'bru phogs(zla re ra dge 'dun rer 'bru phogs gshor khal gsum re yin pa rgya mar phab na khrom rgya 5 tsam re)dus thog 'grems sprod dang / dus mchod khag gi lha mi'i mchod phogs 'gan len byed dgos pa de yin zhing / gzhan yang drung rigs ser 135

skya'i phogs 'bra dang / chibs ra mdo sbug gi rta drel gsos chag phyi nang cugi mgron po che phrar zur gsos gtong rgyu sogs kyi las 'gan yod pa red/ riṣi cho chibs ra las khungs/ rdzi 'di ni paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa'i sku dus gsar btsugs mdzad cing /rta ra do dam pa zhes chibs ra las khungs kyi gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur ba rim pa bzhi pa'i mkhan chung gcig(de gong rtse mgron zhes rim pa lnga pa'i rtse mgron gcig gam/ gnyis kyi 'gan 'khur pa yang byung 'dug)dang / las bya drung rigs ser skya gcig gnyis gsham du gnyer pa gnyis/ nang bzan zhes drung yig dang 'degs 'gyogs pa bcas khyon las byed mi grangs bcu skor yod/ las khungs des gzhis ka rtse'i nye 'dabs bla khongs gzhis khag dang / mi ser nas gzan pa skya sngo dang / 'bud shing lci ba/ shag pa/ skyi 'tsher bcas 'bab deb nang gsal lo ltar dus thog so sor bsdus te rtse shod gsol thab khag gi rgyun gtan 'bud shing dang / 'char 'phar zhabs brtan gyi mar bzhu'i 'bud shing / bkras lhun dgon pa'i tshogs chen dang / sngags pa/ rtse mgon khang pa sogs kyi tshogs shing dang / chibs ra mdo sbug gi gzan rtswa sogs gtong rgyu/ gzhan yang pho brang yas mas dang / gtsug lag khang / gzhung khang khag gi sa dkar dang / wa kha thigs tshags/ skyi shīng sbangs rgyag(chibs ra khag gi lo 'khor rta sbangs rnams 'bud shing bzo rgyu'i lci phag rgyag rgyu dang / 'tsher sa khag nas skyi 'tsher brnga 'dren byed rgyu bcas la zer)bcas kyi 'ul mi bskul 'gugs bya rgyu/ kun gling na tshal stod smad dang / zhabs lcang / dung mtsho na kha/ phyug gzhung bcas kyi na ra rtswa thang khag ji snyetshi stesto

rme sde ṅgem thog dbyar ston gzhung phyogs kyi rta drel rtswa gsor gtong yul byid pa dang / da dung sger phyug khag gi rta drel rtswa gsor btang rigs nas rtswa rin bsdu rgyu sogs kyi 'gan dbang yod pa red/ lhan bcar phyag mdzod/ 4'di ni chu 'brug(1952)lo paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa sku 'khor mtsho sngon nas bod ljongs su chibs zhabs bsgyur skabs bzhugs sgar dang lhan du yod pa'i phyag mdzod las khungs yin pa dang / paṇa chen rin po che mchog bkras lhun gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod rjes kyang sgrig gzhi de rang 'jags bzhag pa dang / nang sgang u yon lhan khang gi thad gtogs phyag mdzod las khungs 'phar ma zhig red/ de'i 'go 'dzin mkhan che gcig dang / mkhan chung gcig las bya drung rigs ser skya bdun tsam dang / gsham 'og drung 'dra kan pu'u zer ba sogs kyi spyir btang las don mi sna mi grangs nyi shu skor bcas yod pa red/ las khungs 'di'i ngo las rnams kyang byes 'byor zhabs 'bring sha stag las/ gzhis yod zhabs 'bring gcig kyang yod pa ma red/ lhan bcar phyag mdzod kyi gtso bo'i las 'gan ni/ sa smad nas mnyam 'khyer byas pa'i bla brang gzhung sga dngos rdzas che phra dang / go lag me mdel bcas bdag gnyer do dam bya rgyu dang /— zhabs 'bring ser skya dang / lto gzan las byed/ rtse 'phrul 'khor slob grwa bcas pa'i zla re'i dngul phogs sprod rgyu/ nang sgang u yon lhan khang yig tshang dang bcas pa'i rgyun gtong tha mag dang / a rag tshal rigs/ kha zas la sogs pa'i sne len dgos cha sna tshogs dang / snag shog la sogs pa'i galhang lasu la mkho ba'i spyod chas sna tshogs/ nang sgang gi 'phar ma'i la

gsol ston khag gi dgos cha mang che ba bcas gtong dartso/sa pa/ spi lo 1955lo nas bzung bla brang gi zhabs 'bring ser skya dang / las byed mi sna tshang mar go gnas mtho dma'i rim par gzhigs te krung dbyang nas zla reri dngul phogs(tā yang )gnang gi yod pa ltar/ zla durnga so sor krung gung gzhis rtse yan lag las don u yon lhan khang gi 'brel yod sde tshan nas dngul 'bab thob 'bor zhu rgyu'i rtsis khru 'don rgyu dang mjug rtsis bya rgyu/ gzhan yang nang sgang u yon lhan khang nas skabal 'phral gyi las 'gan gang gnang ba dus thog so sor sgrub dgos pa bcas yin pa dang / bla brang gi rdzong gzhis che gras khag gcig phyis gzhung 'dzin byas pa'i sngar lam 'char can gyi gzhung 'bab rtsis zhu dgos/ pa phud/ 'phar ma'i zal thon yong 'bab khongs nas khag gcig lhan bcar phyag mdzod la 'bab kyi yod pa red /'bab zhib las khungs/las khungs 'di ni de snga bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dmag phogs kyi dmigs sgor bkras lhun bla brang gi khongs gtogs gzhung sger chos gsum gzhis khag gi lag 'debs sa zhing rnams la rdog bskor sa zhib dang 'brel sngar med gsar spros kyi zhib 'phar 'bab 'bru zer ba'i 'khri khrul khyon che btsan 'gel byas par brten/ rang khongs gzhis khag nas zhib 'phar 'bab 'bru bsdu len gyis sa gnas srid gzhung la 'jal sgrub byed ched du lo rabs nyi shu pa'i nang btsugs pa zhig yin zhing / paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa bod du zhabs 'khod rjes gzhung bla'i bar gyi gros chod ltar sa gnas srid gzhung la zhib 'phar 'bab 'bru 'jal dgos kyi med kyang / bla brang rang khungs su bzu len byed rgyur /38

'bab zhib las khungs phyir bsdu ma byas par rang 'jags bzhag pa dang / de'i 'go 'dzin rtse drung rim pa lnga pa'i mgron gnyer gcig dang / rim pa drug pa'i las tshan pa skya bo gcig gsham du las bya kha shas bcas yod pa red/rkang rtsis sgang ngam 'tsho zhib las khungs/'di ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa dang / paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa rnaca/ gnyis rgyu mtshan sna tshogs kyis rkyen pas re zhig thugs snang mi mthun pa'i tshul bstan rjes chu phag(1923) lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas ‘‘chu phag bka' rtsa’’zer ba spel te bla khongs mi ser la sngar lam la mi gnas pa'i rta khal lam thog gi khrul 'phar btsan 'gel byas par brten bla khongs mi ser gyi sa zhing rkang 'don 'bor grangs la gzhigs pa'i lo lo'i lam thog 'khri khrul ji thob gcig gyur gyis rtsis rgyag byed por gsar du btsugs pa zhig yin zhing / bod zhi ba'i bcings bkrol thob rjes bla khongs mi ser gyi lam thog 'khri cha sngar lam chu glang rgya bod dpyad mtshams gzhir bzung bya rgyur gzhung bla gros chod byung bas de snga'i rkang rtsis sgang gi las 'gan bsgrub bya rang bzhin med par gyur stabs chu 'brug(1952)lo rkang rtsis sgang de‘‘'tsho zhib las khungasari’zer bar ming bsgyur byas pa dang / 'tsho zhib las khungs kyi gtso bo'i las 'gan ni/ rang byung gnod 'tshe 'phog khul la khrul chag skyob gso byed rgyus mtshon pa'i mi ser gyi 'tsho tshis la sman thabs zhib 'jug 'char 'bul zhu dgos pa de 'in zhing / las khungs 'di'i ngo las mi grangs dang / go gnas rim pa ca/tha' gcig tu nges gtan med kyang / spyir btang rim pa bdun pa nas lnga pa'i bar gyi ser skya ngo las mi grangs bzhi lnga tsam re yod pa red/139

zhib khang las khungs/ 'di ni chu sbrul(1953)lor gsar du btsugs shing / de'i las 'gan ni bla khongs mi seng nas nang sgang u yon lhan khang la gyod don snyan zhu sbul 'byor rigs so sor zhu len zhib dpyad byas pa brgyud thag gcod bka' bcad kyi 'char gzhi bzo 'bul zhu dgos pa dang / bka' bcad 'char gzhir 'thus mchan byung rjes de don khungs so sor khyab bsgrags dang / khrims 'degs nyes dngul bsdu len byed dgos pa bcas yin/ do dam pa rim bzhi skya bo gnyis dang / las bya kha shas bcas yod pa rid/ chad rtsis las khungs/'di ni rdzong gzhis bkar yong khag gi gtong yong rtsis khru bla brang yig tshang du phul te chad lhag zhib bsher dang 'brel gzhung 'bab gtsang sel zhu dgos de ltar yang / sne mo ba 'ga' zhig gis las rgyun ring gi gzhung 'bab rjes su sgrub rgyur chad 'jog byas pa mi nyung ba zhig yod pa de dag gi rtsis khru dang chad gan la zhib bsher dang 'brel chad 'don 'ded bskul byed por lcags stag(1960)lo gsar du btsugs shing / do dam pa mkhan rim gnyis dang las bya 'ga' zhig bcas yod pa red/dmag pogs do dam pa/'di ni dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i nang gor ṣas snga rjes su bod la 140

btsan 'dzul byas rjes rgyal mtshams brtan srung ched ching gong ma chan lung gis chogatshomachan gnang ba bzhin/ chu glang(1793) lor dbus gtsang rgya sbyong bod dmag sum stong gsar btsugs skabs dmag phogs kyi kha gsab ma dngul khongs nas bla khongs grong drag la cha gses gtan 'jags skyed 'grems byas pa'i lo lo'i skyed dngul bsdu len gyis gzhung phogs khang la rtsis zhu byed por bskos pa zhig red/ dmag phogs do dam pa zhabs 'bring skya bo gcig gam gnyis sna tshogs bsko srol yod pa red/ klu lding 'go pa/ (klu lding dpon po'ang zer)'di ni paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa'i sku dus btsugs gnang mdzad pa zhig yin pa dang / der 'go 'dzin rim pa drug pa'i las tshan skya bo gcig dang /gsham du bang chen lag g.yog ces btang thung rgyugs mkhan mi grangs lnga tsam yod/ klu lding 'go pa'i 'gan dbang ni/ gzhis rtse grong khul du sdod pa'i gser bzo dang / dngul bzo/ zangs batho/ shing batho/ dkrug pa/ lcags bzo/ lugs pa/ tshag pa/ rdo bzo ba bcas bla khongs sto zan lag shes bzo las rnams la sgrig 'dzugs dang / 'go 'doms byas te sku brnyan bzo bzhengs gtso bor gyur pa'i bla brang rtse shod las khungs khag gi 'char 'phar dgos mkho dngos rigs sna tshogs batho skrun dang / lag rtsal pa gso skyong sogs byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ lag shes bzo las pa 'di rigs la sto zan zhes zer don ni de tshor rgyun gtan bla brang gzhung thog nas gla sto'i mthun rkyen lta bu'i dngos po'i thob thang phran bu re zhu len byed rgyu yod tshod 'dug pa ma zad/lag bzo'i khrod kyi lag rtsal phul byung rnams la dbu che dang / dbu chung zhes 1‘1

pa'i go gnas bsko gzhag gnang gi yod pa red/ klu lding 'go pa zhes zer don ni/ de sngon lag shes bzo las sgrig 'dzugs de'i las gra chugs yul gyi las khang ni bkras lhun dgon pa'i nye 'dabs nub ngos klu lding zer ba'i sa cha der yod pa'i rkyen gyis yin zhing / phyis las khang klu lding gsar pa zhes gzhis rtse'i sto ngos bkra shis dgi tshal du gling kha kho ra khor yug dang bcas pa kher gtsang gsar rgyag par yod pa red/zhol rgan po/zhol rgan po ni de snga drung gtogs mi gcig bsko srol yang / phyis las ka'i khyab khongs rgya cher phyin stabs rim pa drug pa man gyi dpon rigs skya bo gcig dang / bskor bya ba mi bzhi bcas yod cing / zhol rgan po'i las 'gan ni nyes can pa btson 'jug khrims gcod bya rgyu dang / grong nang spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags dang gtsang sbrar bskor g.yeng brda sbyor/ rta khal skul gtong /gzhung phyogs kyi dpon rigs dang dmag dpung 'grul bzhud byed mi'i sdod 'tsher bkod sgrig bya rgyu/ gzhung bla'i mi ser 'khrug rtsod byung na gzhis rtse rdzong dang mnyam sbrel gyis thag gcod bya rgyu sogs yin/ zhol rgan po'i khongs kyi btson srung sogs las ka dman pa rnams sprel rtsed pa(lha sa'i rags rgyab pa dang ma chu ngas)zhes pa'i mi khyim khag gcig yod pa de tshor bskul bkod byed kyi yod pa dang / zhol rgan po'i gzhung las khang dang btson khang chabs sbrags‘‘dril bu tshing tshing’’dang / ‘‘lhun grub khang gsar’rizer ba'i khang pa khag gnyis gzhis rtse zhol khul du yod pa red/142

rtse spob grwa/de snga paṇa chen sku phreng brgyad pa bstan pa'i dbang phyug sku dus tsam la slob phri de 'dra zhig btsugs gnang yod skad kyang bar skabs shig nas rgyun chad cing / phyis kyi rtse slob grwa ni paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i sku dus bla brang yig tshang las khungs kyi thad ka'i 'go khrid bkod 'doms 'og lo rabs lnga bcu pa'i nang btsugs pa zhig yin zhing / slob grwa des zhabs 'bring ser skya'i bu phrug dang dge phrug gis mtshon pa'i dgon pa dang / spyi tshogs thog gi lo chung slob zhugs byed 'dun zhu mkhan su yin yang bsdu len byed kyi yod pa red/slob grwa'i 'go khrid dang bod yig dge rgan gcig lcogs rim pa drug pa'i rtse drung gcig dang / rim pa bdun pa'i shod drung gcig dge rgan gsum bzhi tsam/ slob grwa ba mi grangs brgyad cu skor bcas yod/ slob grwa des gtso bo bod yig rdel rtsis/ snyan sum/ lachi/ wartu/ hor yig bcas rig gnas slob khrid byed kyi yod pa dang / skabs 'gar rtse'i bka' dgongs ltar 'brel yod mi snas bod kyi lo rgyus dang legs bshad kyi shes bya yang slob khrid gnang gi yod pa red/sku srung dmag sgar/'di ni paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa sku 'khor sa smad nas thog mar bod phyogs chibs bskyur skabs mtsho sngon du rgyal khab nas ched mngags sku srung la sgrig 'jugs gnang ba'i lhan bcar dmag sgar zhig yin/ dmag sgar de'i thog 1/ 3

ma'i dmag dekyus sdung ma mtsho sngon gyi mi sha stag yin pa dang / bod du 'byor rjes dmag dkyus mtsho sngon pa mang che ba rim bzhin las bsgyur byas pa dang /'ga' zhig pha yul du phyir log byas pa bcas kyi tshab dmag mi gsar pa bla khongs rdzong gzhis mi ser gyi nang nas bsdus pa red/ dmag sgar de'i sgrig gzhi ying gcig(ru shog gcig)yin pa dang / ming la‘‘paṇa chen sku srung ying’ zhes zer gyi yod/ dmag sgar der sa gnas tang ud dang / nang sgang zung sbrel gyis 'go khrid byed kyi yod pa dang / pha'e(lding dpon)rim pa yan gyi las byed rnams sa gnas tang ud dang / nang sgang phyogs gnyis ka nas bsko gtong byas yod/dmag sgar de'i sgrig 'dzugs lam srol dang dmag rtags chas gos sogs tshang ma mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dang gcig mtshungs red/ rim pa lnga pa'i nang rnam ying krang rgan par zha'o dpon 'bring ba dang / ying krang gzhon par zha'o dpon chung ba'i go gnas dpung rtags yod/ 'go dmag gi phogs thob dang go lag dmag chas/ dmag sgar gyi gron dngul bcas tshang ma rgyal khab nas gcig gyur gyis gnang gi yod pa dang / dmag sgar des paṇa chen rin po che phyogs phebs skabs sogs kyi sku srung zhu sgo spyi dang / bye brag dbyar dus kun skyob gling ngam/ bde chen pho brang gar bzhugs pho brang gi sgo grung dang / dza sag gnyis kyi bzhugs gnas sger khang gi sgo srung bcas kyi las 'gan 'khur gyi yod/ dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas rjes nas spyi lo 1964lo'i bar du de snga nang sgang gis bsko gtong byas pa'i sku srung dmag sgar 'go byed rnams rim bzhin tshang ma phyir 'then las bsgyur byas pa dang / dmag sgar de sa gnas bca' sdod dmag dpung gi khongs su gtogs par byas te de'i ming yang‘‘tu'u lis ying’ri(rang tshugs ying)zer bar bsgyur ba dang / de rjes su tu'u lis ying de yang dmag sgar gzhan dag gi khongs su zla sgril btang ba red/1 4

nang lgang kha par sbyi 'khor(rdzungacis)/skyid na pho brang ser po'i nang sgrig 'jog byas pa'i nang sgang gi kha par spyi 'khor la las don mi sna ser skya mi gsum yod pa dang / de dag sdod bya res bskor gyis paṇa chen rin po che'i bzhugs gnas pho brang dang / nang sgang gis gtsos pa'i rtse shod kyi las khungs khag gcig gzhis rtse yan lag las don u yon lhan khang gi kha par spyi 'khor bcas par kha par 'brel mthud kyi 'gan 'khur byed dgos pa red/ shang spyo/shang khul bla khongs gzhis khag mi nyung ba zhig yod khar/ gzhung bla sa gsum 'dres sdod rtsod rnyogs kyang cung che bar brten bla khongs gzhis khag la gcig gyur gyi bkod 'doms dang / 'go 'don 'tsho skyong byed bde'i ched me sprel(1956) lor shang nang gzhis khag spyi 'doms rim pa drug pa'i las tshan pa skya bo zhig gsar bsko byas pa red/ des don gnad che rigs gong zhu dgongs bskor byed dgos pa phud/ de min gyod don dang khrul don sogs kyi don gnad chung rigs rnams sa gnas sa thog tu thag gcod byed dgos pa red/yong rtsad pa/'di ni rdzong sgo khag nas khrul 'bab bsdu mkhan gyi las sne'i ming yin 14bya

zhing / mi 'gro ni bla brang zhabs 'bring ser skya'i /bongadzishaṃ nas me/ re skabs gangaji'akhel gyis bsko gtong byed jipre las dmi gas ngas sotshogatan 'a/wetā3—med/ des/ lo ltar ston mjug rdzong sgo so sor ngo bskyod kyi sngar lam yong sdudatshopa'i deb gsal khrul rigs sha dang / mar/ dngul/ gzan rtswa sogs sdud steng nas 'char can lha mi'i mchod phogs gtong sgo rnams btang 'phros lhag bsdad rnams yong sdud pa mi 'gro sger la 'bab kyi yod pa red/ da dung rdzong sgo de'i lo re'i gtong yong khag gcig yong sdud par rtsis zhu byas te zhib 'jug zhus dag dang 'brer mchan bkod byed dgos pa red/rngabaminazab thre5 tshab/'di ni rdzong gzhis khag gi lo re'i 'bru rigs yong 'bab steng nas 'char 'phar lha mi'i mchod phogs kyi dgos 'bru phud 'phros bsdad 'bru lhag khongs nas gtan 'bebs grangs tshad gzhiru bzung lo ltar bkar khang('bru'i mdzod khang)so so'i nang bkar rdzong gtso drag(bkar rgya ba dang rdzong sdod/ mi ser gtso drag)thun mong ngam/ bkar gzhis(bkar rgya ba dang / gzhis sdod)thun mong gis bkar 'bru 'pher nges sa rdo bzha' phub kyi bsres lhad med pa bcug thog grangs 'bor he bag med pa bkar rgya ba so so'i lag deb tu 'god rgyu dang /da dung sa gnas 'ga' sha/sa la ba7kar 'bru'i khongs nas lo 'khor bun 'bru skam skyed(lo 'khor ru'i khal brgya la ru'i khal bcu)du btang ba'i ma skyed rnams slar yang bkar 'jug byed rgyu'i las 'gan yo/ da pa red/ mi 'gro bsko gtong thad gong gsal yong sdud pa dang 'dra/146

tsho gser dpon/stod dang byang ༷/ la bla khongs gser kha khag la 'o/ re 'byor phyug khagadang zhing 'brog mi ser gser 'don par 'gro mkhan yod rigs tshang ma nas mgo zho zhes mi re nas gser phye zho gang re'i khrul bsda byeng po der gser ༄dpon zer/ des dpyid ka gser 'don par 'gro mkhan tsho nas gan rgya blangs te stom dus gser kha nas tshur 'khor mtshams gan gsal ca/go zho'i gser khrul bsdu len byas te rtse shod phyag mdzod so sor gzhung 'bul zhu dgos pa red/gser dpon la phogs thob lo re 'bru ru'i khal nyis brgya skor yod pa'i thogagaser dpon rang gis gser par(gser 'don pa)ja dang 'bru rigs sogs tshong zog bskur nas sger gser bsgrub pa'i khe 'bab kyang yod/ gser dpon mi/ 'gro sa babs 'brel mtshungs kyi bla khongs mi tshang 'os drag su rung gcig la bsko srol yod pa red/ 147

sa khyal phyi phyogs su yod pa'i las khungs gras/lha sa nang lgang /'di ni me sprel (1956) lor bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes nas las khungs so so'i rim pa khag gi las byed mi sna gzhung bla khams gsum dang / bod las don u yon lhan khang bcas phyogs bzhi nas mi grangs cha gses kyis bsko gtong gnang ba bzhin bla brang nas grwa lhan gyi las don nang zhugs mi dza sag lha smon ye shes tshul khrims kyis gtsos pa'i zhabs 'bring ser skya lnga bcu skor lha sar rgyun bzhugs gnang dgos par brten byes bzhugs nang sgang yig tshang dang bcas pa gsar du btsugs shing / lha sa nang sgang gi gtso 'gan dza sag lha smon gyis gnang thog gal che'i tshogs gros gnang rgyu sogs mnyem sdeb 'go khrid gras ka'i khongs su tā bla ma gcig dang / tha'i ji gcig rim bzhi gsum/ bla sprul gcig bcas yod pa red/ lha sa nang sgang gi gtso bo'i las 'gan ni/ gra lhan gyi las don nang zhugs mkhan rang khongs mi sna rnams la tang gi 'go khrid 'og 'gan bab las don khag legs 'grub yong ba dang / rgya bod gzhung bla khams gsum dang bcas pa'i mthun sgril yag po yong ba byas te bla brang gi mtshan la shas gzhi mi 'byung ba'i bskul 'ded slob gcun bya rgyu dang / bod las don u yon lhan khang la 'brel gtugs zhus te gzhis byes kyi las don gnas tshul gang ci'i skor dgongs bskor dang / re 'dun bsam 'char brje res sogs zhu rgyu dang / bka' shag la gzhung bla'i 148

dbar gyi gnad don gang ci'i gros mol dang mthun la ma 'brer ba zhu rgyu/ rtse spyi 'domyo/sa las khungs la yig thog nas las don snyan seng zhu rgyu dang / gzhi sa yod nang sgang u yon lhan khang dang rgyun du rga/nas tshul dang / snyo bsam 'char spel res bya rgyu so gas red/lha sa nang sgang yig tshang la gtso 'gan 'khur mi rim pa lnga pa'i mgron gnyer gcig dang / drung yig gcig yig 'bri las bya zhabs sdod pa gsum/gnyer pa gcig ma chen dang / yig skyel sogs mi bdun bcas yod pa dang /des nang sgang 'go khrid kyi bka' bkod 'og lha sa nang sgang gi bka' yig dang /'phrin yig snyan zhu/ brda tho/ tshogs 'du'i zin tho sogs yi ge bzo 'bri'i 'gan yongs rdzogs dang / gsham gyi snyan zhu len 'bul dang / bka' bsgyur rgyu bcas kyi las 'gan 'khur sgrub zhu dgos pa red/ lha sa mi khang 'argo pa/'a di ni snga dus tsam nas yod pa zhig yin zhing / mi khang 'go pa ri ma pa drug pa'i las tshan pa skya bo gcig dang / las rogs rtse drung gcig gsham du rgan po rgan gzhon gnyis dang / da dung khang gnyer dang bcu dpon zer ba mi kha shas bcas yod pa red/ de'i gtso bo'i las 'gan ni/ lha sa grong khyer du yod pa'i bla brang gi mi rtsa pho mo dang / gzhung khang la do dam bya rgyu de yi na zhing / bla wo/ ngas rmi rtsa dang phyogs gzhan dag dbar gyod gzhi thon na snang shaka mi dpon dang mnyam du gyod don thag gcod bya rgyu dang / bla khongarngage kyi khri0 /sa 'degs bsdu lem/ bya rgyu(snang shag tu mi khang 'go pa'i gdan gnas shig kyang (shāgresku/ su yod shed)/ gzhung khang khongs nas mkho gal yod rigs 'ga' bheb1 phud/149

de byingane+e/ mang che ba /bang glar bta/ri lnge )/gla ngangul bsdu len bya rgyu// de rmi na da dung lha 'byor bla brang ge don / ced mi sna ra sdod /bang dang / chu len thab g.yog gi 'ul mi bkod sgrig dang / las zla/ṭā cho ri masprun regyur gzhogs 'degs bya rgyu/lha sa'i nye 'dabs su sku 'bum thang zer ba'i bla brang gi gzhis ka zhig yod pa de'i sa zhing 'debs skyong thog 'bab steng nas 'o/ ltar lha sa'i smon lam chen mo'i skabs stong mchod re dang / mang ja lag rgyag dge 'dun rer 'gyed dngul ṭam gcig re bcas 'bul gtong byed dgos pa sogs red/ gzhan yang sngar lam bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mdzad sgo che gras 'ga' zhig dang / bod ljongs spyi tshozla/sa zer ba'i tshogs 'du rgyas pa tshogs skabs bcas par mi khang 'go pa zhugs dgos kyi yod pa red/pe cin dang / zi ling / this a/na bcas kyi so sor bca' sdod don gcod khru'u/snga sor go min tang gis srid dbang 'dzin skabs nan cin du bca' sdod paṇa chen don gcod khang zhig btsugs myong yod pa dang / krung hā mi dmangasaspyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes rjes pe cin dang / zi ling / shis an bcas so sor don gcod khang(rgya skad pan hre khru'u zer)re re btsugs shing /don gcod khang re rer 'go 'dzin(khru'u krang)rgan gzhon gnyis re dang / las bya mi lnga drug re yod pa red/ don gtsod khang de gsum gyi gtso bo'i las 'gan ni/ bla brang gi sku tshab byas nas sa khul de dag gi tang srid 'brel yod las khungs dang 'brel gtugs bya rgyu dang / las rigs khag gi chab spi da byed sgo sna tshogs la zhugs rgyu/ bod nas btang ba'i tshogs 'du dang / blta 150

bskor/ slob sbyong sogs byed mi 'byor rigs la sa babs kyi mthun 'gyur rogs ram bya rgyu/ rtse dang / nang sgang / phyag mdzod las ku/ ngas khag sogs na sa bka' mngags gnang ba'i thugs ma/bo'i dngos zog nyo sgrub bya rgyu sogs red/ phag ri'i mi ser 'go pa/'di ni phag ri khul du yod pa'i bla khongs mi ser rnams la 'go 'dzin do dam bya rgyu dang / bla brang la 'bab pa'i 'gag sgo'i tshong khrul bsdu len byed mkhan byug yin/ mi 'gro zhabs sdod skya bo zhig bsko gtong byed kyi yod pa red/ yan steng tshwa tho/'di ni bod stod khul nas bal yul la 'gro ba'i tshwa dang / lug gi 'gag sgo'i tshong khrul bsdu len byed mkhan zhig yin/ mi 'gro zhabs sdod skya bo zhig bsko gtong byed kyi yod pa red/ snye 1

'brel yod gnas tshul gzhan dag1 rtse byi 'doms las khungs gsar btsugs gnang skor/rtse spyi 'doms las khungs ni paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa sku ngo mas bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i me bya (1957) lor gsar btsugs gnang ba zhig yin pa ma zad/ 'di ni bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i rtse shod chos srid 'phrin las kyi las khungs che phra yongs kyi spyi 'domang/ khang yin pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang ba dang / paṇa chen rin po che mchog sku ngo mas gtso 'dzin gyi thugs 'gan bzhes nga//nang thog yongs 'dzin dngul chu sprul sku dang / dza sag bkras mthong 'a'igs med grags pa/ jo sag lha smon ye shes tshul khrims/ rgyal yab gung sngu/ra mjo/na tshe brtan bcas gtso 'dzin gzhon pa dang / de min tā bla ma dang /tha ri ji/ mkhan sde che chung / rim bzhi bcas mtho rim ser skya dpon rigs khag gcig khongs mir bsko gzhag sa/nang ba dang / byed sgo'i sgrig srol rtsa k+ṣ-ibaiji na zhig kyang gtan 'bebs gnang yo/da pa red/ las khungs 'di nyid paṇa rtson rin po che mchon gis bla brang nang khongs kyi las / sdungs khag 'a mkhyen rtogs dang / do dam/ bka' bkod bcas mdzad bde'i ched gsar btsugs gnang ba zhig yin pa las/ phyi nang rgya khyab tu yongs bsgrags gnang ste btsugs pa zhig min la las khungs rgyun tshogs kyang gnang dgos kyi med par gza' 'khor rer nang sgang u yon lhan khang dang / byes/ bzhugs lha sa nang sgang / bla brang phyag mdzod sogs gnad che'i las khungs so sos rtse spyi 'doms las khungs si las don snya/na seng thengs re zhu dgos/(lha sa nang sgang gis yig thog nas snyan seng 'bul gyi yod pa) kyi yod pa red/ ji 16ཿ rdzo
