'i gzhung bla'i dbar lo rgyus bog lus bsdad pa'i don gnad thag gcod byung skor/ rdzo snga sor lo rgyus thog rgyal ba yab sras sku phreng rim byon rnams dgung na bgres gzhon la gzhigs te phan tshun bla slob tu bkur res dang thugs bzhed gcig gyur dam gtsang lhad med thog gzhung bla gnyis kyang so so'i skyong khongasakyi bdag dbang spyod pa las/ phan tshun btsan gnod sogs mthun sgril phyogs/ 'ga' gyur gzhi'i gnad don tshabs che gang yang lhags myong med kyang / dur+sā rabs nyi shu pa'i 'go tsam nas bzung phyi nang lo rgyus kyi rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyis rkyen pas rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa dang / paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa rnam gnyis thugs snang mi mthun pa byung thog bod sa gnas sri da gzhung nas bkras lhun bla brang dpon dmangs thog sngar med gsar spros kyi dmag phogs dang /zhib 'phar 'bab 'bru/ rta khal lam thog bcas kyi khrul 'phar sna tshogs 'gel dkri rnga sdogs btsan gnon rim par byas stabs gzhung bla'i dbar gyi 'gal ba je sdug tu gyur nas mthar paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa bod du bzhugs/ bzod ma bde bar chu phag (1923) lo ste/sa rgyal nang sar gsang phebs gnang dgornga byung ba dang / de rjes paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku'i tsha bo yab gzhis nor khang gung phun tshogs g.yul rgyal gyis gtsos pa'i bla zhabs re zung 'dzin bzung btson 'jug gis rta lcag btang ba dang / lhan bcar byes ba skyod rme zhabs dang mi sna rnams kyi mkhar dngos gzhung bzhes/ bla brang rdzong gzhir+sā tsā/ ga gcig gzhung zhabs kyi thabs rten 'gro yul du bskyur pa/ gzhung bskos phyag mdzod dza sag bla ma ngo las tham ga dang sbrags mngags gtong gis bkras lhun bla brang gi sri da 1 tshesnyi3

dbang yongs rdzogs 'phrog pa sogs 'bu ches chung zornga/ kyi spratsan gnod ji snyed phog pa ma zad/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu paṃ rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma bod du phyer phebs gnang rgyur yang bkag 3 tho/ ga ju ma par byas stab ṭ+wāṃge rngo da phebs kyi thugs bzhed ma 'grub par mi / glang(1937) lor mtsho sngon zhing chen skye rgu mdo'i klung shod dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling du dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa red/ gzhung bla'i dbar gyi 'gal ba'i don gnad ther ba ni de ltar byas nas chags shing 'phel rgyas phyin pa zhig yin 'dugalcags yos(1961) lor krung go gung khrun tang gi 'go khrid 'og bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa dang / chu 'brug(1952) lor pa/'o chen sku phreng bcu pa sku 'khor bzhugs sgar zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa bod ljongs su zhabs sor 'khod thog yar lam lha sar gzhung bla gnyis dbar lo rgyus thog lus bsdad pa'i gnad don skor phyogs so so'i sku tshab bskos te thog ma'i gros mol byas pa dang / shing rta(1964) lor rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis skabs dang po'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs che na thengs dang por phebs skabs rgyal sa pe cin du bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun nang 'khod pa'i dgongs don dang / phan tshun mthun sgril dang / phan tshun brtsi 'jog phan tshun bsam shes bcas byed dgos pa'i krung dbyang dbu khrid kyi bka' slob dgongs don la gzhigs te sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku tshab bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / dza sag sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa can/ bla brang gi sku tshab dza sag bkras mthong 'jigs med grags pa(cis 'jigs med)dang rim bzhi ldan lhun tshe ring dpal 'byor can bcas kyis gzhung bla'i dbar gyi gnad don skor zhib phra'i gros mol gnang ste gzhung bla gnyis dbar gyi don gnad gang ci rgyal ba yab sras rnam 154

gnyis thugs mthun po'i skabs te rab byung bco lnga pa'i mi bya (1897) the ba dang po phan gyi 'am srol la rngakanas pa bya rgyu/ de tshun du byung ba'i /sa/hwa ri du/rī ge rnams med pa bzo rgyur gnyis mos gros /3cham byung thog rtsa don der gzhegs te zhibatshophra'i gros chod don tshan bco lnga bzhag yod pa dang / gros chod de rgyapa srid spyi khyab khang gi rgyas 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs bdun pa'i thog snyan seng zhu rgyur phul nas chog mchan gnang ba red/ de nas bzung gzhung bla gnyis dbar lo rgyus thog nas lus bsdad pa'i gnad don rnams gzhi rtsa'i thog thag gtsang chod byung ba dang / de skabal rmang gzhi gsar pa'i thog mthun sgril byed rgyu mngon du 'gyur thub pa byung ba red/ ri rdzong gzhis khag gcig gzhung 'dzin byas skor/de snga bla brang gi rdzong gzhis che chung tshang ma'i sne sdod mi 'gro zhabs 'bring ser skya'i khongs nas su 'os la dus bkag bsko gzhag gis 'dzin rgyun ring gi gtong yong khe gyong mi 'gro sger so sos rang 'khur byed kyi yod kyang /(195 ྾) lo nas bzung gcig nas gzhung 'bab che ba dang / gnyis nas mi ser thog za gyod brdab mnar chung khyad rdzong gzhis che gras khag gcig la sne mo ba ngo las cha tshang re bsko gtong dang 'brel ba/tong yong khe gyong gang byung gzhung rtsis bum pa sib blugs zhu rgyu'i gtan 'be+ebs byas pa red/ gzhung 'dzin byas pa'i rdzong gzhis ni rdzong sgo lha rtse dang / ngam ring / phun tshogs gling bcas gsum dang / gzhis ka bzhad mthong smon dang / rta nag rin chen rtse/gam pa/ gcen lung / lhan lhun rab/ rgyal rtse brag phug 'ad ma bla ma bcas yin/165

4 nang lgang las byed smyong brdar 'dzin grwa btsugs skor/nang sgang las byed sbyong brdar 'jin t+pā ni/ krung gung gakyis/ rtse byubyun lag las do na u yon lhani khang dang / nang gi nga rwa/ yo na lhan —/bang gnyirngage mnya6 sha sbre—zi/ gyis gnyer ba zhig yin pa dang / slob grwa'i se tho/ 'dzin dang / dge sku/na/rgyab phyogs las don mi sna bcas phyogs nga/nyis nas ma— ngapa /sa gto/ra byed cing /slob grwa'i gron dngul rgyal khab nas gtong ba dang / khang pa dang ma/ro dngos 'ag 'a zhi ga bla brang nas mkho 'don byed kyi yod pa red/ sla ba tshan ni rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims dang / gros d+dha thun don tshan bcu bdun/ tang gi mi rigs sri da jus/ rgyal spyi rgya'ashaṃ nang gi dus bab gnas tshul sogs chab srid shes byari slopa tshan /krid rgyu gtso bo yin pa dang / chabs cig bod yig sum rtags dang /'phro da za sten rgyun shes/ glu gzhas so gas rig gnas slob tshan ya nga khrid kyi 'o /nga khu/ red/ slo ba grwa ba'i yong khu ngas ni bla brang zhabs 'bring ser skya'i nang gi 'o/ na gzhon gras dang / rdzong gzhis mi ser grong drag gi bu phru.a/ de ṣ+ṭa na sbyi/ tshogs/ thog nas re 'dun zhu mab/ na gzhon nu pho mo bcas bsdu 'jug kye/ skedzhakyi yod/ slob dus rer slob phrug mi grangs bzhi bcu lnga bcu skor re yod pa dang /slo/ba dusatshore'i dus tshod dang theb / bla gsum re yin ba dang / de rjes zla dru shā / re yin zhing / slo ba kwa sdo /na rjer+sā bod rgya skyu/'o pa nga gnyis kyi ming khroko da pa ri slopaṃ thon rag /ster re sprod kyi yo da/ 'ji na lngathe/ de shrī4 / ma 1954 ro rngotsung—/sa rwa nas 197 lha lo bar khyon slo pre du sa the nga sa paṃzhe lnga zhig rngananyer pa red/156

'i bla brang phyag mdzod rim cung si/ srid 'dzin lo chig sa/༈ga marjod dang po lhun gling byirje drung blo bzang chos gragasalo/'irab byung batram̐ gcag pa' sa stag nas lcags (638da 660)bar nya shu rtsa ཿ ///snas// rjobacu //( ma ri /blo/ the //blo/ /bye/ (smos gnyas pa na pa rja ༵nga bzang da gas/ lcags nas chu sa (1660——— 663)bar gaṭ+wāṃm/ yogasum pa dung lha ba lophun gas rab brtan/ chu sa nas sa lug (1663/sgo 6༵9)bar bcudrupy-i tsho'i b.ru pa sa mdzad bstan 'an rgya ༵ / ṅgi lug nas rab byung bcu gnyas pa' chu bya(gli67༷da ṭ+wāṃ93)b.ragobashā ba / merī lnga pa lhun nga rja hāngaske bzang ma na / chu bya nas spral (693da wa176༷b.rarī nyashurtsakāsum/ rdosgo me skedrug pa rgyal chan rtsa lodaka' bcu bzang rja/ bya nas shang sbrul (77—— wa172tram̐)bar ṅgirgyad/ blo rubadun pa lda 'chang ga gnasalo pa bzang dbang rgyal/ shang sbrul nas lcags phaka(725da gli7༷)baṭ+wāṃ drug rī byibargyad pa lhun nga ༵ drung bzang dag 'dun/ chu nas rnga rta (173tshiwadage73༵)baX drug ru dzodagu pa mapan gnyar sa lung zlo('ad phyag mad las tshab)sa ḍa nas lcags bya(73ṭ+wāṃd wa74pebararigasum/ blo tshebacu pa ba rgyal lha ra sgang rja drung dar han bzang dbang /57

lcags bya nas rab byang bcu gakum pa'i me khyi(1741da 1766)bar lo nyi ༄(1/ga//// rī ru rīrī —ri de//4blo brnyi gcag pa sdir bkra shas rtsabyi rja drung sprul sku ar rum thu lo 'im han bzang na pa/ ma phag nas chu (1767da 1792)bar nya shu rtsa //1dzi/ thornga ri rjo rig pha cho //rdo ////༵cu gnyas pa dpal sdang sharalo dza sag bla ma mad rgan mkhan / chu nas chu (1792da 18༷2)dir bcu/ poblokhyi bcu rīga~Xm pa khang chan rja drung dar hakā mkhan bzang dar rgyas/chu nas ma mus(1802da —1༷07)bar lnga/phri cho phebacu zlozha rda dzo~Xng dpal ༵ drung sprul sku 'a na las sa 'a la rab byuX bcu ba pa' ma sa nas sa sa(1807da 1819)bar lo bcu ཿsa///snas// //blo ma ri ma ri/che/ /)//ba lnga pa sa khud ༵ drung dag gas rgyal mtshan/ sa sa nas sa glang bar(819—1829) bcu/ sa ruru bcu druX pa rta nag la rnyi ba bstan 'dzan bkra /snadabyings sa dkyal rta ba yangazarasaglang/༷ sa ༵829da 1838)baḍi dgu/rībacu bduṭ+wāṃ pa graX cha rja drung bzang rab brtan(༵ drung na ma chung yang zar)tre/ sa nasashangasbrukā(183ṭ+wāṃrā 184༷)zlor bdun/ chorī ༷0 sgargyad pa sku bcasnyer nga pa ru pan kye/ 7 na han rnam rgyal sa 'pha' lo nga / dgra 'dul nga zad )/ shang sbru si nas sa rta(1845—1858)bar bcu gsum/ ru cobacu dgu pa sman ra lob la bzang na ma rgyal/ sa rta nas shang glang (ṭ+wāṃ8 8da 1865)bar bdun/

nyi shu pa gzim mkhan gu ge ba dka' chen blo bzang bsam gtan (khang chen pa yang zer)/ shing glang nas rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa yos(1865da wa1878) bar lo bcu gsum/nyer gcig pa khron sbug pa rnam rgyal shes rab/ sa yos nas lcags sbrul (1878da wa1881) bar lo gsum/nyer gnyis pa sman ri ba su'u le no mi han blo bzang don grub/ lcags sbrul nas lcags stag(1881da wa1890) bar lo dgu/nyer gsum pa gsol che khang chen pa dbang phyug tshul khrims lo ྾྾nyer bzhi pa skyabs dbyings dpon brang(ko ko lhag pa yang zer)lo ྾྾nyer lnga pa grub dbang sprul sku blo bzang brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ lo ྾monyer drug pa sprul sku dpal ldan seng ge me 'brug nas chu phag (1916da wa1923) bar lo bdun/nyer bdun pa dza sag bla ma 'bras khang san sbi lig thu blo bzang bstan 'dzin dro'adi bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bsko gtong byas pa) / shing glang nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yos(1925da wa1927)bar lo gnyis/nyer brgyad pa ja rtasag bla ma 'brug rgyal a mor ling go'i blo bzang rin chen('a di0 pod sa gnar+sā m+bid gzhung gis bsko gtong byas rngapre)/ sa 'brug nas lca gas stag(— 928da wa1 350) bar lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis/nyer dgu pa dza sag bla ma rong dpal lhun san ci rom thu thub bstan bsam 'phel('de bod sa gnas sred gzhung gis bsko gtong byas pa)/ ci/gas sta ga nas chu 'bru ga(1950da wa1952)bar lo gnyis bcas rnams so/ / ribye /rji rdo rjon 'a phi na nang rga nga u yon lha na /sprong gi khorngari sa 2 //kru'u rin rwa/krastuki maṅge nga 'aṭī ga'i/ me da gra nga/r+sā pa dang / lha/ smo na ye du/r+sā 159

tshul khrims/ kru'u rin gzhon pa ngag dbang sbyin pa dang / nor brang blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ bkras mthong 'jigs med g.yul rgyal/ bde rab rdo rje g.yul rgyal/ thub bstan nyi ma/ u yon dam chos yar 'phel dang / chos khang blo bzang chos 'byor/ rdo gdan blo bzang sbyin pa/ tshe ring don grub/ nyos dpal don/ blo bzang 'phrin las/ don khang bsod nams stobs rgyal/ ldan lhun tshe ring dpal 'byor/ bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ wang don grub bcas so /yo nang sgang u yon lhan khang gi las tham rtsis 'bul zhus pa'i sko ra/spyi lo 1959 lor bod kyi mtho rim log spyod ru tshogs kyis bslang pa'i drag po'i ngo log zing 'khrug de krung go gung khrun tang gi 'go khrid 'og zhod 'jags su btang ba dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa brgyud bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran 'a/ma 'u gas masho/ rting slog ste zhing bran khri tsho brgya yar langs bcings 'grol thob par brten/ bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i lca gas glang lo ste spyi lo 1961 lo'i zla 9 tsher+sā 19 nyin lha sar bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan ba/ nga gi rgyun ud rgya che'i tshogs 'du thengs bzhi bcu zhe gcig pa'i thog de snga'i paṇa chen nang sgang u yon lhan khang gi las tham rtsis 'bul zhus te de'i lo rgyus kyi las 'adzhakan mjug sgril ba'i khya/ ba bsgrags byas pa red/nang sgang gi las tham a ma ni li maru brkos pa'i〈bla brang rgya' mtshan mthon po'i srid 'dzin nang sgang u yon lhan khang gi tham ga〉zhes bod rgya yi ge gnyis ldan gru bzhi chemyo/ po ga cig dang / rgyun spyod tham ga tsan dan dmar por brkos pa'i (〈patre chen na nga sgang u khyo/na lhan khang〉zhernga/ kru bzhi chung ba gci ga yod pa reji—/ 160

nge lhar de snga'i bla brang rgyal mtsharmo/ d+dha/bīn po ri sri da 'tshi rtsa/ sgri ga ga'i'i skor gyi d+ku/nas ce 'a 'a ma tsam 'ang4da kyu de tsam yin zhing / 'dikhi nang a/ra spyi las khungs sogs rgyun 'ju gre/sa yi na pa'i gnas skabs kyi 'gan sgrub /swā/sa khu/ ngas rnams 'dir bkod med cing / de bzhin bar thab dang / gro shod ḍā / dpon/snye mo mi ser 'go pa zer ba la sogs pa'i tshan pa dang mi sna rtsag rtsig 'ga' zhig khya/ nga dpyad gzhi ma 'dzoms pas 'dir bkod med pa bcas lags so/ /

bye/ ṣ+ṭha lde/'i sa skya'i sgri/ga gzhi/lcamyo/ grwa d+mo/ra bzang dang / kun dga' chos/ bzang bcas /de yang / darnga4'i/ ldan sa skya pa'i de snga 'i chos srid kyi sprig gzhi ni/ 'khon gyi gdung las mched pa'i 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos thog mar bro bo lung du dgon chung zhig btab pa(sa skya bas dpal chen po brang zer srol dang / lo rgyus yib/ rigs thog sa skya gog po yang pre ra)der lo lag3 bzhugs shing / de'i ri rtse nas gzigs pas dpon po ri'i ngos su sa dkar po snum pa/ chu g.yas su 'bab pa so gas —shetse/ mtshan ldan pa der dayo/na pa zhig btab na bstan 'gror pan pa che bar dgongs te jo bo gdong 'bag ma khashaṃ zhus thog sa'i bdag po zhang zhung gu ra ba sogs la rta skro/da ma da7/ ra mo gci'ika dang / mo gos gciganor bu'i phre nga ba gcig khrub gcig bcas rin du gnang nas mon grog mar bcad/ 'bal grog yar bcad kyi bar(mo na grog/ dang 'barkame grog zer ba sa skya'i dgon pa shar nub kyi grog rong gnyis kyi ming) gyi sa cha rnamarnga bla mar dbang ba byas pa der rab byung dang po'i chu glang (1073) lo 'a/lon dkon mchog rgyal pos dpal ldan sa skya dbo/na palhaphyag ḍasdotab rjes rim bzhin dar rgyas chen po byung /skabs de'i bod sbyo ṭārngas ni mnga' bdag glang dar ma 'u dum btsan gyi rjes su bod chos rgyal tre/—rnga ma'i srid dbang rim bzhin 'thor nas yul gru rer rgyal phran nam dpon 'go res bcad bzung byas te sil bur gyur nas mi lo chen po bzhi 162

brgyar nye ba'i ring la dpon 'go phan tshun dmag 'khrug sogs kyis rgyun du dus bde med pa bcas kyi rkyen pas thon skyed sogs sgo gang sar nyams gud tshabs che'i gnas su lhung ba ma zad/ bran g.yog rnams la mi bdag so sos bkag 'doms rdu/nga / bskul spyod bcas ya nga ba'i gnas su gyar ba de dag gcig gyur bzo ba'i nurnga/ pa su la'ang med pa'i skabs su/ hor gong ma e chen go dan gyis bod du dpung dam ga btang ste bod gcig gyur bzos rjes sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan khu dbon le'ang kru'u ru gdan drangs te sa hor 'brel ba'i 'ardzo/ tshugs pa dang / hor e chen gong ma 'das rjes hu bi li se chen rgyal po yo na rgyal rabs kyi gong ma dang pos sa skya'i 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa las nga/bang chos richa/ ḍa4ra zhus pa dang / chos rgyal 'phags pas hor yig gsar du bzo gnang mdzad pa sogs kyi bdag rkyen du thog mar gong mas ti shri dang /kan ṣ+pen gu shī zhes pa'i mtshan dang / tham ka phul bar ma zad/ bod dbus katsang ru bzhi dang / chol kha gsum bcas rim bzhin phul te dbus gtsang du /sri sko ra bcu gsu ma gyi 'a/ma 'u gas btsugs shing / khri bskor so sor khri dpon dang / stong dpornga la sogs pa'i sgrig gzhi de dag gi spyi 'doca/sa sa skya pa nas gam/nga rgyu dang / na/ skya'i dpomyo/ chen dang po shākya bzang por zam lu ghun dben hu'i ḍū / sa pa'i cho lo dang / ḍā/la gyi dam ka bcas gnang ba red/ 'phags pa rin po che bod du phyir phebs rjes/ dgung krangs so gsum bzhes pa rab byung lnga pa'i me yos(1267) lo slar yang yon gong d+dha/sa hor yul du gdan zhus ltar phebs skabs las tshan bcu gsu/rma gra sgrig gis byon pas/ skabs der‘‘snyigs dus dge sbyong dpon po 'i cha zhu gas sprudzi'e/’’ḍā/sa so gas kyi zur za zhu mal/ na yang byung yod kyang de kha/ga la dgag pa nga/nga bcas gang ltar chen po la 'os pa'i las tshan bcu gsu ma ḍā/ru/ pa 'di 5/kya /༄/ chos kyi rgyas po 'phags pa'i sku/ dus nas dar 1ji 3

ba 6)na ba/shib// de 05nga slobs zurgan bcu gsum ni/ ‘ba/ro/'a/ gzim skya/tshebyed gsum/mjal yig mdzod gsum/ thab 'dren gdan gsum/ skya rta cha/dzo khyi bzhi’’zhes pa 'di dag yin pa dang / de rjes rab byung lnga pa'i shing phaya/(1206) lo chos rgyal 'phags pas nye gnas shākya bzang po la dpon che na dang / kun dga' bzang por nang chen sogs bsgo bzhag gis dus skabs de nas bzung sa skya'i srid kyi sgrig gzhi cha tshang ba zhig btsugs te dbus gtsang khri slo/ra bcu gsuskya/ la khri skor rer khri dpon re dang / gzhan rnams la bla dpon sprags ma dang nga/pon 'go mtha' sgang dacha/ga dpon sogs kyang rim pas bskos/ yul khams nga/zha na rnams rgya' phran lta ngur brtsis nas khrims 'dzin/ 'u/ nga sprur/ khrul rigs gtan /wa/ phab pa sogs byas te bod chol kha gsum la dbang bsgyur ba red/chos/ kyi rgyal po rir+yā gar+sā pa rin po che 'i skru mche da chung ba slob dpon phyag na'i sras dharma pā la gong du byo na nas yar phebs skabs mashedo smad / tul te maṇ+ḍa/ spru dayo/na du d+dha/ phag(1 287) lo dajo/ngas pa rdzogs rjer+sā r+sā skya'i gdu nga rgyud nyag phrar gyur gshis/ sa skya dgon par bzhu/gas mu sa shar pa/se gdung las mche da rnga/'i shar pa sejam dbyangs kyis gdan sa rgyun ring skyong dartso/sa brung bai ngo carnga༄ kyi/ gre/nasardo tshul la ba rten gong ma'i bka' ltar bdag nyid che na ngo/ khazang po daḍū/sna/ (sa skyari gdung) sman rtse'i yul nas spyan drangs te rnga/ skya'i tsho/di na rtswa bskya nga sa pa ma zad/ dpon chen ag lin gyis bdag nyid chen por btsun/ cho / sgyuga' zhig phul nas gdung rgyud spel gnang mdzad par mumyo/ chi/ /kacig pa'i ga dung sras rngab 1 ri / gre/zhon mang ngo byung bad brten/ gdung sras bgye/hroge rnga/ ti 3 kun dag3 rlo kres kyis sho/ myo/ durīd tsha/mas bla brang khag bak+shir bajo/ru tswa cho4 ski trīngu — ṣ+pe /'a/ du bcuzla/ / /de narngashaṃ bzung sa skya'i srid kyi skyong lugs thad 'byur ba hūṃju— ca/rnga sa byi ri ri ladzi'i/ 164

bla brang khag gi gdung sras res bskor gyi thog nas bskyangs pa bcas bla brang khag babyu ste gzhi thog bla brang dang / rin chen sgang bla brang / lha khang bla brang /dus mchod bla brang bcas bzhir gdung rgyud rnams bla brang so sor bzhugs te khri 'dzin gnang zhing / gzhi thog bla brang sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sku dus btab pa dang / bla brang gzhan gsum kun dga' bzang po dpon chen gyi dus bskrun/de ltar 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa nas ta dben blo gros rgyal mtshan bar bdag chen khri thog dgu dang / dpon chen shākya bzang po nas dbang brtson bar dpon chen nyi shu skor(dpon chen 'ga' res bskyar ldab byas pa'ang brtsis)gyis khyon rab byung bzhi pa'i chu glang nas rab byung drug pa'i sa khyi (1263da wa1368)lo bar bod yongs la dpal ldan sa skya ba'i lung gis dbang bsgyur pa red/bod yongs la dbang sgyur byed pa'i sa skya'i srid dbang de rab byung drug pa'i sa khyi lor phag grur shor ba dang / de nas rim bzhin bla brang khag gsum gyi gdung rgyud rdzogs te dus mchod bla brang rkyang pa'i gdung rgyud la thug cing /dus mchod bla brang nas sa skya'i chos srid kyi dbang sgyur byas/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i nang dus mchod bla brang gi bdud 'dul snying po'i sras pad+ma bdud 'dul dbang phyug dang kun dga' rin chen sku mched gnyis kyi sku dus su pho brang yas mas gnyis su gyes shing bdag chen pad+ma bdud 'du/la dbang phyug zhabs lha zhes par bzhugs pa dang / kun dga' rin chen gyis phun tshogs pho /brang btab ste bzhugs/ de rjes pad 'dul gyi sras bkra shis rin chen gyis sgrol ma pho brang btab pas pho brang yas phyin gnyis te phun tshogs pho brang dang / sgrol ma pho brang zhes pa byung ba sogs mdor na sa skya'i gdung rgyud nyag phra dang / chos srid 165

dbang char 'pho 'gyur/ nang 'ag 3sdo sogs kyi gnas tshul byung yod rung / rtsa ba'i nang khul chos srid kyi sgrig gzhi'i thad dus phyis kyang bdag khri'i dbu 'dzin 'og mkhan chen gyis dbus dgon pa'i las 'dzin dang / zhabs 'bring las tshan bcu gsum gyi rnam pa mtshon byed tsam gyi phyi nang sngar srol chos srid sgrig gzhi cha tshang tsam zhig yod pa red/nye rabs kyi sa skya'i drung rigs ser skya'i las tshan so so'i go gnas kyi rim pa mtho dma'i dbye tshul thad bdag chen khri pa phud pa'i las tshan gtso bo'i rim pa mtho shos mkhan phyag gnyer gsum zhes chos sde'i mkhan chen gcig (mkhan zur yang tshud)dang / shod mdzod pa gcig gnyer dpon gcig bcas dang / de 'og drung yig che mo gcig de 'og rtse phyag gcig dang drung yig gzhon pa gsum/ gsol gzim mchod gsum/ de 'og lde 'chang pa gnyis dang mgron gnyer bzhi bcas yin pa dang / de min gyi las tshan khag rnams ni zhabs zhu'i bslab pa rgan gzhon gyi rim par brtsi ba las/ las tshan so sor rim pa mtho dma' 'di yin dmigs bsal med pa(sa skya'i mdzod pa bdag chen khri mjal sosas lha sar bskyod skabs sa gnas srid gzhung nas las tshan dkyus ma'i gdan thob gnang srol 'dug)bcas zhib phra ser skya'i dakhye ba dang las gnas skor dang /chos sde lho byang gi las sne'i rim pa bcas khungs so sor gsham du bkod yod/bdag chen nam khri chen/bdag chen nam khri chen(sa skya bas skyabs mgon rtse zhes 'bod srol)rim byon ni 'khon gyi rigs las mche da pa'i sa skya'i gdung rgyud gang rung zhig sa skya'i srid kyi 'gan 'khur ba mdzad pa dang / lha sde mi sde'i tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms spre66

kyi thog go bsdur gyis tā la'i bla ma mchog la 'char phud/ phyag rtags gzhir bzung /skru 5/ rngo tre/ ge mdzad srol dang / dus phyis pho brang gnyi8 su/ gyes te phun tshogs rdzo / brang dang sgropa/ ma pho brang rwa/nyis khri pa res 'a/wo da lta bur cha/dzad srol de yang sngar sdam 'char phul phyag rtags dgongs don khri pa gsar pa lha sar khri mjal zhu bcar gyis sngar srol mdzad sgo grub nas sa skyar phyir phebs mtshams khri phebarngage kyi mdzad sgor rten 'brel zhu ba sngar sropa/ ltar sa gnas srid gzhung dang / bkras lhun bla brang so so'i sku tshab dpon rigs mngags gtong bcas khri pheb‘ na rten 'bremā gzab rgyas gnang srol/ khri chen ni sa skya'i chos srid gnyis ka'i gtso (shrīdzin mtho shos yin pa ma zad/ mtshan gnas thob thang bod kyi ho thog thu yongs kyi ang dang po yin gshis lha phebs skabs kyang phebs byams li wang nang phebs srol ma zad/ skyid tshal klu lding du gzhung zhabs ser skya brgyad chibs zhabs bcar dgos la/ tā la'i bla ma mchog gi mjal kha'i skabs bdag chen la ho thog thu gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i bzhugs gdan gangan 'phar gyi gdan thob kyang yod/ sa skya'i chos phyogs kyi mdzad ga tso‘‘lha chen mkhan khriririzheb/ mkhan po dang / srid kyi gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur mkhan mdzod pa 'pho len skabs gsar pa bdag khri rang nyid nas bsko bzhag gis gzim chung 'gag tu mgron brgyud kyi bka' bsgyur gnang srol phud/ de byings chos srid kyi las don gle/la che'i rigs phyag mdzod nas 'char phuka la bdag khris phyag rtags gnang rgyu bcas kyi mdzad srol mchis/sa skyar rtse shod ces sgrig gzhi gnyis yod par rtse zhes pa ni bdag khri'i thad ka'i zhabs zhu ba'i sgrig gzhi zhig yin zhing / de la yo ngas 'dzin dang /rtse phyag mdzod gcig gso6/ gzica/ mchod gre/sum/ chogs cha/gron gcig bla sman pa gcig 'dren dpon gcig phebs 'go gcig rtse gathim 'gag gcig— 67

jo nga/pon che mo — —/ceg 'a/lkeci rnyi //ra khupre jika' shas/ de 3rin drung rig8 ge kyi /ro/ngarngag su rma ga jiteg sa nga 'i sdu li gang pa ngoci ka bya sna sachib ༷ gas pa bcu druka ce chibaru / dpon/ bar tha— tha ces panaso ci4 thab rngor bya na gcedzo/ tre gas/ yod cing / ngo/nga gre/t+nani 'a/ rtse'i zhabs zhu ba de dag/ kyang 'pho len byung skatshobs phyagre/ mdzod nar+sā 'o/ rnga/ 'char phu ka bar bdag chen gyi phyag rtags bstsasmyo ge ba gzhir barbung mdzod pas shod 'gag tu mgron brgyud bka' bsgyur gyi thog nas bsko bzhag byed srol/rtse skor gyi las 'gan/ rtse phyag mdzod(snga mo rtse drung yin rung phyisdo/ skya drung cha/sa byed)kyis gtso bo bdag chen khri pa'i na bzak+ṣ-isgyu skor chas dang / gser dngul las grub pa'i mchod chas sna tsho gas dang bzang gos rnying ma sogs kyi 'cham gos rigs sna tshogs/ zhal dkar yu ring rnying ma rlo gar+sā gre/na' rngos rtsa che mang po rtse phyag gi rtsis 'khrir yod pa de dag rnams 'arge bdag gces dang /rtse phyag gsar rnying 'pho 'gyur skabs rtse shod kyi thu tshab ched katong gi shaṃ / deb gsal bzhin rtsis sprod len byed dgos pa/ de bzhin phyag mdzod dang / gnyer tshang la sa khungs gnyis nas 'char can thugs mkho sgrig 'bul zhu dgos rnams bsdu nyar 'bu(sda gtong / 4/zhan yang sto byang khamarnga/ so/gas khusri gyi sa /wangs dgon /—bag la bla bskos ched btang gi sgrig 'bul dang / dad sbyin /spang/ natra/ phu ba'i dngos rigs sogs bdag khri'i sku chas dang thugs mkho rnams bdag rnga/nanyer 'thus tshang bya rgyu/nga/so la gar+yāca/ mchod gasngu myo4 yī la sa/ 'ali/na/ gso 0mi/ /kad+nghamyo/ sa/nyir+sha naca/ sku spu/3/ rtag sdo da kyiṭashaṃ gsol ja gso ge chas 'che/gas 'bāl dang na bza3 ṣ+pe 7 (de bu la sogre/sa /kye cu/bas zhu dang / mchod dasnga/na gyes phyag dpe bdaye/ nyar nang ma cho da ga/tor raskom sgrigre/ so/gas bya hūṃ /tshogs mgron(ser mo ba)gyis bdag che na tshogs phebs skabs skyabs tho 16 3

klog rgyu /deng / mja' nga/mangs so/gas kyi snyan seng zhu rgyu dang bka' lan brgyud sgod byed sgo sogs ya ra zhu mar gnang bya rgyu/'dren dpon(ser mo ba)gyis mdzad sgo khag tu sder kha bgo 'grems sogs kyi las 'gan 'khur rgyu/phebs byams 'go pa'i(skya bo)khongs phebs byams gnyis yod par de'ang bdag khri dang rgyal yum zhes gdung sras 'khrungs pa'i yum gyi phebs byams la phebs byams gnyer pa(skya bo)zhig dang phebs byams pa dkyus ma brgyad re yod pa/ gong smos ltar gdung sras 'khrungs pa'i bdag mor sa skya pas rgyal yum zhes 'bod srol ma zad/ phar tshur phebs bskyod du phebs byams nang phebs chog pa dang / gal te gdung rgyud sras 'khyungs med na bdag mo zhes 'bod pa las rgyal yum zhes 'bod srol med la/ phebs byams la'ang phebasadzhasrol med/rtse gzim 'gag(skya bo)pas bdag khri'i sku mdun mjal bcar zhu mkhan gyi mi sna stangs 'jin dang / rtse gzim chung 'gag gi sgrig lam srung 'dzin gyi las 'gan sgrub rgyu/ja dpon chen mos gsol ja'i do dam dang / zhal nyir pa zhes pa 'ga' shas yod pa rnams kyis gsol thab nas gsol nyir 'degs 'dren zhu sgo sogs byed/chibs dpon gyis rtse'i chibs thang(rta drel)gi gzan chag dang rtswa thang bkod sgrig chibs sgyur skabs chibs rta go sgrig sogs bya rgyu/de min bar thab ste ma byan sogs nas ming don mtshungs pa'i rang 'khri'i las don sgrub dgos/ gzhan yang sa skyar ban gtsang zhes pa'i grwa tshang zhig yod pa de ni bdag 169

chen gyi chog zhabs zhu mkhan grwa tshang zhig red / bad ske/ che na phyogan/ phebangano skabs ban gtsang pa /bag gcig chibs zhabs su bcar te gsung chog zhabs zhu sgrub dgos/drung yig chen mos bdag khri'i bka' yig 'bri rgyu 'gan len thog rnamasakun yig tshang las khungs kyi 'gan 'khur nas drung yig kha shas yod pa bcas kyis phyag mdzod la gzhogs 'degs byas te srid kyi las 'gan sgrub rgyu/phyag mdzod las khungs/phyag mdzod las khungs zhes pa 'di ni sa skya'i srid kyi las don gtso bor gyur pa'i phyi nang gang ci'i 'khur 'dzin bkod khyab byed po yin zhing / der sa skya bas‘‘shod’ ces 'bod srol mchis/ de'i 'go 'dzin gtso bo ser skya gang rung gi mdzod pa(sa skya pas zhabs pad ces 'bod srol)gcig yod pa de skya bo yin na skra lcog kyang brgyabs chog de 'og rim pa bzhin drung che gcig drung yig gzhon pa gsum/ lde 'chang gnyis/ mgron gnyer bzhi/ yig gnyer gcigayig 'bri ba drung dkyus 'ga' shas/ dmag don do dam pa gcig shod gzim 'gag gcig rtswa gnyer gcig shing dpon gcig khang dpon gcig rta khal 'go pa gcig(gong gsal mang che ba skya drung )/ de min drung rigs ser skya bcu skor tsam bcas dang / de 'og drung rigs min pa bar thab pa'am shod gsol thab pa ma byan gcig gsol g.yog gsucha// gad pa gcig gdan gnyer gcigachibs dpon gcig bong dpon gcig ka chi(las ka rtsag rtsig btang thung rgyug mkhan)bzhi/ tshem bzo dang / lha bris/ shing bzo/ rdo bzo/ rngo bzo/ lcags bzo bcas bzo rigs drug la 'go dpon re/ zhol rgan po gcig bcas yod 170

pa de rnams nas mdzod pa ni bdag khri'i gzim chung 'gag tu bdag khris bad kar bsgo bzhag gnang srol skor gong du bdag khri'i gnang sgo'i khings bkod pa ltar dang / phyag mdzod las khungs kyi mi sna gzhan rnams dang / de min gnyer tshang las /rwangs kyi mi sna sogs sa skya'i las tshan mi sna rnamasacophyag mdzod las khungs nas bdag khrir 'char phul phyag rtags dgongs don gzhir bzung shod 'gag ste phyag mdzod 'gag tu mgron brgyud bsko bzhag gnang srol mchis/mdzod pa dang / drung lde mgron gsum zhes drung che rgan gzhon/ lde 'chang ba/ mgron gnyer rnams bcas ni rgyun ldan phal cher nyin ltar lhan rgyas tshugs dgos shing / mdzod pa ni 'go 'dzin gtso bo yin rung / sa skya'i chos srid sde 'bangs 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed phyogs skor gyi don 'gangs che riṭa gros bsdur gyis bdag chen khri par snyan 'bul dgongs bskor dang 'char phul phyag rtags kyi dgongs don gzhir bzung lag bstar dgos pa dang / gsham rim gyi snyan seng phul 'byor nang 'char can gyi khrul bsdu khrims gnon bkod khyab byed sgo sogs don 'gangs cung chung rigs rnams mdzod pas thag gcod dang 'brel mdzod dam 'byar ma'i bkod rgya lag 'khyer yang gtong chogabye brag so so'i byed sgo'i skor/ drung ches 'gan 'khur gyis drung gzhon dang yig gnyer/ yig 'bri ba bcas nas rtsa ba'i phyag mdzod las khungs kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i yig tshang khang zhes par bsdad de phyi nang srid las dper na/ gzhung sar sa skya'i rje 'bangs kyi bde sdug skor gyi snyan 'bul dgos rigs dang / gzhung bla sa gsum phyi nang 'khri sgrub byed phyogs/ 'dzin dbang bdag thob skor sogs 'brel yod rdzong gzhis la yi ge 'bul gtong dgos rigs/rang khongs su khrul bsdu khriskya/sa gnon skor gyi bkod rgya gtong dgos rigs sogarnga kyi yig 'bri'i las don mtha' dag sgrub dgos pa dang / gal cheri rigs 171

mdzod pa brgyud bdag khrir dgongs bskor ram mdzod par bka' bsdur zhus te 'char zin bzo 'god byed dgos pa sogs/lde 'chang ba) gnyis nas dpal 'byor 'du 'god(bsdu gtong)kyi las don te gzhis khag dang mi ser gyi lo re'i deb gsal khrul bogs kyi yong 'bab thog nas phyag mdzod las khungs su 'bab rigs kyi dngul dang / sha mar/ snam rigs/ rtsid pa/ khu lu sogs dang / bkar 'bru phon che/ stod smad khul tu phebs pa'i bla bskos khag gi sgrig 'bul dngos rigs ja dang / dar gos/'bras/ rta drel/ mdzo sogs sngar srol lam byang deb gsal gyi 'bab yong khag sogs bsdu len/ stod smad khul dang lho 'brug sogs kyi dad sbyin khag gi 'bul dngos sna tshogs bcas pa'i do dam byed sgo dang / gtong sgo gtong yul dper na/ bdag khri'i thugs mkho 'bul gtong dgos rigs dang / chos sde sto byang gis mtshon mchod phogs gtong sgo khag mi sna phyogs bskyod kyi sto phogs sogs 'char 'phar ci rigs kyi gtong sgo rnams nas phyag mdzod las khungs kyis gtong dgosdo rigs rnams deb gsal bzhin dus thog gtong sprod byed sgo'i do dam bcas byed dgos la/ srid kyi las don la'ang the jus byed dgos/mgron gnyer bzhis khrul khrims dang / 'dzin dbang bdag thob/ phan tshun bzlos rtsod byung rigs sogs phyi nang don 'bud(gnad don thon rigs)skor dang / 'char 'phar gyi gal che'i las don sogs kyi skor bdag khri'am/ mdzod par snyan seng zhu dgos rigs yar snyan seng zhu rgyu dang / bka' khyab dgongs don mar bsgrags rgyu sogs kyi byed sgo dang / gzhan yang stod smad khul gyi sa khongs gzhis khag nas lo 'khor deb gsal khrul bogs bsdu len dang / gzhis ka 'ga' shas su lo re'i ston 'bras/ nas bkar 'jug byed sgo bcas su lo ltar bod zla bcu pa'i nang lde mgron ga nyis dang / las bya drung dkyus re bcas hūṃ7ri

jis mos kyis sa gnas so sor bsdu 'jug byed par bskyod thog de'i grangs 'bor ji byung sa skya'i mdos chen(bod zla 11pa'i tshes 13 nas tshes 19bar zhag bdun ring tshugs pa'i dus mchod)skabs las byed tshang ma 'dzoms mtshams mdzod par rtsis zhu zhu dgos/ gong gsal 'gro res ngo las so sor phogs sdon phran bu re'ang mchis/ gzhan yang sa skya pa nas lo ltar tā la'i bla ma mchog la sngar lam dgung gsar gyi rten 'brel dang / dbyar dus chab zhugs legs 'bul bstar bar mgron bzhi res 'khor gyi 'gro bskyod byed dgos shing / dgung gsar rten 'bul skabs lo ltar bod zla 1mitshes shrī6 nyin rtse dgu gtor ma tshugs gong snga dro drung ja'i thog 'byor phyag gi rten gsum bstar 'bul zhu dgos/ de nas bod zla 1 tshes 1 snga dro tshoms chen du mdzad sgo tshugs mtshams 'tshams zhu'i zhu rgya dang / gser srang phyed gsum/ gos dar tshon lnga'i tshan grangs sogs bstar 'bul zhu dgos/ de nas srid skyong dang / bka' shagayig tshang las khungs sogs su'ang 'tshams zhu'i mjal dar dang / byin mdud(byin ṣ+pen dam rdzas dang ljags mdud)yod pa'i zhu rgya/ tshan grangs dod rgya dngul srang do'i 'thum re/ de min drung rtsis(drung yig che mo dang rtsis dpon)sku bcar (tā la'i bla ma mchog gi sku'i gam du rtag bcar zhabs zhu ba)gsol gzim/ gzhan yang bla phyag dang / rtse phyag bsher dpang / lha bzhugs bdag khri'i sku nye khag bcas la'ang 'tshams zhu dang / byin mdud sogs khungs so sor 'bul bar bcar dgos/ gong gsal rten 'bul zhu sgo rnams zin te zla ba phyed gnyis tsam mas bka' lan bstsal thon mtshams gzhes brda snyan seng dang bcas thon phyag zhus nas phyir log byed/ gong gsal dbyar dgun 'gro bskyod thengs gnyis kar phar phyir(phar lam dang phyir log)rta khal gyi lam gron dang gzan gron gang 'tshams gtong dgos pas mgron bzhi'i thab rten du sa khongs spu dkar gzhis 173

ka zhes pa'i gzhis ka zhig yod thog la3/ 3/zer shab gzhis ka dang rtse gdong gzhis ka ga nyis nas phar lam rin spungs rdzong bar rta 'u9ge gsum re brje len gyi bskul rgyu yod la/ phar phyir lam 'khel sa gnas so sor sdod sgrig dang /rta g.yog thab g.yog bskul 'ded chog pa'i sbug dam 'byar ma'i gtan lam yod pa dang / sa skya gzhung nas kyang lam gron thob cha phran bu sprod kyi yod/sa skya 'di bzhin snga dus khrims 'go rang btsan zhes khrims don che chung gang yin rung rang khongs nas khrims gcod bkod 'doms byas chog kyang / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku'i stod cha tsam ste bdag chen phun kho 'dzam gling che rgu dbang 'dus kyi sku dus su mgron gnyer bde legs pa dbang rdor zer ba kha shugs che tsam yod pa de dang / drung che kun byang bstan 3dzin mgon po gnyis 'cham mthun med pas drung che kun byams bstan mgon pa'i skog g.yo ngan jus 'og sa skya nye 'khor mi ser nas mgron gnyer bde legs pas brdabs mnar gtong tshul la bsnyad de mgron gnyer pha bu rkyen lam btang rkyen gzhung nas de skor zhib dbyo da ser skya ched phebs kyis byed gte khag /rā khrims 'doms da nga / spyi sger la dngul dngos khyon che'i bka' nyes dang 'brel slar khrims 'gar ngan spyod 'di rigs kyi mtshon don rkyen che rigs mtha' dag gzhung sa'am gzhis rdzong du skabs 'phral snyan seng zhus dgo sa pa las/ sa skya pas khrims 'go rang btsan yin khul gyis gang byung khrims 'doms nam yang mi chog pa'i mtha' 'doms gnang ba de nas bzung sa skya pas rang khongs mi ser nang khul gyi 'jin dbang bdag thob skor dang / khrul 'ul 'khri sgrub byed phyogs/phan tshun rtsod gzhi chung gras/ rku rgyag sogs kyi gnas tshul cung rigs la rang khongs nang zhib dpyod pa zur bsko dang 'brel thag gcod 'os 'tshams byed pa dang / 'gal nyes la gzhigs pa'i dngul dngos kyi nyes chad dam/ lam bzo 174

rags rgyag nyin grangs tshad bkag gi phyag 'tshal du 'jug pa/ rku rgyag dang 'khrug rtsod cung tshabs che rigs la rta lcag bzhu ba dang / ske sgo g.yogs pa/kang lcags rgyag pa/ btson 'jug gam gzhis khongs gzhan du dus bkag rgyang 'bud gtong ba sogs byas chog kyang / rtsod 'then(rtsod gzhi 'then khyer)rgya che'i rigs dang / nang khul nas thag gcod mi thub pa'i gang ci'i don 'gangs che rigs gzhung sa dang gzhis rtse spyi rdzong du snyan seng zhib gtugs dgos pa las sngar lugs lta bu'i khrims 'go rang btsan byed mi chogashod 'gag pas shod 'gag ste phyag mdzod khang gi 'gag tu mi sna khag gi sgrig lam gnon 'doms dang bde srung do dam sogs byed dgos/dmag don do dam(sa mgron gcig yin zhes gsungs)pas snga dub sa skya par dmag rten rjes 'khri'i rgya sbyong dmag sum cu tsam yod pa de dag kyang sa skya lha khang chen mo'i gtsug lag khang gi spung char phul de lo ltar sa skyar sos ka dang dgun kha zla ba re tsam rub 'dzoms kyis sos sbyong dgun sbyong zhes dmag rtsed phran bu sbyong brdar byed srol las/ nam rgyun rang khongs su bsdad 'thus de dag gi 'go 'doms byed sgo sogs byed dgos kyang / phyis rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu phag(1923)lo gzhung nas gtsang khul sa zhib gnang ste gtsang rdzong khag dang bkras bla bcas par〈chu phag bka' rtsa 'dra bcu gsum〉zhes pa'i dgongs don lag bstar thog gong gsal sa skya'i rgya sbyong dmag rnams gzhung gi dmag sgar du zla bsgril gyis lo lo'i dmag gla dang sto phogs kha sgon/dbyar dgun gyon dod spyi mtshungs sprod dgos pa ma zad/ rkang 'don brgyad bzhi'i dmag ces brgyad sna tha dang dang bzhi sna ka darngo sku srung dmag kyang 'khri sgrub byed dgos pa bzos pa dang / gzhan yang snga dur+sā sa skya pas gzhung rtsam bzhes las khungs su‘‘rgya shing rngo da gsumari’(rgya gso ni am ba na sogs kyi dgos 175

cha/ shing ni smo na lam gyi tshogs shing / rngod ni smon lam gyi tsha gra'i rtsam pa rngod 'thag las)zhes pa'i khral dngul sne sel tsam 'bul dgos pa las/ sa khongs nas rkang 'gro lag 'din gyi gzhung khrul 'khri sgrub ma dgos kyang / gong gsal dus skabs nas bathung gzhung gi zhi drag mi sna khag 'grul bzhud sogs 'char 'phar gang ci lam 'khel tsā/ ga nas rta khal mi gsum gyi 'khri sgrub byed sgo dang / lam 'khel min rigs nas gzhung bla rdzong khongs so sor gzhung don rta khal mi gsum song rigs 'bor grangs zla drug re'i thog rtsis rgyag dang 'brel lam dod dngul 'bab slog sprod kyang byed dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs bzos pa bcas/phyag mdzod las khungs kyi mi sna gzhan dag rtswa gnyer gyis gzhis khag so so'i lo re'i gzan rtswa do dam gyi nye 'khor rnams sa skyar 'or 'dren dang / de byings sa skya gzhung gi rta drel drug cu skor dang / bong bu sogs la gzan rtswa gtong rgyu'i 'gan 'khur dang / shing dpon gyis mi ser gyi lag nas lci ba bsdus te dus mchod khag dang rgyun ldan rtse shod thab tshang khag gi 'bud rdzas 'gan 'khur/ gdan gnyer gyis dus chen khag sogs la khri dang gdan 'bol mi sna'i thob thang gzhir bzung mtho dma'i rgyag stangs byed sgo'i bkod sgrig sogs kyi 'gan 'khur/ khang dpon gyis pho brang yas mas dang / gtsugs lag khang sogs kyi khang pa'i or rka thigs tshags dang skabs 'phral nyams gso chung rtsag dgos rigs kyi do dam 'gan 'khur/ rta khal 'go pas las don mi sna sa skya gzhung gi don du phar tshur 'gro bskyod byed por rta khal bkod sgrig gi 'gan 'khur/de min drung dkyus ser skya nas lde mgron sogs phar tshur gzhung don phyogs bskyod kyi las byar bskyod dgos pa dang / lo gsar du bsam yas chos skyong dang gnas chung chos skyong so sor bdag chen gyi dus gsol snyan dar sna lnga dang /dngul gyi phud phor/ ja phud/ gser phud(chang)/ mnga' gsol phyag bris 176

bcas bstar 'bul zhu bar bskyod dgos rnga// bod zla 5pa'i tshes 15bsam yas mdo sde'i dus mchod skabs kyang gong bzhin dgos pa ma zad/ bsam yas rab byung grwa tshang gi 'dus spyi(dge 'dun 'dus tshogs spyi)dang sngar lam sa skya nas bskos btang bgyis pa'i bsam yas mkhan po/ spyog mkhan tshang sde pa(chos skyong gi bka' lung 'bri mkhan)dben chung dpon slob(grwa pa'i dpe cha'i dge rgan)ces pa bcas so sor yang 'tshams 'dri'i bkod rgya dang / yig rten kha btags byin bdud bcas khungs sprod byed sgo dang / gzhan yang lho khul sa dgon bco lnga skor la mang ja dang spyi 'gyed dam thum(ljags mdud dang dam rdzas thum)khri dam 'byar ma'i(bdag khri'i dam phrug 'byar ma)'tshams 'dri'i bka' yig bcas khungs so sor 'bul bar zhabs dkyus re ngo bskyod dam yang na des bang mi gla gtong gang rung byed/ yang lo gsar skabs bkras lhun dgon du kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che dang dza sag bla ma sogs la'ang sngar lam rten 'bul bstar bar sa drung re ngo bskyod byed dgos/gong gsal bzo rigs khag drug gi 'go dpon nas rang rang las rigs kyi khrul bskul batho dkyus rnams la bkod khyab kyis skabs bstun dgos mkho sgrub dgos pa/ khrung ra sto zhes chang 'tshong mkhan gyis sa skyar phebs bzhud gzhung bla'i mi sna sogs la sne len dgos rigs skabs kyi mchod chang khrung ma nas gtong dgos/ ka chi ba rnams kyis btang thung sogs las don rtsag rtsig rnams byed dgos pa/ de bzhin bar thab ste ma byan gtso bo gcig dang ma g.yog gsum/ gad pa/ chibs dpon sogs nas rang rang ming don mtshungs pa'i las don sgrub dgos pa bcas dang / de min khrims gcod skabs rta lcag gzhu mkhan‘‘chu zam gnyis ’te chu skor ba dang zam sne ba zhes pa'i dud tshang gnyis gtan 3jags su yod pa(sa skya bas khrims dpon zhes 'bod kyang don du bskor bya ba ji 177

lta bu yin)'di dag gis gong nas nyes ca na nga ra / rbenge rngage bo/cisgyud bye nga sgo'i rnga ka' brda 'byor 'phral gong rim gyi bka' bzhin las/ zastar byed dgos pa/ yang gzar pa tshong dpon zhes pa zhig yod pa der phyag mdzod khang nas lo re 'bru ru'i khal brgya tham pa re sprad de bzhi skor rtsis tshur 'bras ru'i khal nyer lnga re 'bul len byed srol yod pa/zhol rgan pos sa skya'i nye 'khor lha khang dbon mda' ba dang / ha mo ba/ma mi ba/ lo spel ba/ lcags zur ba bcas gnas khag lnga po 'di dag gi rgan po byas te gzhung bla gnyis sogs kyi dpon rigs dang stod smad khag nas mi sna 'byor rigs la sne len byed sgo'i 'gan 'khur do darma byed dgos pa bcas/gnyer tshang las khungs/gre/nyer tshang las khungs zhes pa 'di ni dpal 'byor bsdu gtong gi las don byed po yin zhing / de'i 'go 'dzin gtso bo gnyer dpon zhes ser mo ba zhig bsko ba de nyid mdzod par+sā bdag khrir 'char phul phyag rtags dgongs don phyag mdzod las khungs nang du'ang de'i gdan thob yod pas phyag mdzod khang du sngar srol gsol ja bzhes 'bras sogs sgrig gshoms kyis mdzod pas thang/ kar bsko srol/ de 'og gnyer tshang pa skya bo gnyis(go gnas rim pa mgron gnyer bzhi'i mtshams yin)/ de 'og mi dpon skya bo bzhi/ rngod rgyab pa gnyis/ drung dkyus lnga drug tsam/ de min tshos dpon gcig tshos khang pa bzhi/ khrung ra byang zhes chang khang pa gcig bal dpon gcig bal ma drug gsol ja sgang pa gcig phyi rgyab pa gcig btang thung ba gcig bcas yod pa rnam sa phyag mdzod las khungs nas 'gag tu mgron brgyud bsko bzhag byed srol/178

gnyer tshang las khungs kyis sa skya'i gtong yong gi las ka gtso bor byed dgos shing / snga dus gzhung 'dzin yin tshod kyang bar lam zhig nas khe gyong rang 'khur gyi sger 'dzin byed srol des sa skya'i mnga' khongs phal che bar gzhung zhing zhes gnyer tshang las khungs kyi khongs sa zhing sa rgyu gshin gras khyon son ru'i khal rnga0sdeskor tsam yod pa khungs so sor gzhis gnyer re bsko 'dzugs do dam gyis 'debs las dang rnga bsdu/ g.yul las sogs dus bzhi'i so nam byed sgo dang / gzhan yang 'u lag mi khal dgos rigs 'khri khungs mi ser so so bskul rgya yod la/ lud khrul sogs kyang bsdu rgyu yod/ ston bsdu zin mtshams gnyer tshang yong sdud pa zhes las don mi sna ngo las lo re skor gyi sa gnas so sor mngags gtong byas te 'bru rigs thon 3bor gre/shor /3jal rtsis len do dam dang 'brel 3khri khungs mi ser so sos sa skya bar skyel 'dren byed lam/gzhan yang nye 'khor sa khongs zhing 'brog mi ser dang / shab dang rma bya gnyis sogs nas lo ltar sha khrul dang / mar khrul/ snu spe khrul/ sa zhing son kha/ra brgya rer bogs ma ru'i khal nyi shu re yin pa'i bogs 'bru khyon che bcas bsdu rgyu yo da la/ mi ser ra lug yod rigs kyi ra lug lnga bcu re nas khyu 'dzin zhes lug re bsdu len yang bya rgyu yod par khyon lo rer lug chig stong sum brgya tsam 'bab kyi yod/ de min stod smad khu/la du 'bul sdud bla bskos khag nas ra lug dang / mdzo g.yag ja sogs gang 'tshams sngar lam deb gsasda bsdu len/ dad sbyin khag gi 'byor 'bul zhus dngos sogar+sā 'bab yong che tsam yod pa dang / de 'brel gtong sgo'ang bdag chen gyi bzhes sha dang gso/la mar/ ma chod maradzhaso/gas grig car 'bul dgo sa kyis ma tshon bla brang khag(khri thog min pa'i gdung rgyud /bag)dang / drung rigs ser skya/ lhag par chos sde lho byang gi dge 'dun dbu dmangs bcas la dus mchod khag so sor sha skal sne79

dang / zhib rdor gsol mar/ mchod mar sogs sha mar gyi gtong sgo gtong yul khag mang dang / de bzhin lo re'i 'bru rigs yong 'bab nas bdag chen gyi ljags smin gsol zhib dang mchod rtsam nar gtong dang / de byings bla brang khag dang / lha chen mkhan las/ drung rigs ser skya/ bla brang khag gi zhabs zhu thob khungs yod rigs/ mi sna phyogs bskyod sogs kyi phogs thob dang /chos sde lho byang gnyis su sgrub mchod khag mang gi mchod 'bru dang mchod rtsam/grwa dmangs kyi phogs skal/ gtsug lag khang dang gzhung khang sogs nyams gso'i skabs rdo shing bris gsum gyi sto phogs/ dgung gsar gyi dkar spro khag mang sgrig 'bul zhu sgo sogs gtong gron rgya che dgos rung / gnyer tshang sger 'dzin byed po gnyer dpon la yong 'bab gang 'tshams yod la/ nge min gnyer las drung rigs gzhan rnams la'ang phogs thob che chung rim pa sna tshogs yod pa rnams lo re'i ston bsdu'i skabs g.yul steng nas sprod len byed pa dang / gzhan yang lo rer shab dang rma bya gzhis khongs su ston bsdu dang khrul bogs bsdu len du gnyer drung re 'khor gyi 'gro bskyod dgos pas de skabs gang ci'i 'bab yong phran bu yod/ gong gsal ston bsdu dang khrul bogs bsdu len du bskyod mi de rnams sa skya mdos chen skabs phyir log 'byor thub pa byas te gnyer tshangs las khungs su rtsis zhu khungs sgrig byeng dgos/ gong gsal mi sna khag bye brag so so'i byeng sgo ni/ gnyer dpon gyi bkod sgrig 'og gnyer pa gnyis nas las khungs de'i byed sgo gang spyi'i 'gan 'khur dang / de 'og mi dpon gyes mi ser gyi 'go 'doms sogs/ rngod rgyab pas yos brngo rtsam 'thag gi do dam 'gan 'khur/ tshos dpon gyis mdos kyi snal ma sogs tshos rgyag gi do dam/ tshos khang pa rnams kyis gtso bo tshos las thog 'bru rtsam gshor kha'i las ka yang byed dgos/ phyi rgyab(las rgyab pa)pas gnyer khongs gzhung zhing khag gi rnga bsdu ji 180 mormo po

g.yul gtong sokas 'ul mi'i las ka'i do dam 'gan 'khur byed dgos/ bal dpon nas bal ma rnacha/sa la 'go khrid kyis mdos kyi snal ma 'kha'/ las kyi do dam byed dgos pa sogs de min so sos rang rang ming don mtshungs pa'i rang 'khri'i las 'gan khag sgrub dgos pa bcas /sa skya'i mchod gzhis khag gi skor/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sku dus su‘‘grom stod dang /grom smad/ stag thog mang mkhar drel chen/ gtsang bar phug shab stod smad/rta nag sogs su gzhis bting / byang gcung / khab so/ kom 'dre/ gar phug sogs su 'brog sde mang du 'cha'/ ra sa sogs su rta khyu 'cha'ami zhes dang /de rjes 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i sku dus su yon gong ma'i lung gis bod yongs la dbang sgyur gnang bas smos ma dgos kyang de rjes sa skya pa'i srid dbang de sde srid sne'u gdong pa ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi lag tu shor rjes sa srid la nyams chags chen po byung ba'i skabs dang bstun nas sde pa lha khang pa dang / lha sa rdzong pa/ skyed 'phrang pa zer ba sogs kyis ngan gshom gyi don rkyen(sa skya ba'i ngag rgyun du phyogs bzhi dgrar langs zer srol)byung ste gdung rgyud zhal ngo rnams rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags lug(1451)lo nas rab byung dgu pa'i shing bya(1626)lo bar gdan sa 'og ma rtse gdong du bzhugs dgos byung ba sogs kyi skabs sngags 'chang chen po kun dga' rin gyi zhabs 'degs rin spungs pa dpon blon gyis zhus te sde pa lha khang pa gzhan du brdzangs/ lha khang chen mo sngags 'chang gi phyag tu phul bar sku tshab 'jog gnang gis sngags 'chang chen po dge sding ḍa ḍi dgon du bzhugs skabs slar 181

yang lha sa rdzo nga pa dang gnas pa mgo skya ba brer ba gnyis/ ngan gros kyi ṭage snga gas 'chang chen po bkrong rgyu dang lha khang chen mo bslu rgyu byas don lha khang che na mo bslus pa nyin gcig sku/sa snga bar byung ste sku tshab mdo sngags rab 'byams pa kun dga' tshe brtan zhes/ pa bkrongs pa sogs kyi gnas tshul byung bar sngags 'chang chen po thugs rab tu phyung ste sgrub pa la bzhed nas byang se mo dor phebs par brtsams pa'i tshe byang bdag chos rgyal nam mkha' tshe dbang rdo rje dang / shar kha(rgyal rtse)sde srid nam mkha' lhun grub gnyis kyis lha sa rdzong pa bton te gdan sa'i mchod gzhis yongs rdzogs sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag tu phul/ sngags 'chang mchog slar yang gdan sar byon pas chos rgyal g.yas ru byang pa dang rgyal rtse ba/ rin spungs pa bcas gsum gyis sa skya'i sngar yod mchod gzhis rnying khungs gang yod thog lha sa rdzong par gtogs pa rnams dang /mang mkhar gzhung / shab smad du gtogs pa pha/la che ba rnams/ phu gsum mnga' zhabs su gtogs pa sogs shin tu rgya che ba'i mchod gzhis rnams phyag tu phul/ ‘‘de nas bzung gdan sa 'di nyid dar rgyas kyi dbu tshugs’’zhes dang /dbang nam mkha' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi sku dus su rdzong lha rtse mnga' zhabs dang bcas pa sogs mchod gzhis kyang shin tu stobs che ba sogs lo rgyus thog sa skya bar dar rgud 'phel 'grib sna tshogs byung ba brgyud dus phyis sa skya bas 'dzin skyong byed pa'i mchod gzhis ni/ gtso bo shab rtsed dmigs gsum zhes shab dge sding gzhis ka dang rtsed gdong gzhis ka dmigs gzhis ka bcas dang / rma dpal spel gsum zhes rma bya dang / spel legs/ dpal ldan rtse gsum/ gzhan yang yul can/ phyogs dkar/ ding ri lte gdong / mus rta gling / spos dkar/ lte rag sogs gzhis ka che khag bcu gsum rnams la khungs so sor sa gzhung nas bsko gtong byas pa'i gzhis sdod re yod pa de dag 182

gis mnga' khongs su d+dha/ma kun khrul bsdu khrims gnon dang / sa gzhung gi sa zhing yod rigs la dus bzhi so nam las bskul gyi do dam/ de min sa gnas srid gzhung dang sa gzhung gi 'char 'phar khrul 'ul bskul bsdu bya rgyu'i skor sogs kyi bkod rgya 'byor bar dang len lag bstar byed sgo sogs kyi 'go 'dzin byed dbo/sa/ gzhan yang gnyer tshang sogs kyi khongs gzhis ka chung gras 'ga' shaṭa yod pa dang gnyer tshang gi gzhung zhing yod khul so sor‘‘gnas brtan’’ zhes gzhis gnyer lta bu re yod pa de dag so sos so nam las bskul do dam sogs byed/ gnyer tshang gi gzhung zhing zhes pa sa zhing drag gras bzung ba de dag gi khrul 'khri rnams mi ser thog bkal yod pa/ gong gsal gzhis khag so so nas lo re'i sa zhing yong 'bab khar/ mnga' 'og mi ser nas sa rkang che chung dang / 'dab nor mang nyung la gzhigs pa'i bogs 'bru dang / sha mar/snum/ snam bu sogs deb gsal khrul rigs gtan 'bebs khag rnams mang che ba phyag mdzod las khungs dang / gnyer tshang las khungs su 'bab kyi yod pa bcas/sa dgon ngo da rigs la mkhan po sogs bla bskos gtong spol skor/sa skya dgon nas stod mnga' ris dang / smad mdo khams/ bar dbus gtsang / gzhan yang 'brug dang klo yul khul sogs su sa dgon yod rigs la sngar lam mkhan po sogs bla bskos btang ba de dag ni gtso bo chos phyogs nas rang lugs 'dzin spel gyi dbu 'dzin mdzad po yin la/ de 'brel khungs so sor dad sbyin khag gi 'bul ba'i yong 'bab kyang che tsam yod cing / lhag 183

par khams phyogs su snga dus sa paṇa dang 'gro mgon chos 'phags dus nas slob ma'i gzhi tshugs/ de rjes bdag chen 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan sku mched dus‘‘sa skya pa'i sde dgon mchod gzhis sogs rgya dpang mi chung tsam khams phyogs 'dir yod pa’’rnams 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i rgyun byung /de rjes sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen sa skya'i gdan bzhugs skabs 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas dang / 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug sogs sa skya'i gdung rgyud 'ga' zhig nas 'dab 'dob dang sa dkar gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i khams khul gyi sa dgon che chung grwa bu slob sbyin bdag dang bcas pa'i zhal bdag gnang bar byon bzhugs gnang srol yang byung yod/dus phyis sa skyas bsko mngags byas pa'i mkhan po dang bla bskos ni gtso che ba a mdo rgya khag bla ma dang / rgya khag dpon slob/ nang chen mkhan po dang /sde dge rgyal po'i bla sman pa/ rgyang ra bla ma('di ni khri chen sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i ska bas dar zhes gsung rgyun)/ skye rgu bla ma/ sde dge khul phur pa bla ma/ de'i gnyer par phur pa dpon gnyer zer ba sogs mdo khams khul bla bskos phebs yul rgya che shos yin la/ gzhan yang mkhan po phebs yul ngor dang / mus/gting skyed/ lha rtse bya gshongs/ bsam yas rab byung grwa tshang(sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen skabs nas dar)/ rgyal rtse rkyang 'dul bde ba can/ 'brug yul/ klo khul sogs dang / bla bskos phebs yul/ spu rengs dang / gro r+shashod/ nag tshang khul sogs mdor na mkhan po dang bla bskos phebs yul che chung khag mang yod cing / de yang mkhan po rnams chos sde lho nas phebs pa dang / bla bskos rnams mang che ba chos sde byang nas phebs/ srol mchis/ bla bskos phebs yul che gras khag la mang che ba ban gtsang pa nas phebs kyi yod pa dang / a mdo bla ma dang nang chen bla ma zer ba sogs che ba 'ga' zhig bla 18snye

brang sku sger gyis sger 'dzin —zu/—/nga ste de ḍa/ga nas sa :kazhung rang la 'bab yong med pa'ang yod 3// bla bsdo rnga/ dkyus ma 'a ko yu la chung rigs rnams la grwa pa lo bco brgyad bcu dgu tsam la bla khra/ rā4 zhes bsko gtong byed srol yang yod/gong gsal mkhan po dang bla bskos sam bla gnyer rnams bsko gzhag byed stangs thad ngor pa mkhan po de sa gzhung nas tā la'i bla ma mchog la 'char phul phyag rtags gzhir bzung bsko ba dang / de min rnams sa mdzod nas‘‘rtse’’ste bdag khrir 'char phul phyag rtags gzhir bzung mgron brgyud bsko gzhag byed cing / bsko gzhag byed skabs ja thum bu chung ngu gcig dang /byin rten shog chag gcig ljags mdud gcig bcas gnang ste‘‘khyed rang la (ga ge mo'i)bla bskos bsko gzhag byas pa yin’mizhes khyab bsgrags gnang srol tshug/nger / bla bskos phebs mkhan rnams phebs yul sa khyad ring thung la brten nas khams ngos phebs mkhan sa thag ring ba rnams‘‘lnga song drug steng’ zhes lo lnga song ba'i drug gi thog yar phebs te sngar lam deb gsal 'bul 'bab khag 'jal dgos pa dang / de las cung thag nye ba rnams‘‘gsum song bzhi steng’ zhes pa'ang yod la/ yang gong gsal spu nag gro gsum du phebs mkhan ni lo ltar bod zla gsum pa'i nang phar phebs te bod zla bcu pa'i nang tshur phebs nas deb gsal 'bul sdud sha mar phyur ba sogs 'bul yul khag la lo ltar 'bu2 dgos pa'ang yod/ khams khul phebs mkhan bla bskos che ba rnams kyis bdag khri dang phyag gnyer‘‘spyi sa khang ’/ bla brang khag sogs la sngar lam deb gsar bzhin bdag chen rin po cher‘‘rgya rdo dang rgya drel’mizhes rgya dngul rdo tshad re dang drel spus legs gcig(bla bskos dkyus ma nas drel dkyus ma re)/ ja rgyab re zung / ‘‘gong ma dkyus ma’’(khri chen min pa'i gdung rgyud bla brang) la rta re 185

tsam dang ja rgyab re tsam/ mdzod pa dang / rje btsun myo/ /spuka mkhan po/ bla ma khag drung che/ mgron gnyer sogs las tshan khag 0/ mjal rten ja 'khor drug(sbag chen bzhi)re bcas 'bul dgos pa dang / phyag ca/dzod khang du rta/mdzo/ drel/ ja sgam nyi shu nas lnga bcu bar so so'i deb gsal gzhir bzung /gnyer tshang du ja 'khor drug 'ga' zhig dgon pa spyir gtong rtsa dang sbyor rtsa gang 'tshams 'jog dgos la/ grwa par mang 'gyed kyang 'bul dgos/ gong gsal rgya drel zhes pa ngo 'bul zhu yas med na dngul bsgyur zhus te 'bul dgos shing / sngar lam rgya drel rer rin dngul ṭam ka re yin rung / phyis drel spus legs 'bul dgos pa yin na ṭam rdo(rdo tshad) brgyad cu re dang /drel dkyus mar ṭam rdo drug cu re 'bul dgos pa byung yod/ de bzhin bla bskos so so phebs yul che chung la gzhigs pa'i 'bul yul khungs so sor 'bul 'bab mang nyung dbye ba yod la/ sa gnas kyi thon khungs khyad chos la gzhigs te sha mar/ g.yag lug snam bu/ 'brug yul khul phebs mkhan nas 'bras sogs 'bul srol yod pa bcas bla bskos so so'i 'bul sdud rnams sngar lam deb gsal gtan 'bebs gzhir bzung khrul ltar 'bul dgos pa yin/chos sde lho byang dang bla brang khang /sa skya dgon du chos sde lho byang gnyis pas sto ma 'dul lugs dang bshad grwa(mtshan nyid grwa tshang) bcas dang / byang ma gsang sngags 'u gas kyi rab 'byams pa dang ban tshang pa grwa tshang gnyis yod cing / sto byang gnyis la dus phyis dge 'dun zhal grangs mang ba'i skabs lnga brgya yas mas dang nyung skabs sum brgya jims mas las med pas zhal grangs ngecha/ gtan med/186

tswa— — (1) chos sde'i rtsa ba'i 'gan 'dzin gtso bo lha khang mkhan chen gyis chos phyogs 'gan 'khur gnang dgos pa ma zad/ grwa gsar bsdu rgyu dang dgon pa'i srid don 'gangs che'i rigs mdzod par go bsdur dang 'brel bdag khrir snyan seng dgongs bskor zhus te thag gcod bya rgyu dang / sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' rgya dgongs don sogs gal che'i skor tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms 'tshog dgos pa'i skabs su mkhan chen gyis dbus chos sde lho byang gi las sne khag dang / mdzod pa/ gnyer drung gsum gyis gtsos sa gzhung gi las sne rnams 'dzoms te gros bsdur byed sgo sogs spyi'i srid don skor la'ang the jus gnang dgos pa dang / skabs re chos sde lho byang mnyam tshogs kyi chos lugs gnang sgo'i skabs mkhan chen gyis chos sde lho byang gnyis ka gcig gyur gyis dbu 'dzin gnang dgos/ mkhan por sku 'gyed kyi sku skal dgon par(chos lho) lnga skal dang / tshogs chen(lho byang mnyam tshogs)du bcu skal bzhes rgyu yod pa dang /dbyar gnas dang dgun mchod sogs dus mchod khag dang / bsngo rten skyabs zhu so gas dad sbyin khag gi 'bul ba'i thog nas 'bab yong dmigs bsal phran bu/ de 'brel gsol phogs spyi mtshungs bcas yod/gong gsal rtse bskos mkhan chen dang / bshad grwa mkhan po(mkhan zur gyi thob thang yod)gnyis kyi 'og dbu mdzad gcig dang / spyi khang dpon slob gcig(spyi tshan yang zer)/ las thog pa gcig chos khrims pa gcig gling dpon bcu drug de 'og rung khang ja dpon gnyis dang / tshwa gzigs pa gcig sgo dpon gcig bcas yod pa de rnams nas chos khrims pa de‘‘lha bskos’ zhes lha khang chen mo'i yang steng du sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyi sku brnyan spyan sngar zan ril phul te bsko gzhag byed srol las de min lho byang gnyis ka'i las sne rnams mdzod pas bdag chen la 'char phul phyag rtags gzhir bzung phyag mdzod 187

'gag tu bsko gzhag byed laca/ mchis/ lha khang mkhan chen dang bshad grwa mkhan po gnyis so sor drung chen zhes sger gyi mdzod pa'am/ gsol dpon lta bu re yod pa mkhan po rang khongs nas bsko rgyu dang / gal che rang min pa'i tshogs 'du sogs la mkhan po'i sku tshab tu drung chen gtong srol/ bshad grwa mkhan po dang dbu mdzad nas rang rang mtshan mtshungs 'os 'gan gnang sgo dang / spyi sa dpon slob kyis dgon pa'i‘‘spyi sa khang ’(spyi so)gi nang 'brel yod srid las phran bu byed dgos rung / gtso bo dpal 'byor bsdu gtong gi do dam byed cing / de yang stod smad khul sogs su bla bskos phebs mkhan nas deb gsal ja mar/ dngul dngos/ lug sogs /sebul 'bab rnams dang / stod smad/ nye 'khor dang bcas pa'i dad sbyin khag gi dad 'bul sbyor rtsa'i dngos rigs sna tshogs rnams dang / sa zhing phran bu yod pa bcas kyi yong 'bab steng nas dus mchod khag tu sha 'gyed dang / mang ja/ lo gsar gi‘‘'khrungs rgyu’’zhes 'bru phrin bu re bcas kyi gtong sgo gtong dgos la/ rgyun ja'i tshogs shing yang gtong dgos pa de'i yong khungs ni nye 'khor dad sbyin nas rta sbangs dang lci ba phul ba rnams yin pa las gzhan gyi yod dmigs med rung / rta sbangs dang thal ba mnyam bsres kyis thab nang gshog pa des rgyun ja bskol gtong byed pa/ gling dpon rnams ni grwa pa'i khrul dang / chos khrul/ sgrig lam bcas mthar phyin thon pa'i drung rams pa(rab 'byams pa sger pa drung rams pa zer)bgres gras re yod cing / de dag gis dgon pa'i lcags ri'i khor yug nang tshud dge 'dun bzhuṭa gnas gling khag bcu drug yod pa so so'i grwa pa'i sgrig lam gnon 'doms soṭa kyi 'gan 'khur byed/ (lnga) chos sde byang gi gsang sngags grwa tshang rab 'byams pas sngags phyogs kyi gnang sgo yongs rdzogs gnang dgos pa dang / ban gtsang pa bcu drug 18khu

cime— me dirī— nirte rtse— rkewaska— rkye me ba ltar yin gshis bdeg chen gyi chog zhabs dang —spyan — 'dren dung rgya sogs kyi 'gan 'khur dgos stabs chos phyogs kyi yong 'bab gang cir dmigs bsal can zhig yin/ cho sa byang gi dbu 'dzin gtso bo gzim chung two skor dpon pa/ rgya mtsho dpon slob/ de 'og dga' ldan dpon slob dang /dge 'phel dpon slob/ rdzong chung dpon slob/ skyed lhas dpon slob/ sa gling dpon slob/ dbu mdzad chen mo gcig dbu chung gnyis/ dbu dkyus gnyis/grwa tshang mchod dpon gcig chos khrims pa gcig de 'og ja dpon gcig tshwa gzigs pa gcig bcas yod/rī gong gsal gzim chung skor dpon dang rgya mtsho dpon slob gnyis ni gang ci'i dbu 'dzin gtso bo yin la/ rgya mtsho dpon slob ni sngags pa grwa tshang gi rdo rje slob dpon lta bu red/ dga' ldan dpon slob sogs dpon slob khag lnga po ni sgrub sde khag gi rgyud sde'i mkhan po yin/ de min las sne rnams nas so so'i mtshan mtshungs gnang sgo khag bcas dang / ban gtsang pa rnams nas bdag khri phyogs phebs skabs chog zhabs su bcar dgos pa dang / dung rgya dang dkyil 'khor 'bri 'debs kyis mtshon gsung zhabs zhu dgos rigs sbyang thon dgos pa/ yong 'bab kyang lo ltar bod zla brgyad pa'i nang sa gzhung ste phyag gnyer zhu khang nas chab tshan la phebs rgyu'i thugs mkho ra lug bsdoms bco brgyad dang /‘‘rgyal chen g.yo mdos’’skabs 'bru ru'i khal lnga drug re tsam/ lo ltar gnyer tshang nas 'bru ru'i khal bcu drug re dang sha khog gsum re/ khur ba nyis brgya skor/ phyag mdzod khang nas ja 'gyed phran bu/ sngags pa grwa tshang nas lo re 'bru ru'i khal/ bco brgyad re/ gzhan yang stod smad bla bskos phebs yul che rigs khagaji mang che ba ban gtsang pa nas phebs srol yod pas chos sde lho byang gi grwa pa'i nang nas gang ci'i yong 'bab che shos ban gtsang pa yin/ de min sto — — — — spre —— ——sde—— 189

byang so so'i las sne dge 'dun nga dnge ra na/ maspra/ na zur / sku )pred ska 5 ba gnyis dang phyed ka dbu mdzad dang dpon zer ba sogs sda nyi sa ska/ra/ grwa dmangs lho mar dge 'dun rar lo re la pho gas sgrubru kha' gsum re tsam/byang mar yang gsol phogs gang 'tshams re yod kyang lho byang gnyis ka gtso bo dad sbyin khag gi mang 'gyed sbyor 'bul kho nar rten dgor+sā kyi yod pa red/de min brag bcal skyed lhas pa zhes pa sogs sa skya'i ri khrod khag gi gnas 'dzin pa dang mtshams bsnyen sgrub pa po rnams la'ang sngar lam tshogs chen 'gyed tho'i nang gsal ltar 'gyed skal yod pa dang / rin chen sgang gi btsun ma khag gcig yod pa de rnams lha chen grwa tshogs nang zhugs mi chog kyang 'du khang gi phyi'i khyams ra'i zur du gdan gral yod pa der 'khod rnams la mang 'gyed 'dra mtshungs yod/sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyi sku dus su lha sa rdzong pa sogs nas sngags 'chang chen po de nyid bkrong rgyu'i ngan gshom byed skabs bla ma'i sku srog srung ched rang srog blos gtong phod pa'i gsol dpon zhig byung ba'i lo rgyus zhib gsal yod pa ltar de'i skya gzhis zam sne ba'i mi rgyud dang bcas par bzos sgo bdag rkyen du bka' tham rgyas bcad gzhir bzung lo re sa skya mdos chen skabs zam sne ba'i mi rgyud ser skya gang yin la ma stos par rkang 'dzin des kyang 'gyed skal blangs chog pa bcas/(ri) bla brang khag ste/ dus phyis gtso bo phun tshogs pho brang dang sgrol ma pho brang gnyis nas khri thog ma yin pa der yang sku sger gyi gsol gzim mchod gsum sogs zhabs zhu ba cha tshang yod cing / ngo zhabs sku 'khor la phyag gnyer sogs nas gtan 'bebs kyi grig car gsol phogs dang / gzhis ka chung chung re zung 'dzin rgyu yod la/ bla bskos khag nas kyang deb gsal 1 90

'bubashaṃ 'bab gang 'tshams 'bab kyi yod/gdung rgyud rje btsun ma rnams la'ang bla brang khag ces 'bod srol dang /sa skya'i gdung rgyud kyi rje btsun ma rnams snga dus mna' mar gtong sro' med cing / lo rer sa gzhung phyag gnyer khang nas gsol phogs 'bru khal bco lnga re dang / bzhes sha gsol/ ja/ gsol mar bcas gtan 'baibs gzhir bzung gang 'tshams re dang / nyin re'i zhal 'don gyi gtor kha gajo/ byed ces pa'i mchod rtsam phran bu re/ bla bskos khag gi mja ge rten 'bul 'bab phran bu bcas 'bab nga dang / rje btsun ma rer zhabs zhu ba‘‘krum khang gsol dpon’’zhes phyag mjod gcig dang / zhal ta ma gcig gsol thab pa gcig bcas gtan 'bebs yod pa rnams la'ang phogs thob krig car len rgyu yod(rtsa ba'i zhabs zhu'i gtan 'bebs thob thang de ltar yod kyang phyis rje btsun ma 'ga' zhig la de ltar med pa'ang yod)/ ngo g.yog gi phogs 'bab rnams len skabs phyag mdzod khang du kha btags gcig dang / dngul ṭam dkar gcig phul te gtong sgo'i 'dzin yig zhu khyer gyis gnyer tshang nas 'bru rtsam sha mar dang / phyag khang nas ja bcas len dgos/ gong gsal so so'i thob thang gzhir bzung zhabs gras gtan 'bebs kyi tshad gzhi ma yin pa'i sku sger zhabs gras 'phar ma yod rigs la phogs thob len rgyu med pa bcas/ rdze bdag chen khri 'don skor sogs 'brel yod 'ga' zhigs skya bdag chen khri pa'i khri 'don mdzad phyogs ni bdag khri gsar par tā la 'i bla ma'i phyag rtags thog nas thugs gtan 'khel mtshams sngar srol mdzad lam ltar thog ca/ra dbus phebar+sā kyi gsar ca/jal mdzad sgo sne mang yod 191

stabs sngon la mgron gnyer sogs sa zhabs do chod sbrel zla dang bcas lha ldan du ched rdzong gis bdag khri sku 'khor sngar lam gsar mjal dang sbrags dbus phebs gnang rgyu thugs gtan 'khel gshis bzhugs 'tsher dang chibs zhabs phebs bsu sngar lamu gra sgrig yod pa zhes bka' shag brgyud snyan seng zhus thog bdag khri sku 'khor rnams lha ldan du phebs tshes thugs gtan 'khel nyin skyid tshal klu lding du gzhung gi thab bsu dang / chibs zhabs rtse drung rnams chab stod chab gzan/ dbyar kha yin na zhwa dkar dang / dgun kha zhwa mo dga' spug sogs chibs bsgyur gyi lam ltar gyon dgos pa dang / shod drung rnams rgya lu chas spras te rtse shod ser skya brgyad dang sne shan rtse drung gcig bcas thab bsu'i sar bcar thog de nas bdag khri sku 'khor rnams bzhugs 'tsher phebs sgrig gang yod du gdan zhu byed dgos/ de'i sa gnas gang 'gab tu sne shan rtse drung brgyud rtse 'gag tu mjal phyag gzhes brda snyan seng phul te bdag khri sku 'khor bcas tā la'i bla ma'i mjal phyag grub bstun bdag khri'i gsar mjal dngos gzhi'i tshes cha stabs bstun gyis gong bzhin gzhes brda snyan seng dang 'brel gsar mjal dngos gzhi'i nyin bdag khri sku 'khor rnams na bza' gzab bzhes kyis rtse pho brang gi gzhung sgo phun tshogs 'du lam brgyud phebs te dang thog 'phags pa lha khang gi gtsos mchod khang khag la gnas gzigs bskyangs/ de trenas drung ja tshugs mtshams rten 'bul dngos chas rnams mdun du bstar te tshoms chen nyi 'od du yar phebs nas tā la'i bla ma mchog la sku phyag dang 'brel mjal dar nyin mo bde legs kyis thog drangs maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten btegs 'bul grub bstun sngar lam bdag khri rang gi go thob bzhugs khri'i thog bzhugs mtshams gsol ja dang / gsol gro/ bzhes 'bras/ dkar spro gshom sgrig sogs kyi mdzad sgo gnang srol mchis/ mdzad sgo'i rjes bdag khris 192 ༷

dad ldan ger pya / khag gi mjal phyag bzhemu/ shing / lha ldan gtsug lag khang soṭa la gnas kazigs grub mtshams/ tā la'i bla ma mchog gi sku mdun nas thon phyag zhu gnang gis sku 'khor rnams gaka na sa sa skyar phyir phebs gnang skabs gzhung ji/ thab skyel chibs zhabs sogs phebs bsu'i skabs bzhin yod/ bdag khri sku 'khor gdan sar zhabs 'khod mtshams sngar lam bdag khri'i che 'don khri phebs kyi mdzad sgo ni‘‘mdos chen’’gyi 'cham gzigs dus chen dang stabs bstun mdzad srol yod cing / dngos gzhi'i khri phebs mdzad sgo ni chos byang gzhi thog pho brang du de snga 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng mdzad dgos pa dang / bdag chen gyi bzhugs khri'i g.yas g.yon du bdag yum dang gdung sras bgres gzhon/ yongs 'dzin bcas kyi bzhugs khri/ gsol gzim mchod gsum sogs sngar gyi las tshan bcu gsum gzhir bdag thog phyis bdag khri'i gsham du srid kyi gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur mkhan mdzod pas gtsos sa gzhung gi phyi nang las tshan che 'bring chung gsum tshang ma rang rang go babs gdan thog bzhugs gral dang / mdun gral du chos sde sto byang gis gtsos bla ma las sne rnams so so'i go thob la gzhigs pa'i bzhugs gral bcas kyi dbus su ston chen bzhes spro rgyas gshom dang 'brel bro gzhas 'cham gzigs sogs kyi mdzad sgo'i thog dbus gtsang khul gyi sa khongs lha sde mi sde smos med khar/ mdo stod dang mdo smad chu bzhi sgang drug khul gyi sa khongs lha mi'i sde dgon tshang ma'i mkhan 'thus bcas khri phebs mdzad sgor ched bcar rnams kyis sngar lam khri mjal 'bul ba zhu sgo gang yod zhu dgos pa dang / skabs der chos sde sto byang dang lhag par ngo mtshar rten bzhi'i khongs rje btsun sa paṇa gyi thugs dam rten‘‘'jam dbyangs chos 'khor ma midang‘‘rnam rgyal mchod rtenamimi/ ba ri lo tsā ba'i thugs dam rten‘‘sgrol dkar tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo bcas kyi spyan 193

smrer nyin ltar mchod sprin sna lnga stong tshar 'bul gshom/ ngo mtshar rten bzhi'i ya gyal‘‘gur mgon bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes’’kyi spyan sngar tshogs skong 'phrin bcol gzab rgyas bcas mdzad srol thog mdzad chen nyin gsum pa'i nyin tshogs yongs sku 'cham gyi do rar bdag khri rin po che nas gur mgon bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes kyi zhal 'bag dang / 'cham chas cha tshang bzhes thog dung rgya'i phebs bsu dang / rnga rol gyi sgra dang bstun te gar 'cham gnang bzhin par dbu gdugs pa dang bcas byon skabs der bzhugs lha sde mi sde tshang mas dad pa'i spu long g.yos te dga' gus tshad med zhu ba sogs khri phebs kyi mdzad sgo legs grub zin rjes phyogs mtha'i ser skya so so rim bzhin sger mjal du bcar skabs sngar lam gnang cha'i dngos po sna tshogs gya nom pa bstsal srol yod/sa skya mdos chen zhis pa'i dus mchod ni/ lo ltar bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer gsum nyin nas bzung 'go tshugs te dngos gzhi gong zla'i tshes nyer lnga nas nyin bdun ring yin zhing / de'i ring phyogs 'grul khag mang 'dzoms te tshong dus kyi khrom ra yang gang 'tshams yod pa dang ltad mo ba dang bcas mi tshogs che gshis 'khrugs po yod/ tshes nyer dgu'i nyin gtor zlog chen mo dang / tshes sum cu nyin sa skya'i 'cham ra chen mo'i cho sa khri'i thog bdag khri yab sras nas khrom tshogs la mjal dmangs dang 'brel tshe dbang gnang srol/ mozla bcu gnyis tsheṭa/ gcig nyin gzhi thog pho brang gi tshogs khang yang steng du bdag chen ngo phebs kyis lha bar ngas gsung chos mdzad skabs mus gzhil ka nas gzab mchor dang 'brel gser phud(mchod chang) bstar 'bul zhu srol/‘‘gtso mo nam mkha' sprol ma mizhes pa'i zhal 'bag de rgyun ldan yukha/ chen dgon par bzhugs su gsol yang‘‘mdos chen’’skabs bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes 191

nyer gsum nyin sa skyar gdan zhu dgon pas de'i phebs bsu phebs skyel zhu sgo zam sne bas zhu dgos la/ zhal 'bag de nyid gar 'cham mdzad sgo'i nyin tshoṭa khang nang gdan zhu dgos pa las/ de min dus mchod de'i ring zam sne ba'i mchod khang nang bzhugs su gsol te nyin ltar bskang (sgyubul dgos pa dang /dus myo/chod de'i ring tshogs chen mchod dpon la thob cha gang yod pa rna mas zam sne ba'i mi rgyud dang bcas par 'jags gnas yod/zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum nyin dgong dro/ phyi'i khri 'dzin nam gzim chung bskor dpon pa zhes pa de gzhi thog pho brang gi rdo gcal nang bzhugs khri sgron te gdan zhus kyis sger mtsho sgo ba'i gnyer pa 'khor bcas gdan 'khod thog mtsho sgo ba'i mi sger gyis rgyan gos gzab mchor dang bcas glu gar 'khrub 'bur zhu srol yod/dus mchod de'i skabs stod smad gzhis khag dang / bla gnyer ram bla bskos khag gzar pa tshong dpon bcas‘‘nyer gsum ma jal dar’’bstar 'bul zhu sgo'i dus tshod 'gyangs med gdan sar 'dzoms dgos pa dang / bla gnyer las thog che khag nas‘‘mdos chenami’kyi mdzad sgo khag dang / khrom tshogs mjug ma 'gril bar gang ci'i khrims 'doms 'gan 'khur gyis 'khrug rtsod dang / rku rgyag sogs mi 'byung ba'i bde 'jags srung skyong dang / byung rigs la khrims gnon mjug skyong / bdag khris dbus gdung sras khag tshogs phebs skabs phebs 'a ma bshang rgyu sogs kyi 'gan 'khur dang / khrom khrul bsdu len bcas kyi do dam byed dgos/sa skya sde 'og tu gnas pa'i gzhis slong(dbul po dang zha long sogs)gang yod kyi khrod nas na so dar babs gzugs bsam bde grung yod pa gcig 'go par phyag mdzod 'gag nas mgron brgyud bskos te rang 'og gzhis slong na 'chi 196

sogs rkyen ngan dang dka' ngal che rigs la rogs phan byed dgos la/ gtor zlog skabs glud zor gtor ma dbor 'dren sogs kyi byed sgo'i 'gan 'khur dang / dad sbyin khag gi mang 'gyed sbyin gtong skabs lha khang chen mo'i rgyal sgo'i 'gram du zha long rgan rgon rnams mnyam 'khrid kyis sbyin dngos thob mtshams bar bskor rer lam khrid nas khungs so sor skyel dgos pa sogs dang gzhan yang rgan pos bkod sgrig gang byas dang len byed dgos pa bcas/

rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ pad+ma skal bzang /blo bzang tshe brtan/rtsom zhib pa/ sangs rgyas chos 'phel/ tshe dbang stobs ldan/ bod kyi 'o rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/(4)(spyi'i 'don thengs 13pa)bod rang skyong ljongs srid gros lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha u yon lhan khang gis rtsom sgrig byas pa/mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun zhing 'grems spel byas pa/1991lo'i zla 5par par gzhi 1po bsgrigs pa/1091lo'i zla 5par pe cin la par thengs 1po brgyab pa/deb rer sgor 1 76
